feature:access_log.title: Access log
feature:access_log.does: Lists who opened a hidden phone number, address or customer list, when, and why.
feature:access_log.why: Lets the owner see if someone is looking where they should not.
feature:access_log.default: Empty until the privacy switch is ON.
feature:access_log.change: Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
feature:access_log.who: Only the owner can read it. Nobody can change it.

feature:account_classes.title: Account classes
feature:account_classes.does: For each chart account an optional cash-flow class (operating, investing, financing) and balance class (current, non-current). Blank means unclassified. A button fills only the blanks with the usual practice, after a preview and with a reason.
feature:account_classes.why: The owner, not the software, decides which class an account belongs to.
feature:account_classes.change: Changes the cash-flow statement and working capital only. Every change is in the audit log; a class is cleared by blanking it, never deleted.
feature:account_classes.who: The owner or an accounts manager.

feature:action_queue.title: Approval queue for proposed actions
feature:action_queue.does: An agent or an automated job can propose one action from a short allowed list. The owner approves or rejects it (a rejection needs a reason). Nothing runs by itself: the owner's own session runs the approved action and records the result.
feature:action_queue.why: A proposal is never a silent change.
feature:action_queue.default: The list of allowed actions is empty. Nothing can be proposed until the owner allows an action.
feature:action_queue.change: The owner adds an action to the allowed list. Rules, permissions, the audit trail and money can never be on that list.
feature:action_queue.who: The owner decides. The person who proposed cannot decide the same proposal.

feature:actual_yield.title: Actual yield at production
feature:actual_yield.does: An optional box in the production sheet for the real quantity made.
feature:actual_yield.why: The report can then compare real and standard yield.
feature:actual_yield.default: Blank: the standard yield goes into stock and the run says 'actual yield not captured'.
feature:actual_yield.change: A typed value is what goes into stock for that run (existing production rule).

feature:agent_accounts.title: Agent accounts (limited sign-in for software)
feature:agent_accounts.does: A separate sign-in for an automated agent. It can only ask the gate and propose actions for the owner to approve. It can never hold a role or a permission, and it can never change rules, permissions, the audit trail or money.
feature:agent_accounts.why: An agent can help, but it can never do what only a person may do.
feature:agent_accounts.default: None exists. The owner creates one only when needed.
feature:agent_accounts.change: The owner names an account that has no roles and no permissions.

feature:agreed_prices.title: Agreed price per item and supplier
feature:agreed_prices.does: The price agreed with a supplier, from a date; a new price closes the old one.
feature:agreed_prices.why: Lets the price variance report show what was paid above the agreement.
feature:agreed_prices.default: Blank. Lines with no agreed price are counted as 'not captured'.
feature:agreed_prices.change: Nothing is posted or changed; it is a comparison.

feature:announce_bar.title: Headline bar (announcements)
feature:announce_bar.does: A slim moving line under the header shows the announcements addressed to the person. Tap it to read the full text and press I have read this. When nothing is addressed to the person the bar is not drawn at all.
feature:announce_bar.why: Staff see an instruction at once, and the poster can see who has read it.
feature:announce_bar.default: Off. No bar, no request to the server and no menu entry until the owner switches announce_on on.
feature:announce_bar.change: Switch announce_on on, then give the right announce_post to the people who may post. With reduced motion on the phone the line stands still and shows the first headline and a count.
feature:announce_bar.who: Everyone it is addressed to sees it. The owner and holders of announce_post post.

feature:attendance_sources.title: Attendance summary reads both sources
feature:attendance_sources.does: The staff attendance summary shows the attendance marked in the app and the paper register 19-1 in separate rows, with a column saying which is which.
feature:attendance_sources.why: The report used to show only the paper register and was empty while the app held the attendance.
feature:attendance_sources.change: Nothing is added together by name; the two sources stay apart.
feature:attendance_sources.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:aud_approvals.title: Approval delays (#180)
feature:aud_approvals.does: Hours from request to decision by kind and approver, and the oldest requests still waiting.
feature:aud_approvals.why: Clock hours only; no limit for 'late' is invented.

feature:aud_gaps.title: Missing cost, recipe, batch and expiry data (#183)
feature:aud_gaps.does: Lists items with no cost price, finished goods with no recipe, recipe lines with no waste %, ingredients with no cost and batches with no expiry date.
feature:aud_gaps.why: A missing cost is never shown as 0; this list shows where that happens.
feature:aud_gaps.default: Open to control and stock report readers.

feature:aud_log.title: Audit log (#173)
feature:aud_log.does: Everything the system wrote, newest first, with filters, paging and a full CSV.
feature:aud_log.why: The log cannot be edited or deleted.
feature:aud_log.who: Read only. Each export is itself logged.

feature:aud_overrides.title: Discount and price-override approvals (#175)
feature:aud_overrides.does: Per bill, who approved a discount and who approved a price change.
feature:aud_overrides.why: The approver of a price change is stored from this update onward; older bills say 'not captured'.
feature:aud_overrides.default: Open to report readers. A new silent capture runs on every bill with a changed price; it never blocks a sale.

feature:aud_stockadj.title: Stock adjustment approval history (#174)
feature:aud_stockadj.does: Wastage, count adjustments and transit losses: who asked, who approved, how long it took.
feature:aud_stockadj.why: Entries made directly have no request and so no approver; this shows which.
feature:aud_stockadj.default: Open to report readers; values need the cost right.

feature:aud_unusual.title: Voids, refunds and unusual transactions (#176)
feature:aud_unusual.does: Bill voids, voided payments, returns, refunds paid, voided returns and bill exceptions together.
feature:aud_unusual.why: Events of known kinds; nothing is picked by an amount limit.

feature:aud_users.title: User activity (#177)
feature:aud_users.does: Per person: bills, voids, returns, forms and (owner only) logins and audit-log actions.
feature:aud_users.why: Counts are not a judgement of the person.
feature:aud_users.default: Open to report_control readers for business columns; owner for the rest.

feature:aud_voids.title: Voids, reversals and corrections (#182)
feature:aud_voids.does: Every void, journal reversal and correction of every module in one list.
feature:aud_voids.why: Nothing is hard-deleted; modules that never stored the time of a void show a blank time.
feature:aud_voids.default: Open to the owner, report_control and view_reports.

feature:balance_widget.title: Balance sheet check on the owner board
feature:balance_widget.does: The Balance sheet check tile now reads the books (acct_balance_sheet). It used to call a function that does not exist and was always empty.
feature:balance_widget.why: A tile that is always empty looks like a healthy empty state.
feature:balance_widget.default: Shown automatically on the owner board.
feature:balance_widget.change: Green when assets equal liabilities plus equity; empty when the accounting module is not switched on.

feature:batchrep_ageing.title: Finished goods ageing
feature:batchrep_ageing.does: Age in days since the batch was made, per batch and per item (oldest, quantity-weighted average). Age bands only if the owner sets report_aging_buckets. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: report_aging_buckets (bands), batch (unbatched stock)".

feature:batchrep_batches.title: Stock by batch and expiry
feature:batchrep_batches.does: Every open batch in FEFO order and one 'unbatched' line per item and place, so batches + unbatched = the balance. Raw material received without a lot appears as unbatched: its receipt date and expiry are not captured. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: lot / batch on receipt, expires_at".

feature:batchrep_distribution.title: Distribution by outlet and batch
feature:batchrep_distribution.does: Per production batch and place: received, sold, wasted, passed on, held now, on the road, short. Sales made beyond stock have no batch and form their own line. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: stock_ledger.batch_id (sales beyond stock)".

feature:batchrep_expired.title: Expired, damaged and unsold
feature:batchrep_expired.does: Wastage entries by class: expired, unsold (new reason Unsold), damaged (broken, burnt, spoiled) plus customer returns marked damaged and whether they went back into sellable stock (they do while no return class rule is set). Missing data is shown as "data not captured: w1c_return_class_rules, unit cost".

feature:batchrep_unsold.title: Unsold by production batch
feature:batchrep_unsold.does: For every production batch: made = sold (net) + wasted + other + short in transit + on the road + in stock. Unsold = in stock + on the road. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: production cost, expiry".

feature:burn_rules.title: Using points at the till
feature:burn_rules.does: Checks the burn limits before points are used on a bill.
feature:burn_rules.change: The till calls the checked redeem. The old redeem still works for screens that have not changed.
feature:burn_rules.who: Owner sets the limits. The owner or the loyalty manage right can go past a limit, with a reason.

feature:cake_spec.title: Cake specification on an app order
feature:cake_spec.does: Weight, flavour, message, design and a photo reference written on the app order.
feature:cake_spec.why: Cake orders were only free text.
feature:cake_spec.default: Optional boxes on the order form. Nothing is required.
feature:cake_spec.change: Filled boxes are saved with the order. Paper form code for a printed cake sheet: to be given by owner.
feature:cake_spec.who: Anyone who may enter online orders.

feature:camera_recognition.title: Camera and recognition (X5)
feature:camera_recognition.does: Barcode, label text (on phone), photo matching (on phone, not yet installed), name suggestions, duplicate check and a review record for unclear reads. Every part is a separate switch and is OFF by default.
feature:camera_recognition.why: Faster item entry with fewer duplicates, and nothing changes until the owner switches a part on.
feature:camera_recognition.default: All OFF. The item form works as before.
feature:camera_recognition.change: Each part is switched on or off in Settings. Recognised text or photos only suggest; a person always chooses.

feature:campaigns_master.title: Campaign list
feature:campaigns_master.does: The master list of marketing campaigns with start, end, budget and channel.
feature:campaigns_master.why: 17-1 lines, bills and online orders point to a campaign here; without it no report can work per campaign.
feature:campaigns_master.default: Empty. The owner enters every campaign.
feature:campaigns_master.change: Nothing is posted or changed by the list itself.
feature:campaigns_master.who: The owner or the people who manage the list.

feature:capacity_utilization.title: Capacity utilization
feature:capacity_utilization.does: Batches made against the rated capacity of a place or line. The capacity of a day is batches per day x working days per week / 7, from the rating in force that day.
feature:capacity_utilization.why: Shows whether the factory is idle or stretched.
feature:capacity_utilization.default: No rating = 'rated capacity not captured'. Days without a rating are not judged; batches made on them are shown apart.
feature:capacity_utilization.change: Nothing; read only. The owner sets the rating in the set-up tab.
feature:capacity_utilization.who: Anyone with the stock report right; ratings are set by the owner or a holder of capacity_manage.

feature:cash_flow_statement.title: Cash-flow statement
feature:cash_flow_statement.does: Cash movements from the journal grouped as operating, investing and financing by the class of the other account of each entry; opening balances and moves between your own cash accounts are not flows. Closing cash equals the Cash flow tab of Accounts.
feature:cash_flow_statement.why: The old tab only listed movements by source, so an opening balance looked like a big inflow and a bank deposit like an inflow and an outflow.
feature:cash_flow_statement.default: Needs the accounting start date. Every account has no class until the owner gives one, so everything starts as 'unclassified'.
feature:cash_flow_statement.change: Read only. Give the accounts a class in the Classes tab (or fill the blanks with the usual practice there).
feature:cash_flow_statement.who: Anyone with the profit report right or accounts rights; the CSV also needs the export right.

feature:cashier_14_1.title: Cashier on the daily showroom sheet 06-1
feature:cashier_14_1.does: The person who handled the till for that sheet (the shift box already exists).
feature:cashier_14_1.why: Cash short and over could only be tied to the person who wrote the sheet.
feature:cashier_14_1.change: Cashier-wise variance fills in from new sheets. Older sheets show as 'cashier not written'.

feature:col_actual_cost_status.title: Actual cost not captured
feature:col_actual_cost_status.does: Costing runs: shows "Not captured" when no actual yield was typed (no copy of the standard).
feature:col_actual_cost_status.why: Actual equal to standard was misleading.
feature:col_actual_cost_status.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_actual_cost_status.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_actual_status.title: Actual measured?
feature:col_actual_status.does: Raw material report: measured, partly or not captured.
feature:col_actual_status.why: The report used to show 0.00 % difference although nothing was measured.
feature:col_actual_status.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_actual_status.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_conversion_status.title: Conversion cost not captured
feature:col_conversion_status.does: Costing runs: shows "Not costed" when the place method is off (no 0).
feature:col_conversion_status.why: A zero looked like a real cost.
feature:col_conversion_status.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_conversion_status.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_expected_cash_after_refunds.title: Expected cash in drawer after refunds
feature:col_expected_cash_after_refunds.does: POS day close: expected cash minus cash refunds. The old "expected cash" column is unchanged.
feature:col_expected_cash_after_refunds.why: This is the figure to compare with the counted drawer.
feature:col_expected_cash_after_refunds.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_expected_cash_after_refunds.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_gaps_losses.title: Losses left out of the profit (gaps column)
feature:col_gaps_losses.does: Branch profit reports name wastage, count shrink, transit loss and cash short/over that exist but are not counted.
feature:col_gaps_losses.why: The profit looked complete when it was not.
feature:col_gaps_losses.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_gaps_losses.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_net_after_refunds.title: Amount after refunds
feature:col_net_after_refunds.does: Amount taken by the mode minus refunds paid out by the same mode.
feature:col_net_after_refunds.why: The real money by payment mode.
feature:col_net_after_refunds.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_net_after_refunds.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_net_after_returns.title: Sales after returns
feature:col_net_after_returns.does: Sales minus returns. Equals the dashboard figure. With the setting "net of returns" off it equals Sales.
feature:col_net_after_returns.why: Lets the sales reports agree with the dashboard and the profit reports.
feature:col_net_after_returns.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_net_after_returns.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_qty_after_returns.title: Quantity after returns
feature:col_qty_after_returns.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_qty_after_returns.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_refund_cash.title: Cash refunds paid out
feature:col_refund_cash.does: POS day close: cash handed back to customers that day.
feature:col_refund_cash.why: The drawer cash was shown too high because refunds were ignored.
feature:col_refund_cash.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_refund_cash.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_refund_paid.title: Refunds paid out
feature:col_refund_paid.does: Money handed back to customers for sale returns, by payment mode and day. A return settled against a customer due is not a payout.
feature:col_refund_paid.why: Cash that left the drawer must be visible in the payment report.
feature:col_refund_paid.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_refund_paid.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_returns_amt.title: Returns
feature:col_returns_amt.does: Value of goods taken back in the period (the sale discount share already taken off), counted on the day of the return.
feature:col_returns_amt.why: The same day showed two different sales figures because returns were ignored.
feature:col_returns_amt.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_returns_amt.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:col_returns_qty.title: Returned quantity
feature:col_returns_qty.why: Shows how many pieces really stayed sold.
feature:col_returns_qty.change: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
feature:col_returns_qty.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:consent_register.title: Customer consent and privacy
feature:consent_register.does: Shows who has said yes, who said no, who was never asked and who is do-not-contact, per channel. Tap a customer to record a change.
feature:consent_register.why: It is the proof that a customer agreed.
feature:consent_register.default: Existing customers all start as 'Not asked'. Nothing is changed for them.
feature:consent_register.change: Recording a no cancels waiting messages at once. A yes after a no needs a written reason.
feature:consent_register.who: The owner and customer managers. Counter staff only if the owner switches that on.

feature:cost_variance.title: Standard vs actual cost and the variance split
feature:cost_variance.does: For each run: price variance, usage variance and yield variance of the material, and their sum. Standard quantity is what the production screen booked, real quantity is what was typed, standard price is the owner's price list, standard output is the recipe yield, real output is the typed yield.
feature:cost_variance.why: Separates 'we paid more' from 'we used more' from 'we got less out'.
feature:cost_variance.default: Each part is shown only when all of its inputs exist. The three parts add up exactly to the total.
feature:cost_variance.change: Nothing; read only. Conversion cost has no standard in the system and is shown as booked, not split.
feature:cost_variance.who: Anyone with the stock report right and the cost right.

feature:coupon_override.title: Coupon exceptions
feature:coupon_override.does: Accepts a coupon that is expired, not started, below the minimum bill, at another outlet or past the per-customer limit.
feature:coupon_override.why: Real life has exceptions; they must leave a trace.
feature:coupon_override.change: Needs a reason. Writes an audit line and a yellow Exceptions line.
feature:coupon_override.who: The owner, or a person with the coupon override right.

feature:coupons.title: Coupons and vouchers
feature:coupons.does: A code with a value, dates, a minimum bill, use limits and optional outlet or item scope.
feature:coupons.why: Controlled offers with a record of every use.
feature:coupons.change: Use a coupon: check it at the till, give the discount through the normal discount control, then record it after the sale. A different discount raises a yellow Exceptions line.
feature:coupons.who: The owner or a person with the coupon issue right makes coupons. The owner or a person with the coupon override right can accept an expired or limited coupon with a reason.

feature:crm_hooks_on.title: Birthday, anniversary and festival hooks
feature:crm_hooks_on.does: Lets the owner see who is due for a birthday or anniversary bonus and give the bonus points once per year.
feature:crm_hooks_on.why: Small gifts on special days build loyalty.
feature:crm_hooks_on.default: OFF. The due list is empty and nothing is given.
feature:crm_hooks_on.change: The due list works and the owner can run the bonus (preview first). Loyalty points must also be ON.

feature:crm_merge.title: Link two customers as the same person
feature:crm_merge.does: Lets a person link and unlink duplicate customers.
feature:crm_merge.why: A wrong link would hide a real customer, so it is not open to everyone.
feature:crm_merge.default: Nobody has it until the owner gives it. The owner always may.
feature:crm_merge.change: Given: the person can link and unlink with a written reason; each link is a yellow row in the Exceptions list.

feature:customer_advance.title: Customer advance
feature:customer_advance.does: Money a customer pays before buying. It is held as a liability in account 2300. A read-only check compares the journal with the cash moves for each customer.
feature:customer_advance.why: An advance is not income until it is used.
feature:customer_advance.default: The posting already worked before phase 81. The check changes nothing.
feature:customer_advance.change: There is no switch. The full flow of using an advance was not confirmed here.
feature:customer_advance.who: People with Accounts view can run the check.

feature:customer_lists.title: Customer lists screen
feature:customer_lists.does: Build a list of customers from a few plain rules: not seen for N days, high spenders, birthday soon, one-time buyers, at risk, not yet agreed to messages, by outlet, by tier, bought an item. You see how many customers it holds before you save anything.
feature:customer_lists.why: It turns 'who should we call or message for this festival?' into a clear list, and shows the size first so nobody messages the whole customer book by mistake.
feature:customer_lists.default: The screen is visible only to the owner and to people given a CRM right; saving is off.
feature:customer_lists.change: Looking and counting change nothing in your data. Saving and freezing are controlled by the switch above.
feature:customer_lists.who: The owner decides who gets the rights 'See customer lists, scores and notes', 'Save customer lists and refresh customer scores' and 'Export customer lists'.

feature:customer_profit.title: Customer profit view
feature:customer_profit.does: Shows, for a period of up to 400 days, how much each customer bought, what it cost you, and the profit, using the same cost figures as the profit reports.
feature:customer_profit.why: A customer who buys a lot at a big discount may earn you little.
feature:customer_profit.default: Visible only to people who may already see cost
feature:customer_profit.change: Reading only. Sales whose cost is not known are shown apart and marked 'some cost unknown'; they are never guessed.
feature:customer_profit.who: The owner, through the existing right to see cost.

feature:customer_type_and_credit_days.title: Customer type and credit days
feature:customer_type_and_credit_days.does: Marks a customer as retail, wholesale, party, corporate, online or staff (from the editable list), and records how many days they are normally given to pay.
feature:customer_type_and_credit_days.why: Staff know at a glance how to treat the customer.
feature:customer_type_and_credit_days.change: Setting a value changes only the profile. The retail / wholesale choice used at the till is not changed by it.
feature:customer_type_and_credit_days.who: The owner or a person with the customer manager right.

feature:customer_value.title: Customer value screen
feature:customer_value.does: Shows how many customers come back (repeat-purchase rate), the average and middle lifetime value, who is a Champion or At risk, who has not been seen for a while, the biggest customers, and who owes money.
feature:customer_value.why: It shows whether the shop is building loyal customers and where regular customers are slipping away, before the money is lost.
feature:customer_value.default: Visible to the owner and to people given a CRM right. Reading only.
feature:customer_value.change: Nothing in your data changes. Lifetime value here is what the customer really spent after returns; it is not a forecast.
feature:customer_value.who: The owner decides who gets the right to see it.

feature:customers_credit_days.title: Credit days of a customer
feature:customers_credit_days.does: How many days a customer may take to pay.
feature:customers_credit_days.why: A due date is needed to say what is overdue.
feature:customers_credit_days.change: Set from the customer card in Customer insight. A change of an existing value needs a reason and is written to the audit log.
feature:customers_credit_days.who: The owner or a person with the customer_manage right (the right that sets the credit limit).

feature:delivery_cost.title: Actual delivery cost
feature:delivery_cost.does: The cost really paid for delivering one order (rider, fuel, platform fee).
feature:delivery_cost.why: Delivery cost and order profit could not be known; the customer's delivery charge is the only figure the system had.
feature:delivery_cost.default: Optional box when delivering. Does not post to the books.
feature:delivery_cost.change: The cost is information for costing. The payment is still entered as an expense as usual, so nothing is counted twice.
feature:delivery_cost.who: Anyone who may enter online orders; the cost is shown only with the cost right.

feature:dispatch_recon.title: Production to dispatch
feature:dispatch_recon.does: Per day, producing place and item: quantity made, sent to shops, received, still in transit and short, and the quantity on hand now.
feature:dispatch_recon.why: Shows whether what the factory made reached the shops.
feature:dispatch_recon.default: Quantities only, no money. Sent = received + in transit + short always ties; a row that does not tie is flagged.
feature:dispatch_recon.change: Nothing; read only. On hand is the balance today, not the end of the period.
feature:dispatch_recon.who: Anyone with the stock report right or the right to move stock.

feature:do_not_contact.title: Do not contact
feature:do_not_contact.does: Stops every message to a customer on every channel, even if they said yes before.
feature:do_not_contact.why: Some customers ask not to be contacted at all.
feature:do_not_contact.change: On: waiting messages are cancelled now and new ones are refused. Off again: needs a manager and a written reason.
feature:do_not_contact.who: Anyone who may record consent can switch it on; only a manager can switch it off.

feature:exception_reason.title: Override with a reason
feature:exception_reason.does: Each control has a way past it that needs a written reason. A use writes one audit line and one row in the Exceptions list. The way is not tied to a person or a role.
feature:exception_reason.why: A rule that can never bend gets worked around, so a bend with a reason leaves a trace.
feature:exception_reason.default: An override is not available unless the owner grants it.
feature:exception_reason.change: There is no switch. The owner's one-off grant needs a reason, works once and expires in 24 hours by default; a journal that does not balance gets no exception.
feature:exception_reason.who: The owner gives the grant. The use is logged.

feature:expense_register.title: Expense register
feature:expense_register.does: One list of every expense line (vouchers 11-1 in every status, quick expenses, bank charges, wallet fees, and the marketing register 17-1 marked 'not in the books'), with the expense report, P&L, day book and journal totals side by side, a reconciliation that says why they differ, a basis selector and a CSV.
feature:expense_register.why: The same period gave three different expense totals and no screen listed the vouchers behind them.
feature:expense_register.default: Open to the owner and to people with the expense report right or accounts rights. Nothing to switch on.
feature:expense_register.who: Anyone with the expense report right; the CSV also needs the export right.

feature:factory_vs_retail.title: Factory vs retail
feature:factory_vs_retail.does: Three blocks side by side: what the factory produced and what it cost, what it sent to the shops (quantity, cost, and value under the owner's basis), and what each shop sold with its cost of goods and gross profit.
feature:factory_vs_retail.why: Tells whether the factory or the shops make the money.
feature:factory_vs_retail.default: Transfers are 'not valued' until the owner picks a basis. Shop gross profit is at ledger cost and is never netted with a transfer value.
feature:factory_vs_retail.change: Nothing; read only. Cost columns need the cost right at that place.
feature:factory_vs_retail.who: Anyone with the sales report right or the stock report right, for their own places.

feature:fc_cash.title: Expected cash in and out (#188)
feature:fc_cash.does: Known future money by day: order balances, customer dues, supplier bills, salary, bank charges.
feature:fc_cash.why: An unknown date is shown apart, never placed on the calendar.
feature:fc_cash.default: Open to cash report readers; salary lines need salary view.

feature:fc_expiry.title: Expiry and wastage risk (#190)
feature:fc_expiry.does: Batches expiring soon: units expected to sell before expiry (oldest first) and units left over.
feature:fc_expiry.why: 'At risk' is what is left after expected sales, not a prediction of waste.
feature:fc_expiry.default: Needs days and a window; the existing setting report_expiry_soon_days can supply the days.

feature:fc_items.title: Item demand forecast (#185)
feature:fc_items.does: Units per item for the coming days from the stock ledger, same method as the sales forecast.
feature:fc_items.why: Days out of stock count as zero, so demand may be understated; items that are not stock-tracked are not covered.
feature:fc_items.default: Needs a window; nothing is assumed.

feature:fc_production.title: Production requirement (#186)
feature:fc_production.does: For one place: expected demand (and open orders) minus stock on hand = what to make, in units and recipe batches.
feature:fc_production.why: Adding open orders may count some demand twice, so the two columns are separate.
feature:fc_production.default: Needs a window and a place.

feature:fc_raw.title: Raw material purchase forecast (#187)
feature:fc_raw.does: The production quantities pushed through the recipes: need, stock on hand and shortfall per ingredient, with cost for people who may see costs.
feature:fc_raw.why: A blank waste % is used as zero and flagged; an ingredient with no cost is counted, not priced.
feature:fc_raw.default: Needs a window and a place.

feature:fc_sales.title: Sales forecast (#184)
feature:fc_sales.does: Coming days estimated from the average of the same weekday in the look-back window, with the lowest and highest as a range.
feature:fc_sales.why: The range is not a confidence interval and no probability is claimed.
feature:fc_sales.default: Needs a window (typed or set); nothing is assumed.

feature:fc_scenario.title: What-if scenario (#192)
feature:fc_scenario.does: A past period's real figures with the percent changes you type applied.
feature:fc_scenario.why: Arithmetic on your numbers, not a forecast; no percent is suggested.

feature:fc_seasonal.title: Seasonal and festival demand (#193)
feature:fc_seasonal.does: For each past festival the owner entered: sales per trading day during it against ordinary days before it, plus sales by month.
feature:fc_seasonal.why: Observed differences are history, not promises; the days behind each figure are shown.

feature:fc_suppliers.title: Upcoming supplier payments (#189)
feature:fc_suppliers.does: Open supplier bills with due date = bill date + credit days: overdue, coming up, date unknown.
feature:fc_suppliers.why: A supplier with no credit days has no due date; enter it on the supplier.
feature:fc_suppliers.default: Open to cash and purchase report readers.

feature:festival_calendar.title: Festival calendar
feature:festival_calendar.does: The owner's list of festivals with dates and an optional uplift %.
feature:festival_calendar.why: Festival days are left out of ordinary averages; an uplift is shown only when the owner types one.
feature:festival_calendar.change: Forecasts mark festival days and apply the owner's uplift separately.
feature:festival_calendar.who: Only the owner. Entries are retired, never deleted.

feature:item_suppliers.title: Preferred and alternative suppliers
feature:item_suppliers.does: Which suppliers may supply an item, preferred or alternative.
feature:item_suppliers.why: Shows items that depend on one supplier.
feature:item_suppliers.default: Blank. Items without a declared supplier are flagged 'not captured'.

feature:kpi_trend.title: KPI trends and alerts
feature:kpi_trend.does: A daily series of sales, bills, average bill, discount %, voids and production yield from daily snapshots, plus the alerts of the three owner limits and the count of open exceptions.
feature:kpi_trend.why: History of how the business is running, not only today's numbers.
feature:kpi_trend.default: Days without a snapshot are listed as missing, never drawn as 0. A blank limit means no alert of that kind.
feature:kpi_trend.change: Taking snapshots stores a copy of figures already recorded for closed days (up to yesterday); existing days are not changed unless the owner asks to redo them. Nothing else moves.
feature:kpi_trend.who: The owner, holders of the sales report right, and the scheduler account that runs notify_scan.

feature:labour_productivity.title: Output per labour hour
feature:labour_productivity.does: Per run: the output and the labour hours recorded for it (people x hours each, summed over the crews) and the output per hour; totals per item and per place.
feature:labour_productivity.why: Shows how productive each run and place is.
feature:labour_productivity.default: A run with no labour record is 'labour not captured' and is left out of the totals. Output of different items is never added.
feature:labour_productivity.who: Anyone with the stock report right.

feature:loyalty_summary.title: Loyalty summary
feature:loyalty_summary.does: Points given, used and expired, points outstanding, referrals, coupons and bonuses for a date range.
feature:loyalty_summary.why: Shows what the programme costs and does.
feature:loyalty_summary.change: Nothing changes. Outstanding points are shown for information and are not booked in the accounts.
feature:loyalty_summary.who: The owner, customer-manage holders and loyalty managers.

feature:main_phone_change.title: Make an extra number the main number
feature:main_phone_change.does: Swaps the main phone number of a customer with one of their extra numbers. The old main number stays on the profile as an extra number.
feature:main_phone_change.why: The main number is how the till finds the customer.
feature:main_phone_change.default: Not available until 'Customer profile extras' is ON.
feature:main_phone_change.change: Needs a written reason of at least 3 characters and writes one line to the change log. A number that is already the main number of another customer is refused.
feature:main_phone_change.who: The owner or a person with the customer manager right.

feature:mkt_cac.title: Customer acquisition cost (#169)
feature:mkt_cac.does: Marketing spend divided by new customers, by customer source.
feature:mkt_cac.why: The share of new customers with a source filled is always shown; without a source the spend cannot be split.

feature:mkt_campaign_perf.title: Campaign revenue and contribution (#166)
feature:mkt_campaign_perf.does: Net sales, discount and contribution of bills tagged with a campaign, next to the campaign spend.
feature:mkt_campaign_perf.why: Untagged sales are never guessed into a campaign, so the share of bills with a tag is always shown.
feature:mkt_campaign_perf.default: Open to report readers; cost columns need the cost right.

feature:mkt_coupons.title: Coupon and offer usage (#168)
feature:mkt_coupons.does: Uses of coupons from the coupon module (CRM-F) when installed, and codes typed on bills.
feature:mkt_coupons.why: No second coupon system exists here.

feature:mkt_discount.title: Discount campaign performance (#167)
feature:mkt_discount.does: Bills with a discount grouped by campaign, next to the average bill without a discount.
feature:mkt_discount.why: Helps see whether discounts go with bigger bills.

feature:mkt_post.title: Post 17-1 to the books
feature:mkt_post.does: Shows each approved 17-1 line and what would happen to it before anything is posted.
feature:mkt_post.why: Prevents counting the same spend twice with form 11-1.
feature:mkt_post.default: Preview always available; posting only when the setting is ON.
feature:mkt_post.who: The accounts manager runs it; the owner winds it down.

feature:mkt_repeat.title: Repeat purchase after a promotion (#170)
feature:mkt_repeat.does: Of the customers who bought on a promotion bill, how many bought again within the days given.
feature:mkt_repeat.why: A window not yet over shows no percentage, only 'so far'.

feature:mkt_roi.title: Marketing ROI (#171)
feature:mkt_roi.does: Contribution of tagged sales against the spend of the same campaign.
feature:mkt_roi.default: Open to report readers; needs the cost right for ROI.

feature:mkt_spend.title: Spend by campaign (#164)
feature:mkt_spend.does: Paid 17-1 amounts by campaign and month, with budget used.
feature:mkt_spend.default: Open to the owner, report_marketing and view_reports.
feature:mkt_spend.who: Read only. Export needs export_data and is logged.

feature:mkt_vs_sales.title: Spend vs sales (#165)
feature:mkt_vs_sales.does: Marketing spend and bill totals of the same day and place, side by side.

feature:money_transfer.title: Transfers between money accounts
feature:money_transfer.does: Moves money from one money account to another as one balanced entry. You can add a fee, which the account you choose bears. You can void a transfer with a reason, and repeat a transfer every month.
feature:money_transfer.why: Money moved between your own accounts is not a sale or an expense.
feature:money_transfer.default: Nothing moves until you enter a transfer.
feature:money_transfer.change: There is no switch. A void adds a linked reversal and never deletes, and the same account on both sides is refused.
feature:money_transfer.who: The owner and people with money rights. The exact grant is not confirmed.

feature:notes_are_kept.title: Notes cannot be edited or deleted
feature:notes_are_kept.does: A note keeps its text, its author and its time. A wrong note is retired with a reason; it disappears from the list but stays in the record.
feature:notes_are_kept.why: A fair history of what was said to a customer.
feature:notes_are_kept.default: Applies as soon as notes are used.
feature:notes_are_kept.change: Not a setting. Retiring needs a reason of at least 3 characters, by the author or the owner.

feature:opening_balance.title: Opening balance
feature:opening_balance.does: Puts what you had on day one into the books: stock, cash, bank, customer dues, supplier dues and capital. It posts as one journal entry. Debit and credit must be equal, or it is refused.
feature:opening_balance.why: Every later figure in the books starts from it.
feature:opening_balance.default: Nothing is posted until you press Save on the Opening tab. A dry run first shows both totals and writes nothing.
feature:opening_balance.change: There is no switch. Only one opening can be posted; later changes need an adjustment with a reason, and past figures never change.
feature:opening_balance.who: The owner, or people with the Accounts manage grant. The stock part also needs the stock opening right.

feature:order_delivery_cost_kinds.title: Kinds of delivery cost
feature:order_delivery_cost_kinds.does: The list used when a delivery cost is written (rider pay, fuel, platform or courier fee, other).
feature:order_delivery_cost_kinds.why: Costs need a kind so the report can group them.
feature:order_delivery_cost_kinds.change: The owner adds kinds through Lists.

feature:owner_board_target_vs.title: Owner board tile: this month's target vs achievement
feature:owner_board_target_vs.does: A widget for the owner board showing the total achievement % of the month against the targets, the pace, and the outlets that are behind.
feature:owner_board_target_vs.default: Not on the board until the owner adds it (Edit board, Add widget). With no target set it says 'Sales target not set'.

feature:paper_list_import.title: Paper list
feature:paper_list_import.does: Records many customers' yes (or no) from a paper list of mobile numbers. You check first; nothing is written until you press Apply. The list needs a name.
feature:paper_list_import.why: Many shops already hold signed forms.
feature:paper_list_import.default: Nothing is imported unless someone does it.
feature:paper_list_import.change: A customer who said no before is never turned back to yes by a list.

feature:party_requests.title: Supplier payment requests
feature:party_requests.does: Purchase, store or any staff member (or the supplier side, entered for them) writes a request to pay a supplier: amount, which bill or due, date needed. The same approver flow decides. The payment is then made through the normal supplier payment, from the money account chosen at that moment.
feature:party_requests.why: A supplier asking at the counter becomes a written request with a decision and a date.
feature:party_requests.change: Settings party_requests_on and party_requests_required (no supplier payment without an approved request), and the approver for supplier requests: the same person as for staff requests, the owner, a role or one named person.
feature:party_requests.who: Any staff with a place can send. The chosen person decides. A payment made together with a purchase bill is not covered.
feature:party_requests.src: phase120.sql (pay_request_submit kind supplier, trigger on supplier_payments)

feature:pay_request_exception.title: Pay without a request, with a reason
feature:pay_request_exception.does: One payment, within 30 minutes, for one person and up to one amount, after the payer writes why. It is written to the Exceptions list as r1_unbacked_payment.
feature:pay_request_exception.why: A real emergency must not be blocked, but it must not be silent.
feature:pay_request_exception.default: The payer may do it with a reason, but only while the policy above is ON.
feature:pay_request_exception.change: Setting pay_request_exception_mode: reason, owner (only the owner) or never.
feature:pay_request_exception.who: Decided by the setting. The owner's one-off override of the money controls (event r1_pay_advance, r1_pay_salary, r1_pay_supplier) also works.

feature:pay_request_limits.title: Request limits
feature:pay_request_limits.does: Caps the number of requests one staff member may send in a month, and the total advance he may hold: open advances, open advance requests and the new one together.
feature:pay_request_limits.why: Stops repeated small requests and advances that grow past what the owner accepts.
feature:pay_request_limits.change: Settings pay_request_max_per_month and pay_request_advance_ceiling. A cancelled request is not counted.
feature:pay_request_limits.who: The owner sets them. The server refuses a request that passes a limit.

feature:pay_request_required.title: No pay without a request (verbal request policy)
feature:pay_request_required.does: When ON, an advance or a salary payment to a staff member is refused unless an approved request, due today or earlier, backs it. The old screens still work: they are accepted when a matching request exists.
feature:pay_request_required.why: Money moves only after a written, approved request, not after a talk.
feature:pay_request_required.default: Off. Payments work exactly as before.
feature:pay_request_required.change: Setting pay_requests_required, with pay_requests_required_kinds (both, advance or salary). A paper-register advance (mode none, no money moves) is not covered.
feature:pay_request_required.who: The owner switches it on. It applies to everyone who pays.

feature:pay_requests.title: Pay requests (salary and advance)
feature:pay_requests.does: A staff member writes a request in the app: amount, reason and the date he needs it. One person decides. He shows the staff member received, approved with a pay date, a different date, rejected with a reason, or paid.
feature:pay_requests.why: Nobody has to come in person and tell a story to ask for money.
feature:pay_requests.default: Off. Nothing changes until the owner switches it on.
feature:pay_requests.change: Setting pay_requests_on. The person who decides is set on the Pay request settings page: the owner, a role, or one named person.
feature:pay_requests.who: Any staff member linked to an employee record sends. The chosen person decides. The person who asks never decides or pays his own request.

feature:payment_source.title: Payment source
feature:payment_source.does: Lets you pick which money account a payment comes from: cash drawer, wallet or bank. The journal, statements and reports follow that account.
feature:payment_source.why: The owner may pay from a different source each time, and the books should match.
feature:payment_source.default: No default source and no source required. A payment with no account posts as before.
feature:payment_source.change: For each event type the owner can set a default source, stop a different pick, or require a source. Without a source, a required payment is refused.
feature:payment_source.who: The owner sets the defaults. A one-off exception needs an owner grant with a reason.

feature:pl_by_month_outlet.title: P&L by month and outlet (from the journal)
feature:pl_by_month_outlet.does: Income, cost of goods, other expenses, gross and net profit from the books, with a column for each month and a row for each outlet; tap a cell for the accounts and entries behind it.
feature:pl_by_month_outlet.why: The books showed one period and one place at a time, and the management profit report is a different calculation.
feature:pl_by_month_outlet.default: Open to the owner, accounts view or manage, and the profit report right. Needs the accounting start date, otherwise it says 'accounting module not switched on - no data captured'.
feature:pl_by_month_outlet.change: Read only. Year-end closing journals are left out.
feature:pl_by_month_outlet.who: Anyone with the profit report right or accounts rights; the CSV also needs the export right.

feature:points_expiry.title: Points expiry
feature:points_expiry.does: Preview, then apply: points earned before the cut date and not yet spent or expired are removed once.
feature:points_expiry.default: Off until months and a start date are set.
feature:points_expiry.change: Applying writes expire lines in the points history and an audit line. A second apply the same day finds nothing.
feature:points_expiry.who: The owner, or a person with the loyalty manage right. A customer-manage holder can preview only.

feature:points_statement.title: Points statement
feature:points_statement.does: One customer's points: opening balance, every line with a running balance, closing balance.
feature:points_statement.default: Always available to staff who can see customers.

feature:possible_duplicates.title: Duplicate customers
feature:possible_duplicates.does: Shows pairs that may be the same person, with the reason (same phone, same name, same address, same birthday) and how likely it is. For each pair you can say 'Same person' or 'Not the same'.
feature:possible_duplicates.why: One person under two numbers splits their points, tier and history.
feature:possible_duplicates.change: 'Not the same' hides the pair from the list; you can bring it back.
feature:possible_duplicates.who: Everyone who can see it can look; only people with the 'link two customers' right can decide.

feature:privacy.title: Phone numbers in customer lists
feature:privacy.does: When the privacy guard is on, people without the right 'See full phone numbers and addresses in customer lists' see a hidden number such as 017******78.
feature:privacy.why: A list of phone numbers is valuable.
feature:privacy.default: Follows the privacy guard; if the privacy package is not installed, numbers show as they do today
feature:privacy.change: Turning the guard on hides numbers in these lists and exports for people without the right. The full number never travels to a hidden screen.

feature:prod_real_use.title: Real use of ingredients (blind entry)
feature:prod_real_use.does: For a finished run you type the quantity of each ingredient really used. The recipe quantity of a line is shown only after you saved your own.
feature:prod_real_use.why: The recipe quantity is what the production screen booked; the report real-use-vs-recipe and the usage variance need what was really used.
feature:prod_real_use.default: Empty. A run without a record is 'not captured' and is left out of every total.
feature:prod_real_use.change: The reports consumption, cost variance and the price/usage/yield split can then be worked out for that run. Stock is not moved: an extra use is a record, to be corrected through the stock count if wanted.
feature:prod_real_use.who: The owner and holders of stock_production.

feature:prodplan.title: Production: plan, orders & runs
feature:prodplan.does: Digital entry screens: a plan line per day, place and item; production orders with a due day; and, for each finished run, the real use of ingredients, reject / rework with a reason, the labour hours, the line, and the plan or order it belongs to.
feature:prodplan.why: These are the figures the plan-vs-actual, real-use, loss, labour and order reports need.
feature:prodplan.default: Always available to the owner and to holders of the production grant (stock_production). Nothing is required; a run without these records simply shows 'data not captured' in the reports.
feature:prodplan.change: Nothing moves stock or money. The production screen booked the recipe quantity; these records say what really happened.
feature:prodplan.who: The owner and holders of stock_production (orders can also be raised by the outlet's stock-transfer staff).

feature:prodreports.title: Production reports
feature:prodreports.does: Eight read-only reports: plan vs actual, order status and pending orders, made-sent-received-in transit-short, standard vs actual cost with the price/usage/yield split, real use against the recipe, run-level yield, reject and rework, wastage by batch and run. Each has a CSV and every row opens its source.
feature:prodreports.why: Answers whether plans were met, where material and yield were lost and what the batch really cost.
feature:prodreports.default: Open to the owner, holders of the stock report right and the people who may read recipes or production, for their own places. Money columns need the cost right.
feature:prodreports.change: Nothing changes; it only reads. A figure that was never captured is shown as 'data not captured: <field>', never 0 and never an estimate.

feature:production_crew.title: Crew and hours on a production run
feature:production_crew.does: The workers and the hours each worked on one production run, picked from the staff list.
feature:production_crew.why: Output per worker hour needs hours; the run had no worker or time.
feature:production_crew.default: Optional box on the production sheet.
feature:production_crew.change: Runs with a crew feed 'Output per labour hour'; runs without are counted apart.
feature:production_crew.who: Owner or the stock_production right at that place.

feature:production_labour.title: Labour hours of a run
feature:production_labour.does: Records how many people worked on a run and for how many hours each (more than one crew = more than one line).
feature:production_labour.why: Attendance exists only at day level; output per labour hour needs the hours of the run.
feature:production_labour.default: Empty. A run with no entry is 'labour not captured'.
feature:production_labour.change: Nothing; it is a record. A wrong line is voided with a reason, never deleted.
feature:production_labour.who: The owner and holders of stock_production.

feature:production_loss.title: Reject and rework
feature:production_loss.does: A record per run: reject or rework quantity with a reason from the existing wastage-reason list, or 'checked, none'.
feature:production_loss.why: Without 'checked, none' a run with no record cannot be told from a run with no loss.
feature:production_loss.default: Empty. A run with no record is 'not captured'.
feature:production_loss.change: Nothing moves in stock: the output of the run stays as booked. Stock written off is recorded through the existing wastage screen.
feature:production_loss.who: The owner and holders of stock_production.

feature:production_order_link.title: Order on a production run
feature:production_order_link.does: Links a production run to an app order (with the quantity for that order).
feature:production_order_link.why: Order-wise production cost needs to know which order a run was for.
feature:production_order_link.default: Optional box on the production sheet.
feature:production_order_link.change: The run cost is split by quantity across its orders.
feature:production_order_link.who: Owner, the stock_production right at the place, or a person who enters online orders at the order's place.

feature:promised_slot.title: Promised time slot on an app order
feature:promised_slot.does: From and to time of the promised delivery on the delivery day.
feature:promised_slot.why: On-time delivery cannot be measured from a date alone.
feature:promised_slot.default: Optional box. Required only if the switch above is on.
feature:promised_slot.change: A change needs a reason and keeps the earlier slot in the trail.
feature:promised_slot.who: Anyone who may enter online orders.

feature:purchasing_reports.title: Purchasing reports
feature:purchasing_reports.does: Returns and adjustments, price variance, rejection rate, supplier dependency, delivery performance.
feature:purchasing_reports.default: Always available to who may read purchase reports.
feature:purchasing_reports.change: Read only. Money shown only with the cost right.
feature:purchasing_reports.who: Anyone with the purchase report right.

feature:quality_checks.title: Quality check with item, quantity, supplier
feature:quality_checks.does: A quality check can name the item, the quantity checked or rejected and the supplier.
feature:quality_checks.why: Needed for the supplier rejection rate.
feature:quality_checks.default: Optional. Old checks stay blank and say 'data not captured'.
feature:quality_checks.change: Filters by item and supplier appear on the list.

feature:r138.title: Credit risk and overdue (#138)
feature:r138.does: Customers who owe, aged oldest-first by the same rule as the dues list, against their credit days.
feature:r138.why: Only age buckets existed, with no due date.
feature:r138.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r138.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r138.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r139.title: Customer lifetime value (#139)
feature:r139.does: Orders and revenue over all time (no 365-day cap), returns, first and last sale; margin only where cost is known.
feature:r139.why: The hub report refuses ranges over 365 days.
feature:r139.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r139.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r139.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r140.title: Returns and complaints per customer (#140)
feature:r140.does: Sale returns and 32-1 complaint sheets matched by phone; sheets that cannot be matched are counted apart.
feature:r140.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r140.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r140.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r141.title: Special order history (#141)
feature:r141.does: Cake and custom orders per customer with flavours, birthday and anniversary as entered.
feature:r141.why: No link from order to customer.
feature:r141.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r141.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r141.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r142.title: Attendance summary for a period (#142)
feature:r142.does: Days by status, late, worked and overtime per person from the app day records; days with no record counted apart.
feature:r142.why: The hub report read paper only and showed nothing.
feature:r142.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r142.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r142.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r147.title: Overtime and late variance (#147)
feature:r147.does: Worked time against the shift and overtime waiting for approval; only days with a shift are compared.
feature:r147.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r147.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r147.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r148.title: Sales per labour hour (#148)
feature:r148.does: Sales against labour hours with the punch coverage; a figure appears only where hours exist.
feature:r148.why: Hours and sales were never joined.
feature:r148.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r148.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r148.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r149.title: Output per labour hour (#149)
feature:r149.does: Finished goods per crew hour over runs with a crew; coverage shown.
feature:r149.why: Runs had no crew or hours.
feature:r149.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r149.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r149.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r150.title: Cashier cash variance (#150)
feature:r150.does: Cash short and over by cashier and shift from form 06-1, with the decision on each shortage case.
feature:r150.why: Variance could only be tied to the sheet writer.
feature:r150.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r150.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r150.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r153.title: Order register (#153)
feature:r153.does: Every order in one list: app orders, paper 05-1 sheets and paper 23-1 ledger lines, each with its source. Never merged.
feature:r153.why: Before this the paper report showed nothing for app orders and the app list ignored paper.
feature:r153.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r153.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r153.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r155.title: Cake order register (#155)
feature:r155.does: Cake and custom orders with weight, flavour, message and design, beside the paper custom sheets.
feature:r155.why: Cake facts were only free text.
feature:r155.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r155.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r155.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r156.title: Advance and outstanding balances (#156)
feature:r156.does: Advances held and what is still to collect. A delivered order is not shown as owed unless its sale really has an amount left.
feature:r156.why: The old list showed delivered orders as owing their advance-reduced total.
feature:r156.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r156.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r156.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r157.title: Cancellations and refunds (#157)
feature:r157.does: Cancelled orders with the reason and where the advance stands, and the refund records.
feature:r157.why: A refund could be chosen and never paid.
feature:r157.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r157.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r157.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r158.title: On-time delivery (#158)
feature:r158.does: Share of delivered app orders that arrived by their promised slot, with the basis (slot or day only).
feature:r158.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r158.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r158.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r159.title: Delayed and undelivered orders (#159)
feature:r159.does: Open orders whose promised time has passed. Orders with no promised date are counted apart, not judged.
feature:r159.why: Late orders were found by hand.
feature:r159.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r159.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r159.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r160.title: Order production cost (#160)
feature:r160.does: The share of each linked production run's cost that belongs to an order.
feature:r160.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r160.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r160.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r161.title: Order profit (#161)
feature:r161.does: Sale value less goods cost less delivery cost, only where every cost is known.
feature:r161.why: Never shown as a profit when a cost is missing.
feature:r161.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r161.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r161.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r162.title: Delivery cost (#162)
feature:r162.does: What the customer paid for delivery against the cost written. Orders with no cost written are counted apart.
feature:r162.why: Only the customer's charge was known.
feature:r162.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r162.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r162.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:r163.title: Order fulfilment rate (#163)
feature:r163.does: Delivered, cancelled and still open of the orders taken, per source.
feature:r163.why: Open orders are not counted as failures.
feature:r163.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:r163.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:r163.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:recall.title: Recall case
feature:recall.does: Records a recall: the batches under recall, what was done with each, and prints the affected-stock report.
feature:recall.why: A recall needs one list of everything affected, and a record that it was handled.
feature:recall.default: No case exists until someone opens one.
feature:recall.change: Opening a case writes a red line in Exceptions. Holding, returning or writing off is done with the existing screens.
feature:recall.who: The owner or the recall_manage right.

feature:recipe_cost_gaps.title: Materials with no cost (Costing screen)
feature:recipe_cost_gaps.does: A list on the Costing screen of ingredients and packaging used by active recipes that have no cost under the chosen cost method, with a CSV.
feature:recipe_cost_gaps.why: A recipe cost with a missing material is incomplete, not zero.
feature:recipe_cost_gaps.default: Shown automatically to people who may see costs of the place.
feature:recipe_cost_gaps.who: Anyone with the cost right of the place; the CSV also needs the export right.

feature:referral.title: Referral
feature:referral.does: A code per customer, a link for a new customer, and a one-time reward.
feature:referral.change: See the Referral tab. The reward is taken back if the first sale is voided.
feature:referral.who: Staff at the till can link a new customer. The owner or loyalty manage right can reject a referral with a reason.

feature:refresh_scores.title: Refresh scores
feature:refresh_scores.does: Works out each customer's last visit, orders, spending, amount owed, points, usual outlet and top three items from the sales you already have, and keeps the result so screens are fast.
feature:refresh_scores.why: Lists and labels use these numbers.
feature:refresh_scores.default: Runs only when someone presses the button (or when the owner switches the automatic refresh on)
feature:refresh_scores.change: It only copies figures; it never changes a sale, a payment, a return or the books. If more customers need a score than the batch size, press again.
feature:refresh_scores.who: Anyone with the right 'Save customer lists and refresh customer scores', the customer manager, or the owner can press it.

feature:report_daily_closing.title: Closing stock vs next-day sales and loss
feature:report_daily_closing.does: Closing stock of each day (ledger replayed by business day) beside what was sold and lost on the next day. Today has no next day yet: those cells are empty.

feature:report_expiry_soon.title: Expired and expiring soon
feature:report_expiry_soon.does: One list for expiry. 'Soon' uses the rule report_expiry_soon_days if the owner set it, otherwise the existing rule expiry_warn_days; the notice names which. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: shelf_life_rules / stock_batches.expires_at".

feature:report_item_slow.title: Slow and non-moving items
feature:report_item_slow.does: Old columns unchanged; added refunds, net quantity, net after refunds, stock on hand, its value, last movement and a state (not moving, no net sales, sold). No limit is used to call an item slow. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: unit cost".

feature:report_item_turnover.title: Turnover and days on hand
feature:report_item_turnover.does: Used (sold net + issued to production) / average of the daily book stock. Days on hand = average stock x days / used. Empty where nothing was used or the average stock is not above 0.

feature:report_k2_count_variance.title: Stock count variance
feature:report_k2_count_variance.does: Counts from the paper sheet 36-1 and counts typed in the app. The app writes a line only when the count differs, so for those rows the number of counts and the off % are not captured. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: number of counts (app), avg_cost".

feature:report_notices.title: Basis lines under the hub reports
feature:report_notices.does: Under a hub report the screen shows short notices: the profit reports say they are the management view (with a link to Profit check) and what is missing; the sales reports show a returns line; the expense reports say which of the three expense totals they are; the staff, compliance, customer segment, lapsed and cash short reports say where their numbers come from.
feature:report_notices.why: The same word 'profit', 'expenses' or 'sales' meant different things in different reports.
feature:report_notices.default: Shown automatically when the database has phase 440; nothing shown otherwise.
feature:report_notices.change: Nothing changes in a figure. The notices are also at the end of every CSV of that report.
feature:report_notices.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:report_p4_supplier_score.title: Supplier scorecard
feature:report_p4_supplier_score.does: Per supplier: posted purchase bills, purchase returns (amount and % of bills), quality checks held or rejected, plus the paper-form legs (goods received 13-1, bill check 02-1, purchase orders 27-1). A leg that was never captured in the period is empty and its form code is named; it is not 0. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: 13-1, 02-1, 27-1, qc_records".

feature:report_parity.title: Report parity
feature:report_parity.does: Checks if salary and expense totals agree between the day book, the profit report, the expense report and the journal for the same days. A difference is listed by cause.
feature:report_parity.why: Different totals for the same cost make every report doubtful.
feature:report_parity.change: There is no switch. Three settings bring the reports to one rule: expense_count_on, report_expense_parity_on and report_salary_source.
feature:report_parity.who: People with Accounts view or Accounts manage.

feature:report_reports_map.title: Reports map
feature:report_reports_map.does: Lists the 14 sections of the report master list: the state of every report and one link to open it. Static list from the audits.
feature:report_reports_map.why: One place to see what exists, what is incomplete and what is missing.
feature:report_reports_map.change: Open to the roles that already hold the report group right. Read-only.
feature:report_reports_map.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:report_stock_adjustments.title: Stock adjustment history
feature:report_stock_adjustments.does: Each count adjustment: book quantity, counted quantity, difference, who, why, value and the basis of the value (booked cost, average cost now, or no cost recorded). Missing data is shown as "data not captured: unit cost".

feature:report_stock_balance.title: Stock levels and value
feature:report_stock_balance.does: Book balance of every item at every place. Value = quantity x weighted average cost. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: avg_cost (unit cost on purchase line / opening / production)".

feature:report_stock_integrity.title: Negative stock and integrity
feature:report_stock_integrity.does: Negative balances (sold beyond stock, with the date it went negative and the part posted with no batch), cached balances that differ from the ledger, and batches that hold more than the balance. The owner repairs the cache on the stock screen after typing FIX.

feature:report_supplier_ageing.title: Supplier payables ageing
feature:report_supplier_ageing.does: Open payables by supplier. 00. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: suppliers.credit_days, rule report_aging_buckets".

feature:report_transfers_register.title: All transfers
feature:report_transfers_register.does: Every transfer of the period: sent, received in full, received short, still on the road, cancelled, with the shortage claim state. 'Transfers not received or short' remains the exceptions-only view. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: shortage_transit.value (cost at send)".

feature:report_wastage_rate.title: Wastage % of stock handled
feature:report_wastage_rate.does: Wastage quantity / (stock at the start + goods received in the period). Both parts are shown. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: denominator (nothing held or received), ledger unit cost".

feature:report_y1_daily_sellout.title: Daily sell-out / unsold at closing
feature:report_y1_daily_sellout.does: Per day, outlet and item: opening, produced, received, returned, sold, wasted, sent, other, what is left at closing, sell-through % and the cost of the wastage. Tap a row for the stock movements behind it.
feature:report_y1_daily_sellout.why: Answers a question a sweets business asks and no existing report answers.
feature:report_y1_daily_sellout.change: Open to the roles that already hold the report group right. Read-only.
feature:report_y1_daily_sellout.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:report_y2_festival_compare.title: Festival / season comparison
feature:report_y2_festival_compare.does: The same items over the chosen dates against the same dates one year earlier (or other dates in "Compare with"). Says "no previous data" when nothing was sold then. Tap a row for the sales.
feature:report_y2_festival_compare.why: Answers a question a sweets business asks and no existing report answers.
feature:report_y2_festival_compare.change: Open to the roles that already hold the report group right. Read-only.
feature:report_y2_festival_compare.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:report_y3_customer_items.title: What the top customers buy
feature:report_y3_customer_items.does: The top customers by sales (after returns) and their items. Walk-in sales without a customer are counted and named. Tap a row for the sales.
feature:report_y3_customer_items.why: Answers a question a sweets business asks and no existing report answers.
feature:report_y3_customer_items.change: Open to the roles that already hold the report group right. Read-only.
feature:report_y3_customer_items.who: Anyone who may open the report.

feature:return_restock.title: Return restock rules
feature:return_restock.does: For each item class you can say if returned goods go back on the shelf or are written off. The cashier can also choose. Goods written off go to wastage at the sale cost.
feature:return_restock.why: A returned perishable item should not be sold again by FEFO.
feature:return_restock.default: No class rule. All returned goods go back on the shelf, as today.
feature:return_restock.change: A class can start on a set date. A return that wrote goods off cannot be voided; use a stock adjustment instead.
feature:return_restock.who: The owner sets the class rules.

feature:rpt_hub_compare.title: What changed
feature:rpt_hub_compare.does: Puts two periods side by side (this month and last month, for example) with the change, the percent and the outlets that moved most. Tap a figure to see the transactions behind it.
feature:rpt_hub_compare.why: It answers 'why did this number change' with real transactions, not a guess.
feature:rpt_hub_compare.default: Available; figures you may not see are left out and named

feature:rpt_hub_day.title: Day replay
feature:rpt_hub_day.does: Shows, in time order, everything recorded on one date (optionally one outlet): sales, voids, returns, collections, expenses, purchases, production, transfers, wastage, counts, cash short, approvals, exceptions, period locks, staff exits. Each line says when, who, how much, and opens the record.
feature:rpt_hub_day.why: When you wonder what happened on a day, you can read it like a story instead of opening ten reports.
feature:rpt_hub_day.default: Always available to signed-in people; each kind of line appears only if you hold the matching report right
feature:rpt_hub_day.change: Nothing to switch. The sales figures are compared with the daily summary; if they differ the page says so and shows both numbers.
feature:rpt_hub_day.who: Nobody changes it. It only reads.

feature:rpt_hub_entity.title: Timeline of one thing
feature:rpt_hub_entity.does: Every event for one item, customer, supplier, staff member, outlet or batch in a date range, with a running quantity (item, batch) or running balance (customer, supplier).
feature:rpt_hub_entity.why: You can see how a balance or a stock figure got to where it is.
feature:rpt_hub_entity.default: Available; limited by your rights and your outlets

feature:rpt_hub_my.title: Favourites, recently opened, saved views
feature:rpt_hub_my.does: Each person can star reports, see the ones opened lately and save a named view of any hub tool. Only you see your own list.
feature:rpt_hub_my.why: Your usual questions are one tap away.
feature:rpt_hub_my.who: Each person, for their own list.

feature:rpt_hub_spend.title: Spend finder and question box
feature:rpt_hub_spend.does: Finds money spent by person, place, head (for example staff meals, electricity), memo words, account, payment source and period. Shows the total, month by month, and every source transaction. You can type the question in Bangla or English; the page always shows what it understood as editable chips and never guesses a number.
feature:rpt_hub_spend.why: Answers questions like 'what did one branch pay for electricity in the last 8 months' from the real records.
feature:rpt_hub_spend.default: Available; staff pay, advances, meals and labour rows need the payroll right
feature:rpt_hub_spend.change: Nothing to switch. If an expense does not say which person it was for, it is counted apart as 'not linked to a person' and the missing field is named; nothing is guessed.

feature:rpt_hub_trail.title: Record trail
feature:rpt_hub_trail.does: For one record: who created it, posted it, changed or voided it, what the stock and the books did about it, which exceptions it raised. Anything the system did not record is listed as 'not recorded'.
feature:rpt_hub_trail.why: Shows who did what without anyone having to remember.
feature:rpt_hub_trail.default: Available; the audit log lines are shown to the owner only

feature:safe_rules.title: Safe rule builder
feature:safe_rules.does: Only a fixed set of questions can be asked about customers, with a fixed set of comparisons. Anything else is refused.
feature:safe_rules.why: Nobody can type a command that reads or changes other data.
feature:safe_rules.who: Nobody; it is part of the system.

feature:salary.title: Salary basis notice
