feature:salary.does: Which salary figure the staff-cost and profit reports use, beside the 21-1 sheets and the payroll runs. Changes nothing.
feature:salary.why: The two sources differ and nothing said which one a report used.
feature:salary.default: Open to the owner and to holders of the existing report rights; only the places the person may see.
feature:salary.change: Reading changes nothing. A missing figure shows as 'not captured', never as 0.
feature:salary.who: Nobody changes it; it is a report.

feature:screen_crmleads.title: Party and gift enquiries
feature:screen_crmleads.does: The board of enquiries by stage (Enquiry, Quoted, Following up, Won, Lost), the enquiry sheet with notes, quotes and history, the win and loss report, and the three lists.
feature:screen_crmleads.why: It is the one place where a big order is followed from the first question to the delivered cake.
feature:screen_crmleads.default: Visible, but it says that tracking is switched off until the owner switches it on.
feature:screen_crmleads.change: Turning enquiry tracking on makes the board work. Nothing starts by itself.
feature:screen_crmleads.who: Only the owner switches it on.

feature:screen_crmtasks.title: My tasks
feature:screen_crmtasks.does: Overdue tasks first, then due today, later and snoozed. Done, snooze or skip with one tap.
feature:screen_crmtasks.why: It is the staff member's daily to-do list for customers and orders.
feature:screen_crmtasks.default: Visible, but it says that tasks are switched off until the owner switches them on.
feature:screen_crmtasks.change: Turning tasks on makes the list work.
feature:screen_crmtasks.who: Only the owner switches it on.

feature:shelf_life_missing.title: Shelf life not set notice
feature:shelf_life_missing.does: Lists made products that have no shelf-life rule.
feature:shelf_life_missing.why: Their batches get no expiry, so expiry lists say nothing about them.
feature:shelf_life_missing.change: Set the rule in Settings > Shelf life.

feature:shift_report.title: Roster versus attendance report
feature:shift_report.does: Compares each rostered day with what attendance recorded: present, late, absent, leave, no record, or worked on an off-day. It only reads attendance and writes nothing.
feature:shift_report.why: The owner sees where the plan and the real day differ.
feature:shift_report.default: Visible to schedulers once shift_on is on. Without attendance data the screen says there is nothing to compare.
feature:shift_report.change: There is no switch of its own. It never changes attendance, leave or payroll.
feature:shift_report.who: The owner, and people holding shift_manage or attendance_manage for the place.

feature:soft_link.title: Same person (link)
feature:soft_link.does: Marks one customer as the same person as another. Their ids do not change. The customer list can show them as one, and a 'no' or 'do not contact' on one number protects the other number.
feature:soft_link.why: Sales, payments and dues are tied to the customer id in the books, so the two customers are never merged into one record.
feature:soft_link.change: Dues, payments and balances stay on each customer. Only spend, orders, last purchase and points are added up for display.
feature:soft_link.who: The owner and people given 'Link two customers as the same person'.

feature:stockout.title: Stockout log
feature:stockout.does: A simple shop entry: date, place, item, note, optional estimate of missed quantity.
feature:stockout.why: Shows what customers asked for and the shop did not have.
feature:stockout.change: Nothing changes in stock or money. A blank estimate is never added as 0.
feature:stockout.who: The owner or the stockout_log right.

feature:stockrep_ledger.title: Stock movement ledger
feature:stockrep_ledger.does: One item at one place: opening, every movement with its running balance, closing, the check against the cached balance, and the source document of each row (tap a row). Missing data is shown as "data not captured: unit cost".

feature:stockrep_recon.title: Stock reconciliation for a period
feature:stockrep_recon.does: Opening (ledger replay) + received - issued = closing for every item and place, with transfers on the road, transfers received short, and a check against the cached balance. Missing data is shown as "data not captured: shortage cost".

feature:target_report.title: Target vs achievement
feature:target_report.does: Per place and month: the owner's target, the net sales so far (after returns, like the dashboard), the pace, the shortfall, and the gross-profit % against its target when the reader has the cost right.
feature:target_report.why: Shows early which outlet is behind, instead of at month end.
feature:target_report.default: A place with no target says 'target not set' and still shows its sales.
feature:target_report.change: Nothing; read only. The owner board has a tile with the same figures.
feature:target_report.who: Anyone with the sales report right, for their own places.

feature:trace.title: Trace a batch
feature:trace.does: Follows a batch from the supplier lot through production, transfers and sales to the outlets and named customers, and back.
feature:trace.why: Answers 'where did this lot go' in minutes.
feature:trace.default: Always available to who may read stock or quality reports.
feature:trace.who: Anyone with the stock or quality report right.

feature:transfer_damage.title: Damaged quantity on transfer receive
feature:transfer_damage.does: The receiver can write how much of what arrived is damaged and why.
feature:transfer_damage.why: Separates damage from a short count.
feature:transfer_damage.change: A yellow line appears in Exceptions. Stock is not changed: write damaged goods off with the wastage screen.

feature:working_capital.title: Working capital
feature:working_capital.does: Current assets minus current liabilities by the class the owner gave each account, and the plain formula cash + customer receivables + inventory - supplier payables.
feature:working_capital.why: There was no working capital figure.
feature:working_capital.default: If no account is classed current, the class figure says 'Not captured' and never 0; the formula still shows.
feature:working_capital.who: Anyone with the profit report right or accounts rights.

feature:x1_gate.title: The gate for outside and AI calls
feature:x1_gate.does: Every outside call, AI call and automated write asks one gate first. The gate checks, in order: automation ON, not paused, the connection ON and configured, read-only, do-not-contact for the customer, the monthly call cap, the calls per minute, and dry run. The reason for every answer is logged.
feature:x1_gate.why: Nothing is sent to a customer who asked not to be contacted, nothing runs over budget, and nothing writes while the owner is only testing.
feature:x1_gate.default: Denies everything until automation is ON, the connection is ON and a monthly cap is set.
feature:x1_gate.change: The switches and caps on the Connect Center and in the Switchboard.
feature:x1_gate.who: Used by the scheduled jobs and by the approved agents. Staff cannot call it.

grant:announce_post.title: Post announcements and instructions
grant:announce_post.does: Lets a person or a role post an announcement. A right without a place can post to everyone, a role, a place or one person. A right limited to one place can post only to that place.
grant:announce_post.why: The owner decides who may speak to the staff, not only himself.
grant:announce_post.default: Nobody holds it. Only the owner can post until he gives it.
grant:announce_post.change: Give it on the Delegation board to a role or to one person, with or without a place. Taking it away stops new posts but keeps the old ones.
grant:announce_post.who: The owner gives and takes the right.
grant:announce_post.src: phase130.sql (announce_post, r2_announce_post); phase130_test.sql T2, T7, T8

grant:backdate_over_limit.title: Go over the back-date limit
grant:backdate_over_limit.does: Lets a person save a record dated further back than the back-date limit.
grant:backdate_over_limit.change: Each use is logged. A one-off owner grant or an override window also works.

grant:cake_price_manage.title: Change the cake price list
grant:cake_price_manage.does: Lets a person change the base price per kg, the flavour prices and the design extras.
grant:cake_price_manage.why: Prices change with the market; only a trusted person should change them.
grant:cake_price_manage.default: Nobody holds it. Only the owner can change the list.
grant:cake_price_manage.change: The holder can save a price; the quote uses the new price for every cake made after the save.

grant:capacity_manage.title: Set production lines and rated capacity
grant:capacity_manage.does: Lets a role or person add production lines and set the rated capacity (batches a day, working days a week) of a place or line.
grant:capacity_manage.why: The capacity-utilization report is only as good as the rating behind it.
grant:capacity_manage.default: Held by nobody but the owner.
grant:capacity_manage.change: The holder sees the set-up tab on Labour & capacity and may change it for his own places.

grant:closed_period_edit.title: Enter or change something in a closed period
grant:closed_period_edit.does: Lets a person enter or change a record dated in a closed period.
grant:closed_period_edit.why: Sometimes a closed month needs a fix.
grant:closed_period_edit.default: Nobody has it except the owner.
grant:closed_period_edit.change: It is a window grant. An approved emergency request can give it for a short time.

grant:crm_complaint_log.title: Log a customer complaint or rating
grant:crm_complaint_log.does: Lets a person log a complaint or a rating at the outlets given to them. Staff who already may enter sales at an outlet can do this without the grant.
grant:crm_complaint_log.why: The person at the counter hears the complaint first.
grant:crm_complaint_log.default: Given to nobody. The owner always has it.
grant:crm_complaint_log.change: The person can log at their own outlets only. They see only what they logged themselves or what is assigned to them, with the phone number hidden.
grant:crm_complaint_log.who: Only the owner, on the user rights page.

grant:crm_complaint_manage.title: Assign, resolve and close customer complaints
grant:crm_complaint_manage.does: Lets a person assign an owner, add notes and calls, change severity, resolve, close, close without a result, reopen, link a finished return, and run the overdue check, at their own outlets.
grant:crm_complaint_manage.why: Closing a complaint should be a decision by a responsible person, not by whoever logged it.
grant:crm_complaint_manage.default: Given to nobody. The owner always has it.
grant:crm_complaint_manage.change: The person sees the full phone number and every complaint at their own outlets.
grant:crm_complaint_manage.who: Only the owner, on the user rights page.

grant:crm_contact_view.title: See full customer phone and address
grant:crm_contact_view.does: Lets a person see full phone numbers and addresses even when hiding is ON.
grant:crm_contact_view.why: Delivery and accounts staff may need the real number while counter staff do not.
grant:crm_contact_view.default: Nobody has it until the owner gives it. The owner always can, and so can anyone who already sees mobile numbers in reports.
grant:crm_contact_view.change: Given: the person sees full numbers. It has no effect while hiding is OFF.

grant:crm_export.title: Export the customer list
grant:crm_export.does: Lets a person export (and, if the setting asks, print) customer lists.
grant:crm_export.why: Exports are the easiest way to lose a customer book.
grant:crm_export.default: Nobody has it until the owner gives it. The owner always may.
grant:crm_export.change: Given: the person can export once export is switched on and a row cap is set; each export needs a reason and is logged.

grant:crm_feedback_view.title: See customer complaint and rating lists and reports
grant:crm_feedback_view.does: Lets a person read the complaint list, the rating list, the repeat customers list and the report for their own outlets. It lets them change nothing.
grant:crm_feedback_view.why: A buyer or an area head may need the numbers without being able to close complaints.
grant:crm_feedback_view.default: Given to nobody. The owner always has it.
grant:crm_feedback_view.change: The person sees the lists and reports for their own outlets with the phone number hidden.
grant:crm_feedback_view.who: Only the owner, on the user rights page.

grant:crm_lead_all.title: See and work on the enquiries of every outlet
grant:crm_lead_all.does: Removes the outlet limit: the person sees and works on enquiries of all outlets.
grant:crm_lead_all.why: A showroom manager should see only their own outlet's enquiries.
grant:crm_lead_all.default: Given to nobody. Only the owner has it.
grant:crm_lead_all.change: Given to a person: they see every outlet's enquiries and the report for all outlets.
grant:crm_lead_all.who: Only the owner, under Roles and permissions.

grant:crm_lead_manage.title: Manage enquiries of my outlets
grant:crm_lead_manage.does: Lets a person see every enquiry of the outlets they work at, give an enquiry to someone, close one as lost, reopen one, and turn a won one into an order or form.
grant:crm_lead_manage.default: Given to nobody. Only the owner has it.
grant:crm_lead_manage.change: Given to a role or a person: they get these powers inside their own outlets only.
grant:crm_lead_manage.who: Only the owner, under Roles and permissions.

grant:crm_task_all.title: See the tasks of every person
grant:crm_task_all.does: Lets a person see all tasks in the Team view of My tasks.
grant:crm_task_all.why: A supervisor needs to see what is overdue across the team.
grant:crm_task_all.default: Given to nobody. Only the owner has it.
grant:crm_task_all.change: Given to a person: the Team view shows every task.
grant:crm_task_all.who: Only the owner, under Roles and permissions.

grant:crm_task_assign.title: Give tasks to other people
grant:crm_task_assign.does: Lets a person add a task for a colleague.
grant:crm_task_assign.why: A task with a named person is done; a task for everybody is not.
grant:crm_task_assign.default: Given to nobody. Only the owner has it.
grant:crm_task_assign.change: Given to a person: they can choose who a task goes to, among people who work at the same outlet.
grant:crm_task_assign.who: Only the owner, under Roles and permissions.

grant:crm_view.title: See customer notes, messages and the full timeline
grant:crm_view.does: Lets a person read and write notes on a customer, see the messages sent to them and their enquiries, and see who has a birthday or anniversary coming.
grant:crm_view.why: Notes and messages can be private.
grant:crm_view.default: Nobody has it until the owner gives it. The owner always can.
grant:crm_view.change: Given: the person sees the Notes tab and the message and enquiry lines in the timeline. Taken away: they disappear at once; the notes themselves are kept.

grant:exit_keep_access.title: Keep a login after the person has left
grant:exit_keep_access.does: Lets a person keep the login of someone who has left, for one case.
grant:exit_keep_access.why: Sometimes a person must keep access for a short time.
grant:exit_keep_access.default: Nobody has it except the owner.
grant:exit_keep_access.change: It needs a reason. It writes an audit line and a yellow Exceptions row.

grant:late_sale_release.title: Decide a held late sale
grant:late_sale_release.does: Lets a person accept, re-date or reject a late sale held by the park policy.
grant:late_sale_release.why: Someone must decide each held sale.
grant:late_sale_release.change: The maker cannot decide the same sale unless the maker is the owner and owner self approve is ON.

grant:market_manage.title: Add topics, sources, findings, prices and opportunities, and decide them
grant:market_manage.does: Lets a person add research, record opportunities and move them through their statuses (each move needs a reason).
grant:market_manage.why: The person who asks for an opportunity can not approve it themselves, so a decision always has a second person behind it.
grant:market_manage.default: Given to nobody. Only the owner has it.
grant:market_manage.change: The person can add and change research and opportunities, and create tasks from approved work. They can not set scraping permissions, link a provider or schedule jobs.
grant:market_manage.who: Only the owner. Every change is written to the change log.

grant:market_view.title: See the market intelligence workspace
grant:market_view.does: Lets a person read the findings, prices, opportunities and growth figures on the Market page.
grant:market_view.why: Market notes can be sensitive (competitor prices, plans).
grant:market_view.default: Given to nobody. Only the owner has it.
grant:market_view.change: The person sees the Market page and its figures, but can not add or decide anything. Sales figures on the page still follow their places.
grant:market_view.who: Only the owner. Every change is written to the change log.

grant:pay_verify.title: Verify mobile payments
grant:pay_verify.does: Lets a person approve or reject a written mobile payment. A person never approves a capture they wrote.
grant:pay_verify.why: Two people look at each payment: the one who writes it and the one who checks it against the phone.
grant:pay_verify.default: Nobody holds it. Only the owner can verify until the owner gives it to a person or a role.
grant:pay_verify.change: The holder sees the pending list for their place and can verify or reject with a note.

grant:recall_manage.title: Open and run a recall case
grant:recall_manage.does: Lets a person open a recall case, add batches to it, mark what was done and close it. The affected-stock report shows who holds the batch.
grant:recall_manage.why: A recall needs one accountable person with a written record.
grant:recall_manage.default: Management, factory in-charge and storekeeper roles hold it; the owner always may.
grant:recall_manage.change: Giving it to another role lets that role open recall cases. Recorded cases are never deleted.

grant:return_override.title: Return outside the rules
grant:return_override.does: Lets a person save a return that breaks the window, the receipt rule, the restock rule or the expired batch rule.
grant:return_override.why: Some returns are right even if a rule says no.
grant:return_override.default: Nobody has it except the owner.
grant:return_override.change: A reason is needed. It writes one audit line and a yellow Exceptions row (red for an expired batch).
grant:return_override.who: The owner gives it. It is a window grant, so an approved emergency request also works.

grant:rider_manage.title: Manage riders and delivery zones
grant:rider_manage.does: Lets a person add or change riders and the delivery zone fees.
grant:rider_manage.why: A fee and a rider list are money decisions.
grant:rider_manage.default: Nobody holds it. Only the owner can change them.
grant:rider_manage.change: The holder can add a rider and set a zone fee. Nothing already delivered changes.

grant:sales_target_manage.title: Set sales targets
grant:sales_target_manage.does: Lets a role or person enter, change and retire the monthly sales target of a place.
grant:sales_target_manage.why: A target is a decision about money.
grant:sales_target_manage.default: Held by nobody but the owner.
grant:sales_target_manage.change: The holder sees the 'Set a target' button on Targets, KPI & comparison, and the server accepts the entry for his own places.

grant:shift_manage.title: Schedule shifts and the roster
grant:shift_manage.does: Lets a person or a role add and retire shift templates and set roster days for the people whose main place he holds the right for. It does not give access to attendance, leave or pay.
grant:shift_manage.why: A manager can plan the week without being given the attendance powers.
grant:shift_manage.default: Nobody holds it. Only the owner can schedule until he gives the right.
grant:shift_manage.change: Give it on the Delegation board, with a place. The attendance_manage right does not include it.
grant:shift_manage.who: The owner gives and takes the right.

grant:social_approve.title: Approve social posts
grant:social_approve.does: Lets a person approve a post that someone else wrote, after looking at the preview.
grant:social_approve.why: Every public post needs a second person to say yes.
grant:social_approve.change: The approver can approve, send back or cancel posts. The person who wrote a post can never approve it.

grant:social_manage.title: Write and submit social posts
grant:social_manage.does: Lets a person write a post, add its pictures and send it for approval.
grant:social_manage.why: Only the people who write posts should have this.
grant:social_manage.change: The person can prepare posts; they cannot approve their own.

grant:stockout_log.title: Log a stockout (unmet demand)
grant:stockout_log.does: Lets a person write down that a customer wanted an item and it was not there.
grant:stockout_log.why: Shows lost demand that sales figures cannot show.
grant:stockout_log.default: Management, showroom manager, storekeeper and salesperson roles hold it.
grant:stockout_log.change: Entries can be voided with a reason, never deleted.

grant:supplier_terms_manage.title: Set agreed supplier prices and preferred suppliers
grant:supplier_terms_manage.does: Lets a person record the agreed price of an item with a supplier and the preferred or alternative suppliers of an item.
grant:supplier_terms_manage.why: Agreed prices are costs; the purchase price report compares them with what was paid.
grant:supplier_terms_manage.default: Purchasing and management roles hold it; the owner always may.
grant:supplier_terms_manage.change: Holders also see the agreed prices, which are otherwise hidden like any cost.

grant:todo_assign.title: Give extra tasks and duties
grant:todo_assign.does: Lets a person or a role give a task to one person or to everyone holding a role. A task given to a role becomes one task for each person who holds the role at that moment.
grant:todo_assign.why: The owner can hand out extra work through a trusted person.
grant:todo_assign.default: Nobody holds it. Only the owner can give tasks until he gives the right.
grant:todo_assign.change: Give it on the Delegation board. A giver sees only the tasks he gave, never another giver's tasks.
grant:todo_assign.who: The owner gives and takes the right.
grant:todo_assign.src: phase131.sql (todo_assign, r2_todo_assign); phase131_test.sql T2 and T3

rule:accounting_on.title: Accounting (double-entry books) on
rule:accounting_on.does: While OFF, nothing is posted to the books. ON starts posting sales, purchases and expenses to the journal.
rule:accounting_on.why: The books must not start before the start date and the opening are ready.
rule:accounting_on.change: Set the start date and the opening first. Nothing dated before the start date goes into the books.
rule:accounting_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:accounting_on_needs_reason.title: Switching accounting ON needs a reason
rule:accounting_on_needs_reason.does: When ON, turning Accounting from OFF to ON is done from the Period lock screen, with a written reason and a preview of the backlog that will be posted.
rule:accounting_on_needs_reason.why: Switching accounting on can post a long backlog at once.
rule:accounting_on_needs_reason.change: ON adds the preview and the reason step. Past figures never change.
rule:accounting_on_needs_reason.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:accounting_start_date.title: Accounting start date
rule:accounting_start_date.does: Nothing dated before this day goes into the books. Type it as YYYY-MM-DD.
rule:accounting_start_date.why: The books begin on one clear day.
rule:accounting_start_date.default: Blank. The balance check says data is needed.
rule:accounting_start_date.change: Set it before you switch accounting on. After an opening is posted it can be locked from moving.
rule:accounting_start_date.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:ai_default_provider.title: Default AI provider
rule:ai_default_provider.does: Chooses which provider the helpers use when an agent does not name one. local_rules runs on the phone for free. The other choices are paid providers and need a key, a model and a monthly budget first.
rule:ai_default_provider.why: A paid provider can spend money every month.
rule:ai_default_provider.change: A paid provider is used only when it is enabled, has a model and a budget, and the data level it needs is allowed for it. The AI log shows each call.
rule:ai_default_provider.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:ai_on.title: AI helpers are on (after a provider is linked)
rule:ai_on.does: Lets the AI helpers run. Nothing runs while this is off, and no provider is called and no money is spent.
rule:ai_on.why: This is the main on/off for every AI helper.
rule:ai_on.default: Off. No AI call is made and nothing is spent.
rule:ai_on.change: On: the helpers that are switched on for their own agent can make suggestions, within the provider budget. Every answer is a suggestion a person reviews.
rule:ai_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:ai_pause_all.title: Pause all AI now (emergency stop)
rule:ai_pause_all.does: Stops every AI agent and every provider at once. No new suggestion or proposal is made while it is on.
rule:ai_pause_all.why: If an answer looks wrong or a cost looks too high, one switch stops everything at once.
rule:ai_pause_all.change: On: every AI call is refused and the reason 'paused' is written in the AI log. Existing suggestions and their decisions are kept.
rule:ai_pause_all.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:ai_speech_on.title: Voice questions (browser speech-to-text)
rule:ai_speech_on.does: Shows a microphone button in the assistant. The phone's own speech recognition turns the voice into text, which is then shown for the person to check before it is asked.
rule:ai_speech_on.why: Helps people who prefer speaking, including in Bangla.
rule:ai_speech_on.default: Off. No microphone button is shown.
rule:ai_speech_on.change: On: the microphone button appears in the assistant. The question is still answered by the same rules and permissions as typed text.
rule:ai_speech_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:allow_test_reset.title: Allow test data reset
rule:allow_test_reset.does: When ON, the owner can delete all test data by typing a fixed phrase. The switch turns itself OFF after one reset and a log line is written.
rule:allow_test_reset.why: It clears a test project fast.
rule:allow_test_reset.change: ON lets the owner destroy all transaction records in one step. Items, rules, users, places and the chart of accounts are kept.
rule:allow_test_reset.warn: Test projects only. Never switch this on in the live project. It deletes real records.

rule:announce_on.title: Announcements are on (headline bar at the top)
rule:announce_on.does: Turns the whole announcement feature on or off. Off means no bar, no posting and no menu entry. On lets the owner or a designated person post to everyone, a role, a place or one person.
rule:announce_on.why: A new feature should start only when the owner decides.
rule:announce_on.default: Off. The app behaves exactly as before.
rule:announce_on.change: Turning it on shows the bar to people who have an announcement addressed to them. Turning it off hides the bar at once and keeps every old announcement and read receipt.

rule:auto_lock_day.title: Automatic lock: lock last month after this day
rule:auto_lock_day.does: Used only when the period lock is auto. Example: with 10, the whole month before is closed from the 11th of each month.
rule:auto_lock_day.why: It closes each month without anyone having to remember.
rule:auto_lock_day.change: A number from 1 to 28. Past figures never change.
rule:auto_lock_day.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:automation_on.title: Automation (all) ON
rule:automation_on.does: The one master switch for everything that talks to the outside or runs on a schedule: outside connections, AI calls, scheduled jobs and proposals made by agents. When it is OFF, every call is refused and every scheduled job is recorded as skipped.
rule:automation_on.why: One place stops everything at once if something goes wrong, and nothing starts by surprise.
rule:automation_on.default: Off. Nothing outside the app runs until the owner switches it on.
rule:automation_on.change: Rule automation_on. The pause rule automation_pause_until stops it for a set time without switching it off.

rule:automation_pause_until.title: Pause automation until a time
rule:automation_pause_until.does: Stops all automation until the time written here (ISO time, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00+06:00). A value that cannot be read counts as paused.
rule:automation_pause_until.why: A safe way to stop everything for a few days (for example during a holiday or an incident) without losing the settings.
rule:automation_pause_until.change: Write the time in the Switchboard rule. Clear it to end the pause.

rule:backdate_max_days_cash_move.title: Back-date limit: cash move date
rule:backdate_max_days_cash_move.does: How many days back a new cash move (deposit, withdrawal, owner top-up or draw, advance) may be dated. Over the limit needs an override window, a one-off owner grant or the back-date grant.
rule:backdate_max_days_cash_move.why: A date far in the past can hide a cost or move profit between months.
rule:backdate_max_days_cash_move.change: A number of days from 0 to 3650. It applies to new records only, so past figures never change.
rule:backdate_max_days_cash_move.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:backdate_max_days_expense.title: Back-date limit: quick expense date
rule:backdate_max_days_expense.does: How many days back a new quick expense may be dated. Over the limit needs an override window, a one-off owner grant or the back-date grant.
rule:backdate_max_days_expense.why: A date far in the past can hide a cost or move profit between months.
rule:backdate_max_days_expense.change: A number of days from 0 to 3650. It applies to new records only, so past figures never change.
rule:backdate_max_days_expense.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:backdate_max_days_production.title: Back-date limit: production date
rule:backdate_max_days_production.does: How many days back a production run may be dated (the made-at time). Over the limit needs an override window, a one-off owner grant or the back-date grant.
rule:backdate_max_days_production.why: A date far in the past can hide a cost or move profit between months.
rule:backdate_max_days_production.change: A number of days from 0 to 3650. It applies to new records only, so past figures never change.
rule:backdate_max_days_production.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:backdate_max_days_purchase.title: Back-date limit: purchase bill date
rule:backdate_max_days_purchase.does: How many days back a new purchase bill may be dated. Over the limit needs an override window, a one-off owner grant or the back-date grant.
rule:backdate_max_days_purchase.why: A date far in the past can hide a cost or move profit between months.
rule:backdate_max_days_purchase.change: A number of days from 0 to 3650. It applies to new records only, so past figures never change.
rule:backdate_max_days_purchase.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:backup_encrypt_on.title: Encrypt the nightly backup files
rule:backup_encrypt_on.does: When ON, the nightly backup files are encrypted with a passphrase the owner holds. Restore needs the same passphrase.
rule:backup_encrypt_on.why: The backup holds national ID and bank numbers.
rule:backup_encrypt_on.change: ON with no passphrase makes the backup fail on purpose and never falls back to plain files. Backups already made stay as they are.
rule:backup_encrypt_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.
rule:backup_encrypt_on.warn: If you lose the passphrase, nobody can open the encrypted backups. Store it safely before you switch this on.

rule:backup_retention_days.title: Keep dated backup folders for this many days
rule:backup_retention_days.does: A tool lists older dated backup folders and removes them only when told to. The newest folder is never removed.
rule:backup_retention_days.why: Old backups hold old personal data.
rule:backup_retention_days.default: Blank. Every dated folder is kept.
rule:backup_retention_days.change: A number of days from 1 to 36500. Git history still holds the old files, so removing a folder does not free them.
rule:backup_retention_days.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:bank_move_backdate_days.title: Flag a bank deposit or withdraw dated more than this many days back
rule:bank_move_backdate_days.does: A yellow line in the Exceptions list when a bank deposit or withdraw is dated more days back than this. The entry is still saved.
rule:bank_move_backdate_days.why: A date far back can move money between months.
rule:bank_move_backdate_days.change: A number sets the limit. It flags new entries only.
rule:bank_move_backdate_days.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:bank_move_large_over.title: Flag a bank deposit or withdraw above this amount
rule:bank_move_large_over.does: A yellow line in the Exceptions list for a bank deposit or withdraw above this amount in Tk. The entry is still saved.
rule:bank_move_large_over.why: Large bank moves deserve a second look.
rule:bank_move_large_over.change: A number sets the limit. It flags new entries only.
rule:bank_move_large_over.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:bank_slip_required.title: Bank slip number required on a bank deposit and withdraw
rule:bank_slip_required.does: When ON, the Reference field of a bank deposit or bank withdraw must hold the slip number.
rule:bank_slip_required.why: A slip number links the entry to the bank paper.
rule:bank_slip_required.change: ON refuses these entries without a slip number unless the owner allows one exception. Entries already saved do not change.
rule:bank_slip_required.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:brand_map_dated_on.title: Brand reports use the brand each place had on each day
rule:brand_map_dated_on.does: When ON, the brand report uses the brand a place had on each day, not only today's map.
rule:brand_map_dated_on.why: Changing the brand map should not rewrite old months.
rule:brand_map_dated_on.default: OFF. Today's map is used for every day.
rule:brand_map_dated_on.change: ON keeps old months with the brand they had. A map change dated in the past needs a reason, and a future date is refused.
rule:brand_map_dated_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:cake_capacity_day.title: Most cakes the shop takes for one day
rule:cake_capacity_day.does: The number of cake jobs due on one day. A new cake for a full day is refused.
rule:cake_capacity_day.why: The kitchen can only bake and decorate so many cakes; a cap stops an overload before the promise is made.
rule:cake_capacity_day.default: Blank. With the cake workflow on, no cake can be quoted until a number is typed. No number is assumed.
rule:cake_capacity_day.change: Cakes cancelled before delivery free their place again.

rule:cake_flow_on.title: Custom cake workflow
rule:cake_flow_on.does: Turns on the cake job: quote, advance, production slip, baking, decoration, ready, delivered, with the time and the person at each step.
rule:cake_flow_on.why: Custom cakes are the largest orders of the week and are easy to lose between the counter, the kitchen and the rider.
rule:cake_flow_on.default: Off. No cake job can be made.
rule:cake_flow_on.change: On: a cake needs a price quote, a day that passes the lead time and the daily cap, and the advance in the order before it is confirmed.

rule:cake_lead_days.title: How many days ahead a cake must be ordered
rule:cake_lead_days.does: The earliest day a cake can be due, counted from today.
rule:cake_lead_days.why: A cake needs time to buy materials and bake; this rule stops same-day promises.
rule:cake_lead_days.default: Blank. With the cake workflow on, no cake can be taken until a number is typed.
rule:cake_lead_days.change: A value of 1 means a cake for tomorrow at the earliest.

rule:cake_photo_required.title: Photo of the finished cake before delivery
rule:cake_photo_required.does: Requires a photo of the decorated cake before the cake is marked delivered.
rule:cake_photo_required.why: A photo shows what left the shop when a customer disputes the design.
rule:cake_photo_required.change: On: the delivered step is refused until a photo path is stored for the job.

rule:cash_short_post_on.title: Post an approved cash short/over to the books
rule:cash_short_post_on.does: OFF: approved cases wait and nothing is posted. ON: an approved short or over is posted on the count date.
rule:cash_short_post_on.why: The books should show a cash shortage as a cost.
rule:cash_short_post_on.change: ON posts approved cases from then on. Old cases need a one-time backfill that the owner runs.
rule:cash_short_post_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:cash_short_treatment.title: How a cash SHORT is booked
rule:cash_short_treatment.does: expense: to the cash short and over account (5800). staff_receivable: owed by the named employee (1220). An OVER always goes to 5800.
rule:cash_short_treatment.why: The owner decides who bears a cash short.
rule:cash_short_treatment.change: staff_receivable books the short as money the named employee owes. It applies to cases posted after the change.
rule:cash_short_treatment.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:credit_default_days.title: Default credit days for a customer with none of their own
rule:credit_default_days.does: Terms used for customers who have no credit days set.
rule:credit_default_days.why: Without terms nothing can be called overdue.
rule:credit_default_days.default: Blank. A customer with no days of their own has no terms and is not called overdue.
rule:credit_default_days.change: Their dues are aged against this number in the credit report.

rule:credit_risk_high_days.title: Overdue this many days = high risk
rule:credit_risk_high_days.does: The days past due at which a customer is marked 'high risk'.
rule:credit_risk_high_days.why: Same reason as the watch number.
rule:credit_risk_high_days.default: Blank. The risk column says 'rule not set'.
rule:credit_risk_high_days.change: Customers at or above the number show as high risk. Nothing blocks a sale.

rule:credit_risk_watch_days.title: Overdue this many days = watch
rule:credit_risk_watch_days.does: The days past due at which a customer is marked 'watch'.
rule:credit_risk_watch_days.why: The owner decides how much lateness matters.
rule:credit_risk_watch_days.default: Blank. The risk column says 'rule not set'; ages and amounts are still shown.
rule:credit_risk_watch_days.change: Customers at or above the number show as watch (and high risk when the high number is also set).

rule:crm_burn_max_percent.title: Points can pay at most this percent of a bill
rule:crm_burn_max_percent.does: Limits how much of one bill can be paid with points.
rule:crm_burn_max_percent.why: Stops a bill from being paid almost entirely with points when you do not want that.
rule:crm_burn_max_percent.change: The till check shows the largest points allowed for the bill and refuses more. The owner can allow an exception with a reason.

rule:crm_burn_max_points.title: Most points that can be used on one bill
rule:crm_burn_max_points.does: A fixed cap on points per bill.
rule:crm_burn_max_points.why: Keeps one large redemption from emptying a customer's balance by mistake.
rule:crm_burn_max_points.change: More than this number on one bill is refused unless the owner allows it with a reason.

rule:crm_burn_step_points.title: Points must be used in steps of
rule:crm_burn_step_points.does: Points can only be used in multiples of this number (for example 50).
rule:crm_burn_step_points.why: Keeps redemptions tidy and easy to explain at the counter.
rule:crm_burn_step_points.change: A number that is not a multiple is refused unless the owner allows it with a reason.

rule:crm_complaint_breach_exception_on.title: Put an overdue complaint on the Exceptions list
rule:crm_complaint_breach_exception_on.does: When the overdue check runs, each complaint that has newly passed its target time gets a yellow line on the Exceptions list (red for food safety).
rule:crm_complaint_breach_exception_on.why: The owner sees late complaints without hunting for them.
rule:crm_complaint_breach_exception_on.default: ON, but it only matters once complaints are on and at least one target time is set.
rule:crm_complaint_breach_exception_on.change: OFF: an overdue complaint is still marked overdue on the complaint itself, but no line is added to the Exceptions list.
rule:crm_complaint_breach_exception_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_complaint_fs_categories.title: Complaint categories that always count as food safety
rule:crm_complaint_fs_categories.does: A comma list of category codes. A complaint in one of these categories is marked food safety even if the staff member forgot to tick the box.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_categories.why: A cashier under pressure may forget the tick box.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_categories.default: sick (the same fell-ill cause that form 32-1 already flags).
rule:crm_complaint_fs_categories.change: Add more codes, for example sick,smell, to treat more categories as food safety. Set it to blank to let only the tick box decide.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_categories.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_complaint_fs_exception_on.title: Put a food-safety complaint on the Exceptions list
rule:crm_complaint_fs_exception_on.does: When a complaint is marked food safety, one red line is added to the Exceptions list so the owner sees it without opening the complaints screen.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_exception_on.why: A customer falling ill after eating is the most costly kind of complaint.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_exception_on.default: ON, but it only matters once complaints are switched on.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_exception_on.change: OFF: the complaint is still marked food safety and still shows a warning chip, but no line is added to the Exceptions list. Lines already added stay.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_exception_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_complaint_fs_severity.title: Lowest severity given to a food-safety complaint
rule:crm_complaint_fs_severity.does: keep leaves the severity as chosen by the person. high or critical raises a food-safety complaint to at least that severity when it is logged.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_severity.why: Raising the severity gives the complaint the shorter clock automatically.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_severity.change: New food-safety complaints get at least the chosen severity and therefore its target hours. Complaints already logged are not changed.
rule:crm_complaint_fs_severity.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_critical.title: Target hours to resolve a CRITICAL severity complaint
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_critical.does: Sets how many hours staff have to resolve a critical complaint. The clock starts the moment the complaint is logged. After that time the complaint shows OVERDUE and appears in the overdue list.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_critical.why: For the worst cases, such as a customer who fell ill.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_critical.default: Blank. No clock runs for this severity.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_critical.change: A complaint logged from now on gets a due time. Complaints already logged keep the clock they were given, unless someone changes their severity (then the clock is worked out again from the time it was logged).
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_critical.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_high.title: Target hours to resolve a HIGH severity complaint
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_high.does: Sets how many hours staff have to resolve a high complaint. The clock starts the moment the complaint is logged. After that time the complaint shows OVERDUE and appears in the overdue list.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_high.why: Serious complaints should be answered fast.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_high.default: Blank. No clock runs for this severity.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_high.change: A complaint logged from now on gets a due time. Complaints already logged keep the clock they were given, unless someone changes their severity (then the clock is worked out again from the time it was logged).
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_high.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_low.title: Target hours to resolve a LOW severity complaint
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_low.does: Sets how many hours staff have to resolve a low complaint. The clock starts the moment the complaint is logged. After that time the complaint shows OVERDUE and appears in the overdue list.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_low.why: Gives small complaints a deadline only if the owner wants one.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_low.default: Blank. No clock runs for this severity.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_low.change: A complaint logged from now on gets a due time. Complaints already logged keep the clock they were given, unless someone changes their severity (then the clock is worked out again from the time it was logged).
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_low.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_medium.title: Target hours to resolve a MEDIUM severity complaint
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_medium.does: Sets how many hours staff have to resolve a medium complaint. The clock starts the moment the complaint is logged. After that time the complaint shows OVERDUE and appears in the overdue list.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_medium.why: Stops ordinary complaints from being forgotten.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_medium.default: Blank. No clock runs for this severity.
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_medium.change: A complaint logged from now on gets a due time. Complaints already logged keep the clock they were given, unless someone changes their severity (then the clock is worked out again from the time it was logged).
rule:crm_complaint_sla_hours_medium.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_complaints_on.title: Record customer complaints and track them to a result
rule:crm_complaints_on.does: Lets staff log a complaint with the outlet, item, severity and owner, and move it through open, in progress, resolved and closed. Every step is kept in a history that cannot be edited.
rule:crm_complaints_on.why: Today a complaint is only a line on the paper register (form 32-1).
rule:crm_complaints_on.default: OFF. Nothing changes and nobody can log a complaint here.
rule:crm_complaints_on.change: ON: the Feedback and complaints screen accepts complaints. A complaint never posts any money; a refund is still made on the sale return screen and then linked.
rule:crm_complaints_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_consent_pos_on.title: Let counter staff record a customer's yes or no to messages
rule:crm_consent_pos_on.does: Lets the person at the counter tick 'Agrees to messages? Yes / No / Not asked' under the customer's mobile number while making a sale. Only the ways that need the customer present are allowed: counter tick, phone, paper form, message reply.
rule:crm_consent_pos_on.why: A customer's yes is the only thing that lets us message them.
rule:crm_consent_pos_on.default: OFF. Today only the owner or a customer manager can record consent.
rule:crm_consent_pos_on.change: ON: anyone who can enter POS sales can tick yes or no. They can also say 'do not contact', but only a manager can undo it.

rule:crm_dup_check_on.title: Look for duplicate customers and allow linking them as one person
rule:crm_dup_check_on.does: Builds the 'possible duplicates' list (same phone number, same name) and lets people with the right link two customers as the same person.
rule:crm_dup_check_on.why: The same person under two numbers splits their history, points and tier.
rule:crm_dup_check_on.default: OFF. No list and no linking. Saving a customer still stops on an identical mobile number, as today.
rule:crm_dup_check_on.change: ON: the list appears and linking works. A link never moves sales, payments, dues or the books.

rule:crm_dup_similar_names_on.title: Also list names that differ by one letter
rule:crm_dup_similar_names_on.does: Adds pairs whose names are one letter apart (a spelling slip) to the duplicate list, as a weak hint.
rule:crm_dup_similar_names_on.why: People spell names differently, but one letter apart is often two different people, so it is only a hint.
rule:crm_dup_similar_names_on.default: OFF. Names must be the same after removing spaces, capitals and punctuation.
rule:crm_dup_similar_names_on.change: ON: more pairs appear, marked 'weak' unless they also share an address or a birthday.

rule:crm_export_max_rows.title: Most customers one export may contain
rule:crm_export_max_rows.does: A number. One export never has more customers than this.
rule:crm_export_max_rows.why: A limit stops one click from taking the whole customer book.
rule:crm_export_max_rows.default: Blank. Export stays blocked even when switched on.
rule:crm_export_max_rows.change: Type a number to allow export. Blank again: export is blocked.

rule:crm_export_on.title: Allow the customer list to be exported
rule:crm_export_on.does: Allows the owner and people given 'Export the customer list' to download customers as a CSV file, with a reason, a row cap and a log line.
rule:crm_export_on.why: A customer file can be copied and taken away.
rule:crm_export_on.default: OFF. There is no customer export.
rule:crm_export_on.change: ON: export works, but only after the 'most customers one export may contain' number is set. If the privacy switch is ON and the person cannot see full numbers, the file has hidden numbers too.

rule:crm_feedback_low_max.title: A rating at or below this many stars needs a follow-up call
rule:crm_feedback_low_max.does: Puts every rating at or below this number on the Calls needed list until someone records the call. A manager can also turn the rating into a complaint.
rule:crm_feedback_low_max.why: An unhappy customer who is called quickly often stays a customer.
rule:crm_feedback_low_max.default: Blank. No rating needs a call.
rule:crm_feedback_low_max.change: New ratings at or below the number are put on the list. Ratings already recorded are not changed.
rule:crm_feedback_low_max.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_feedback_on.title: Record customer ratings (1 to 5 stars) for a sale or order
rule:crm_feedback_on.does: Lets staff record a star rating and a short comment for a sale or an online order. Only one rating is allowed for each sale or order.
rule:crm_feedback_on.why: Shows which outlets and items please customers, and which ratings need a phone call.
rule:crm_feedback_on.change: ON: the Ratings tab accepts ratings. A rating never changes a sale or posts money.
rule:crm_feedback_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_feedback_window_days.title: Accept a rating only for a sale made in the last this many days
rule:crm_feedback_window_days.does: Refuses a rating for a sale or order older than this number of days.
rule:crm_feedback_window_days.why: A rating long after the sale says little about today's service.
rule:crm_feedback_window_days.default: Blank. A sale of any age can be rated.
rule:crm_feedback_window_days.change: Older sales can no longer be rated. Ratings already recorded stay.
rule:crm_feedback_window_days.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_lead_list_add_mode.title: Who may add a lost reason, source or occasion to the lists
rule:crm_lead_list_add_mode.does: Chooses who can add or retire entries in the three lists. The entry Other can never be removed.
rule:crm_lead_list_add_mode.why: Clean lists make the win and loss report readable.
rule:crm_lead_list_add_mode.change: Manager: a holder of the right Manage enquiries can also add and retire entries.

rule:crm_lead_lost_by.title: Who may close an enquiry as lost
rule:crm_lead_lost_by.does: Chooses whether only managers, or also the person the enquiry is assigned to, may close it as lost. A lost reason from the list is always needed.
rule:crm_lead_lost_by.why: Closing as lost ends the follow-up.
rule:crm_lead_lost_by.default: Manager: only the owner or a holder of the right Manage enquiries.
rule:crm_lead_lost_by.change: Assignee: the person it is assigned to can also close it, still with a reason from the list.

rule:crm_lead_on.title: Track party, wholesale, corporate and gift enquiries
rule:crm_lead_on.does: Lets staff write down an enquiry, send a quote with items and a valid-until date, follow it up, and mark it won or lost. A won enquiry can be turned into the normal order or a draft party form.
rule:crm_lead_on.why: Big orders are won by following up.
rule:crm_lead_on.default: Off. The enquiry screen shows a short note and nothing else.
rule:crm_lead_on.change: On: the Party and gift enquiries screen works for people who may use it. Nothing is posted to the books, no message is sent to a customer, and no order is made until a manager turns a won enquiry into one.

rule:crm_lead_quote_valid_days.title: Quote validity: default number of days
rule:crm_lead_quote_valid_days.does: Fills in the valid-until date of a quote as today plus this many days.
rule:crm_lead_quote_valid_days.why: A quote that never ends can be used months later at an old price.
rule:crm_lead_quote_valid_days.default: Blank. The person must type the valid-until date; a quote without one cannot be sent.
rule:crm_lead_quote_valid_days.change: With a number: the date is filled in automatically and can still be changed.

rule:crm_lead_reopen_mode.title: Reopening a lost enquiry
rule:crm_lead_reopen_mode.does: Decides who may bring a lost enquiry back. Every reopen needs a written reason and appears on the Exceptions list.
rule:crm_lead_reopen_mode.default: Reason: a manager may reopen with a written reason.
rule:crm_lead_reopen_mode.change: Owner: only the owner may reopen. Off: a lost enquiry can never be reopened; a new enquiry must be started.

rule:crm_lead_stale_days.title: Flag an open enquiry as stale after this many days of silence
rule:crm_lead_stale_days.does: Marks an open enquiry with no note, quote, task or stage change for this many days.
rule:crm_lead_stale_days.why: Enquiries go cold when nobody touches them.
rule:crm_lead_stale_days.change: With a number: a Stale flag shows on the board and the report, and counts in the in-app reminder if reminders are on.

rule:crm_lead_win_needs_quote.title: An enquiry can be won only after a quote was sent
rule:crm_lead_win_needs_quote.does: Asks for a sent quote before an enquiry can be marked won.
rule:crm_lead_win_needs_quote.why: A quote is the written price the customer agreed to.
rule:crm_lead_win_needs_quote.default: Off. An enquiry can be won without a quote.
rule:crm_lead_win_needs_quote.change: On: staff must send a quote first. A manager can still win it without one by writing a reason, which goes to the Exceptions list.

rule:crm_mask_phone.title: Hide customer phone numbers and addresses
rule:crm_mask_phone.does: Shows a number as 017******78 and hides the address from people who do not have the right to see them.
rule:crm_mask_phone.why: Today every person who can open the customer list can read every customer's number and address.
rule:crm_mask_phone.default: OFF. Everyone who can see customers sees full numbers, as today.
rule:crm_mask_phone.change: ON: the owner, people given 'See full customer phone and address', and people who already see mobile numbers in reports still see everything. Everyone else sees hidden numbers and can ask to show one number with a written reason, which is recorded.

rule:crm_mask_style.title: How a hidden phone number looks
rule:crm_mask_style.does: Chooses what a hidden number shows: the first three and last two digits (017******78) or only the last four digits.
rule:crm_mask_style.why: Staff still need to tell two customers apart without seeing the whole number.
rule:crm_mask_style.default: First three and last two digits.
rule:crm_mask_style.change: Only changes the look of hidden numbers, and only while the privacy switch is ON.

rule:crm_metrics_batch.title: Most customers scored in one run
rule:crm_metrics_batch.does: Limits how many customers are worked out each time someone presses 'Refresh scores'.
rule:crm_metrics_batch.why: Keeps one press from making the system slow.
rule:crm_metrics_batch.default: 2000 (a technical size, not a business limit)
rule:crm_metrics_batch.change: A smaller number means more presses to finish; a bigger one means each press takes longer. Nothing else changes.

rule:crm_metrics_schedule_hours.title: Refresh customer scores by itself: at most once every this many hours
rule:crm_metrics_schedule_hours.does: Sets the quiet time between two automatic refreshes.
rule:crm_metrics_schedule_hours.why: Stops the job from doing the same work again and again.
rule:crm_metrics_schedule_hours.default: Blank (the automatic refresh does nothing even if switched ON)
rule:crm_metrics_schedule_hours.change: A number lets the automatic refresh run once per that many hours, continuing at once if a big shop is not finished.

rule:crm_metrics_schedule_on.title: Refresh customer scores by itself
rule:crm_metrics_schedule_on.does: Lets the regular 30-minute background job refresh the scores, so nobody has to press the button.
rule:crm_metrics_schedule_on.why: Scores stay fresh for the festival rush without remembering to refresh them.
rule:crm_metrics_schedule_on.default: OFF (scores are refreshed only when someone presses the button)
rule:crm_metrics_schedule_on.change: ON, with the hours below set: the background job refreshes scores, never more often than the hours you chose, and never more than the batch size per run. ON with the hours blank does nothing.

rule:crm_on.title: Customer profile extras
rule:crm_on.does: Lets staff add more to a customer's profile: a preferred language and outlet, extra delivery points, family birthdays and anniversaries, tags, notes, a customer type and credit days.
rule:crm_on.why: Shop staff can recognise a customer, remember their dates and deliver to the right place.
rule:crm_on.default: OFF. The customer screens work exactly as they do today and nothing can be added.
rule:crm_on.change: ON: the extra fields can be filled. They never change a sale, a payment or any accounting figure.
rule:crm_on.who: Only the owner, in the settings (Switchboard).

rule:crm_order_task_days.title: Add a delivery task when an enquiry becomes an order
rule:crm_order_task_days.does: When a won enquiry is turned into an order that has a delivery date, adds a task for the assigned person this many days before the delivery. It closes by itself when the order is delivered or cancelled.
rule:crm_order_task_days.why: A reminder before delivery protects the biggest orders from being missed.
rule:crm_order_task_days.change: With a number (0 = on the day): the task appears on My tasks. Needs tasks switched on.

rule:crm_pii_guard_on.title: Show customer phone and address only to people who are allowed
rule:crm_pii_guard_on.does: Hides customers' phone numbers, WhatsApp numbers and addresses in the CRM customer list, the customer sheet, the duplicate list and the consent register. The owner and people given 'See customers' full phone and address' still see everything.
rule:crm_pii_guard_on.why: Every sales person can read every customer's number today.
rule:crm_pii_guard_on.default: OFF. Everyone who can see customers sees numbers exactly as today.
rule:crm_pii_guard_on.change: ON: other staff see a masked number such as 017******78 and no address. Opening a full number needs a reason (if that setting is on) and is written to the access log.

rule:crm_points_adjust_alert_over.title: Tell the owner when a manual points change is larger than
rule:crm_points_adjust_alert_over.does: A manual points change above this size also appears in the Exceptions list.
rule:crm_points_adjust_alert_over.why: Large hand-made changes are the easiest place for mistakes or misuse.
rule:crm_points_adjust_alert_over.default: Blank. No alert. A reason is always required anyway.
rule:crm_points_adjust_alert_over.change: Changes above the number show as a yellow line in Exceptions with the reason.

rule:crm_points_expiry_from.title: Points expiry counts from this date
rule:crm_points_expiry_from.does: The first day expiry may count. Points earned before this date are treated as earned on this date.
rule:crm_points_expiry_from.why: Stops old points from being wiped on the day expiry is switched on.
rule:crm_points_expiry_from.change: With a date set, a points expiry run can be applied. Choose a date a few months ahead and tell customers first.

rule:crm_points_expiry_months.title: Points expire after this many months
rule:crm_points_expiry_months.does: Sets how old unspent points must be before the owner can expire them.
rule:crm_points_expiry_months.why: Points nobody spends pile up as a promise to customers.
rule:crm_points_expiry_months.default: Blank. Points never expire, as today.
rule:crm_points_expiry_months.change: Once a number is set (and the start date below), the owner can preview who would lose points and then apply it. Nothing expires by itself.

rule:crm_points_expiry_warn_days.title: Warn this many days before points expire
rule:crm_points_expiry_warn_days.does: Shows the list of customers who will lose points within this many days.
rule:crm_points_expiry_warn_days.why: A friendly reminder before points vanish is kinder and brings customers back.
rule:crm_points_expiry_warn_days.change: The Expiry tab lists who is about to lose points. Sending a message is done from the campaign screens.

rule:crm_print_needs_export.title: Printing a customer list needs the export right
rule:crm_print_needs_export.does: Ties printing a customer list to the same right as exporting it.
rule:crm_print_needs_export.why: A printed list is as portable as a file.
rule:crm_print_needs_export.default: OFF. Anyone who sees the list can print it. Each print is written to the log.
rule:crm_print_needs_export.change: ON: only the owner and people given 'Export the customer list' can print customer lists. The screen enforces it; the system cannot stop a browser print by itself, so the log is the control.

rule:crm_quiet_from.title: Quiet time for messages
rule:crm_quiet_from.does: Two clock times (for example 21:00 and 08:00). Inside this window the message check says 'quiet hours' so the campaign screen can hold messages back.
rule:crm_quiet_from.why: Customers do not like messages late at night or very early.
rule:crm_quiet_from.change: With both times filled in, messages are marked 'quiet hours' inside the window. A window that runs past midnight is fine.

rule:crm_quiet_to.title: Quiet time for messages
rule:crm_quiet_to.does: Two clock times (for example 21:00 and 08:00). Inside this window the message check says 'quiet hours' so the campaign screen can hold messages back.
rule:crm_quiet_to.why: Customers do not like messages late at night or very early.
rule:crm_quiet_to.change: With both times filled in, messages are marked 'quiet hours' inside the window. A window that runs past midnight is fine.

rule:crm_quote_min_lead_days.title: Late quote: least days between the quote and the event
rule:crm_quote_min_lead_days.does: Treats a quote as late when the event is closer than this many days, or the valid-until date is already past.
rule:crm_quote_min_lead_days.why: Cakes and party orders need time to make.
rule:crm_quote_min_lead_days.default: Blank. No check on the event date. A valid-until date in the past is always treated as late.
rule:crm_quote_min_lead_days.change: With a number: a late quote needs a written reason and appears on the Exceptions list. It is not blocked.

rule:crm_referral_min_bill.title: First bill must be at least
rule:crm_referral_min_bill.does: The smallest first bill that earns a referral reward.
rule:crm_referral_min_bill.why: Stops rewards for tiny test purchases.
rule:crm_referral_min_bill.change: A smaller first bill closes the referral without a reward.

rule:crm_referral_on.title: Referral codes and rewards
rule:crm_referral_on.does: Lets each customer have a short code. A new customer who gives it earns the referrer points after their first completed sale.
rule:crm_referral_on.why: Customers bringing friends is the cheapest way to grow.
rule:crm_referral_on.default: OFF. No code is made and no reward is given.
rule:crm_referral_on.change: Codes can be made, a new customer can be linked to a referrer, and the reward is given once on the new customer's first completed sale. Loyalty points must also be ON.

rule:crm_referral_referred_points.title: Points the new customer earns
rule:crm_referral_referred_points.does: Extra welcome points for the referred customer.
rule:crm_referral_referred_points.why: Gives the new customer a reason to say who sent them.
rule:crm_referral_referred_points.change: The new customer gets these points together with the referrer's reward.

rule:crm_referral_reward_points.title: Points the referring customer earns
rule:crm_referral_reward_points.does: The number of points the referrer gets.
rule:crm_referral_reward_points.why: A blank number means no reward is promised.
rule:crm_referral_reward_points.default: Blank. No reward can be given.
rule:crm_referral_reward_points.change: Rewards are given only when this number is set.

rule:crm_repeat_days.title: Repeat complaint check: look back this many days
rule:crm_repeat_days.does: When set, a new complaint is marked REPEAT if the same customer (and, by default, the same item) already complained within this many days.
rule:crm_repeat_days.why: The same customer complaining about the same item again usually means the first answer did not work or a batch is bad.
rule:crm_repeat_days.change: New complaints are checked from now on and may be marked repeat. Old complaints are not re-marked, but they are counted as earlier ones.
rule:crm_repeat_days.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_repeat_min.title: Repeat complaint check: complaints needed (this one included)
rule:crm_repeat_min.does: How many complaints, counting the new one, make a repeat. 2 means the second complaint is marked.
rule:crm_repeat_min.why: A higher number avoids marking a customer who only complained twice by accident.
rule:crm_repeat_min.default: 2. It has no effect until the look-back days are set.
rule:crm_repeat_min.change: Changes which new complaints are marked. Marks already made stay.
rule:crm_repeat_min.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_repeat_scope.title: Repeat complaint check: same customer and item, or same customer only
rule:crm_repeat_scope.does: customer_item looks for the same customer complaining about the same item. customer looks for any earlier complaint by the same customer.
rule:crm_repeat_scope.why: The first finds a problem with one product.
rule:crm_repeat_scope.default: customer_item. It has no effect until the look-back days are set.
rule:crm_repeat_scope.change: Changes which new complaints are marked. Marks already made stay.
rule:crm_repeat_scope.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:crm_reveal_for_call.title: Let counter staff ask for one number at a time to call
rule:crm_reveal_for_call.does: Gives a masked person a Call button that opens one customer's full number to dial it. It always needs a reason (if that setting is on) and is always logged. It never shows the address.
rule:crm_reveal_for_call.why: Staff sometimes have to phone a customer about an order.
rule:crm_reveal_for_call.default: OFF. A masked person cannot open a number.
rule:crm_reveal_for_call.change: ON: masked staff can open one number at a time to call. OFF: only the owner and people with the 'see full phone' right can.

rule:crm_rfm_frequency_min.title: Customer score: frequent means at least this many orders in 12 months
rule:crm_rfm_frequency_min.does: Decides who counts as a frequent customer.
rule:crm_rfm_frequency_min.change: Set together with the other two numbers, it switches the labels to your own cut-offs. Blank brings the standard labels back.

rule:crm_rfm_recent_days.title: Customer score: recent means bought within this many days
rule:crm_rfm_recent_days.does: Decides who counts as a recent customer when customers are given labels such as Champion or At risk.
rule:crm_rfm_recent_days.why: A sweet shop and a cake shop do not buy at the same pace.
rule:crm_rfm_recent_days.change: Blank: the standard labels are used, the same as the old Customer value report (Champion = 3 or more orders and seen within 30 days). When this and the next two numbers are all set, your own labels are used at once, with no rebuild.

rule:crm_rfm_spend_min.title: Customer score: big spender means at least this much spent in 12 months
rule:crm_rfm_spend_min.does: Decides who counts as a big spender. Money is counted after returns.
rule:crm_rfm_spend_min.why: A few customers bring a large part of the money.
rule:crm_rfm_spend_min.change: Set together with the other two numbers, it switches the labels to your own cut-offs. Blank brings the standard labels back.

rule:crm_second_phone_on.title: Extra phone numbers
rule:crm_second_phone_on.does: Lets a customer have more than one phone number (home, work, a family member). The cashier can find the customer by any of them.
rule:crm_second_phone_on.why: A customer who calls from another phone is not entered a second time, so their history, points and dues stay in one place.
rule:crm_second_phone_on.default: OFF. Only the main mobile and the WhatsApp number are used.
rule:crm_second_phone_on.change: ON: extra numbers can be added. A number that already belongs to another customer is accepted but flagged as a possible duplicate; a sale is never blocked.
rule:crm_second_phone_on.who: Only the owner. Needs 'Customer profile extras' to be ON as well.

rule:crm_seg_export_max_rows.title: Customer lists: most customers one export may hold
rule:crm_seg_export_max_rows.does: Sets the largest export. A bigger list is refused, never cut short silently.
rule:crm_seg_export_max_rows.why: Limits how much customer data can leave in one go.
rule:crm_seg_export_max_rows.default: Blank (export stays blocked even if switched ON)
rule:crm_seg_export_max_rows.change: A number allows exports up to that size.

rule:crm_seg_export_on.title: Customer lists: allow export
rule:crm_seg_export_on.does: Lets people with the Export right download a list as a spreadsheet file.
rule:crm_seg_export_on.why: A downloaded list leaves the system.
rule:crm_seg_export_on.change: ON, with the largest export size set: a person with the Export right can download a list after writing a reason. Phone numbers are hidden unless the person may see full numbers.
rule:crm_seg_export_on.who: Only the owner (Settings). Exporting needs the right 'Export customer lists'.

rule:crm_segment_max_members.title: Largest list that can be frozen
rule:crm_segment_max_members.does: Stops a list from being frozen if it holds more customers than this number.
rule:crm_segment_max_members.why: A rule that is too wide (almost everybody) would make a list nobody should message.
rule:crm_segment_max_members.change: A bigger number lets bigger lists be frozen. A list over the number can still be counted and looked at.

rule:crm_segments_on.title: Customer lists: allow saving and freezing lists
rule:crm_segments_on.does: Lets people with the right save a list of customers (for example 'not seen for 60 days') and freeze a copy of it.
rule:crm_segments_on.why: A saved list gives your team the same group of customers every time, so a festival call or message goes to the right people and not to everybody.
rule:crm_segments_on.change: OFF: you can still build a list and see how many customers it holds, but you cannot save it. ON: people with the right can save, change, retire and freeze lists.
rule:crm_segments_on.who: Only the owner (Settings). Saving a list needs the right 'Save customer lists and refresh customer scores'.

rule:crm_task_default_due_hours.title: Task due time when none is typed
rule:crm_task_default_due_hours.does: Fills in the due time of a new task as now plus this many hours when the person leaves it empty.
rule:crm_task_default_due_hours.why: A task with no due time never becomes overdue and is easy to forget.
rule:crm_task_default_due_hours.default: Blank. The person must type a due date and time.
rule:crm_task_default_due_hours.change: With a number: the due time is filled in; it can be changed.

rule:crm_task_on.title: Use follow-up tasks and the My tasks list
rule:crm_task_on.does: Lets staff add a task with a due date and time, tick it done, snooze it, or skip it with a reason. Overdue tasks are listed first on My tasks.
rule:crm_task_on.why: A reminder with a name and a time gets done.
rule:crm_task_on.default: Off. No task can be added.
rule:crm_task_on.change: On: staff keep their own list and managers can give tasks to others (if allowed). A task never posts to the books and never messages a customer.

rule:crm_task_reminder_on.title: Send staff an in-app reminder for due tasks and stale enquiries
rule:crm_task_reminder_on.does: Lets the 30-minute notify job add one in-app line per person per day with counts of overdue tasks, tasks due today and enquiries to follow up.
rule:crm_task_reminder_on.why: Staff who do not open My tasks still hear that something is waiting.
rule:crm_task_reminder_on.default: Off. Nothing is sent; staff see their list when they open My tasks.
rule:crm_task_reminder_on.change: On: one line per person per day, counts only (no customer name or phone). It never messages a customer.

rule:crm_task_snooze_max_days.title: Longest snooze for a task
rule:crm_task_snooze_max_days.does: Limits how far into the future a task can be snoozed.
rule:crm_task_snooze_max_days.why: Snoozing again and again is a way to avoid a task.
rule:crm_task_snooze_max_days.change: With a number: a longer snooze is refused with a message.

rule:crm_unmask_reason_required.title: Ask for a reason before showing a full phone number
rule:crm_unmask_reason_required.does: When someone other than the owner opens a hidden number, they must write a short reason (at least 3 characters). The reason goes in the access log.
rule:crm_unmask_reason_required.why: A reason makes people think twice and gives the owner something to check later.
rule:crm_unmask_reason_required.default: ON, but it only matters while the privacy switch is ON.
rule:crm_unmask_reason_required.change: OFF: staff can open a hidden number without a reason; the look is still written to the access log.

rule:crm_voucher_expense_account.title: Expense account for the coupon provision
rule:crm_voucher_expense_account.does: The chart account (code) charged when the provision is set up.
rule:crm_voucher_expense_account.why: Shows the cost of the offer in the right place.
rule:crm_voucher_expense_account.default: Blank. Liability cannot be switched on.
rule:crm_voucher_expense_account.change: Must be an existing active expense account.

rule:crm_voucher_liability_account.title: Liability account for unused coupon value
rule:crm_voucher_liability_account.does: The chart account (code) that holds the unused coupon value.
rule:crm_voucher_liability_account.why: The books need to know where to hold it.
rule:crm_voucher_liability_account.default: Blank. Liability cannot be switched on.
rule:crm_voucher_liability_account.change: Must be an existing active liability account.

rule:crm_voucher_liability_from.title: Coupon liability counts from this date
rule:crm_voucher_liability_from.does: The first day coupon liability may be booked. Only coupons made on or after it are booked.
rule:crm_voucher_liability_from.why: Protects history: the past never changes.
rule:crm_voucher_liability_from.default: Blank. Liability cannot be switched on.
rule:crm_voucher_liability_from.change: Required before switching on, and it must not be in the past at that moment.

rule:crm_voucher_liability_on.title: Book coupon liability in the accounts
rule:crm_voucher_liability_on.does: For amount coupons marked 'post liability', holds the unused value in the accounts as a provision and releases it as the coupon is used or expires.
rule:crm_voucher_liability_on.why: Shows a promise to customers on the books.
rule:crm_voucher_liability_on.default: OFF. Coupons never touch the accounts.
rule:crm_voucher_liability_on.change: From the effective-from date, new marked coupons write balanced entries (Dr expense, Cr liability). It can be wound down to zero before switching off.

rule:crm_voucher_max_amount.title: Largest taka amount a coupon may give
rule:crm_voucher_max_amount.does: The most an amount coupon may take off.
rule:crm_voucher_max_amount.why: Same safety limit for taka coupons.
rule:crm_voucher_max_amount.default: Blank. Amount coupons cannot be created.
rule:crm_voucher_max_amount.change: Amount coupons up to this number can be created. Above it only the owner can, with a reason.

rule:crm_voucher_max_percent.title: Largest percent a coupon may give
rule:crm_voucher_max_percent.does: The most a percent coupon may take off.
rule:crm_voucher_max_percent.why: A safety limit so a typing mistake cannot create a 90 percent coupon.
rule:crm_voucher_max_percent.default: Blank. Percent coupons cannot be created.
rule:crm_voucher_max_percent.change: Percent coupons up to this number can be created. Above it only the owner can, with a reason.

rule:crm_voucher_on.title: Coupons and vouchers
rule:crm_voucher_on.does: Lets the till check a coupon code and record its use against a sale.
rule:crm_voucher_on.why: Gives staff a controlled way to give offers instead of typing free discounts.
rule:crm_voucher_on.default: OFF. Coupons can be prepared but not used.
rule:crm_voucher_on.change: Coupon checks and redemptions start working. The discount is still entered through the normal discount control, with its normal approval.

rule:crm_winback_days.title: Lapsed customer: not seen for this many days
rule:crm_winback_days.does: Sets how many days without a visit makes a customer 'lapsed'. The lapsed list and the Customer value overview use it.
