rule:crm_winback_days.why: These are the customers a phone call or a small offer can bring back, and bringing back an old customer is cheaper than finding a new one.
rule:crm_winback_days.default: Blank (the lapsed list asks for the number of days each time)
rule:crm_winback_days.change: A number becomes the default for the lapsed list and fills the 'lapsed' tile. A customer who has never bought is never counted as lapsed.

rule:d_material_cost_method.title: How a material's unit cost is taken
rule:d_material_cost_method.does: average_purchase: weighted average of purchases. last_purchase: the last purchase bill. fixed_price: a price the owner fixes.
rule:d_material_cost_method.why: The recipe cost depends on the material cost.
rule:d_material_cost_method.default: average_purchase. It is what the stock already uses.
rule:d_material_cost_method.change: Today it drives only the cost helper and the cost-gap report, so stock and profit do not change. An item with no fixed price shows as a gap.
rule:d_material_cost_method.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:d_recipe_materials_mode.title: When a recipe lacks a material its product requires
rule:d_recipe_materials_mode.does: off: as today. warn: production is saved with a yellow stock exception. block: recipe activation and production are refused (recipe_missing_material).
rule:d_recipe_materials_mode.why: A sweet without milk or packing in its recipe gives a wrong cost.
rule:d_recipe_materials_mode.default: off. Nothing is required until the owner enters which products need which materials.
rule:d_recipe_materials_mode.change: warn or block checks new recipes and runs. Past runs do not change.
rule:d_recipe_materials_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:d_wallet_fee_treatment.title: Wallet fee treatment
rule:d_wallet_fee_treatment.does: separate_expense: every fee is booked as expense 5815 and lowers the wallet balance. not_posted: fees are listed in the wallet register but not booked.
rule:d_wallet_fee_treatment.why: Wallet fees are a real cost.
rule:d_wallet_fee_treatment.change: Switching to not_posted reverses the posted fee entries. Switching back posts them again.
rule:d_wallet_fee_treatment.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:d_wallet_negative_mode.title: When a fee or a move would make a wallet balance negative
rule:d_wallet_negative_mode.does: refuse: the fee or move is refused. warn: it is saved and the answer carries a warning.
rule:d_wallet_negative_mode.why: A negative wallet is usually a mistake.
rule:d_wallet_negative_mode.change: warn lets the entry in. A supplier payment is checked only for a wallet that has an opening date.
rule:d_wallet_negative_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:d_wallet_split_on.title: Book each mobile wallet on its own account
rule:d_wallet_split_on.does: OFF: all mobile money stays on one mobile account (1130), as before. ON: new sales, collections and supplier payments that name a wallet go to that wallet's own account (1131 to 1134).
rule:d_wallet_split_on.why: The books then match each wallet.
rule:d_wallet_split_on.change: ON applies to old and new payments, and old ones are moved by new reclass entries. Posted entries are not edited.
rule:d_wallet_split_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:employee_pay_change_flag.title: Red line when an employee pay account is changed
rule:employee_pay_change_flag.does: When ON, changing an employee's bank account or wallet number adds a red line to Exceptions. It shows only the last 4 characters of the old and new account.
rule:employee_pay_change_flag.why: A changed pay account is a common way to redirect salary.
rule:employee_pay_change_flag.change: ON flags changes made after the switch. Changes already made are not flagged.
rule:employee_pay_change_flag.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:employee_pay_dup_mode.title: Two employees on one pay account
rule:employee_pay_dup_mode.does: off: no check. warn: save it and add a red line to Exceptions. block: refuse it unless the owner allows one exception; employees who left are not compared.
rule:employee_pay_dup_mode.why: Two people on one account can mean a made-up employee.
rule:employee_pay_dup_mode.change: warn or block checks new and changed pay accounts only.
rule:employee_pay_dup_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:exit_alert_hours.title: Hours after leaving before an active login is flagged
rule:exit_alert_hours.does: A person who left but still has an active login after this many hours becomes a red line in Exceptions.
rule:exit_alert_hours.why: It catches a login that was forgotten.
rule:exit_alert_hours.change: A number of hours from 0 to 8760. The scan runs when the owner presses Check now, or when the notify job runs it.
rule:exit_alert_hours.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:exit_deactivate_devices.title: Also switch off attendance device tokens the person registered
rule:exit_deactivate_devices.does: When ON, attendance device tokens that this person registered are switched off when they leave.
rule:exit_deactivate_devices.why: A token is shared by everyone at a place, so it is not switched off by default.
rule:exit_deactivate_devices.change: ON switches off only the tokens this person registered. A re-hire does not switch them on again.
rule:exit_deactivate_devices.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:exit_revoke_mode.title: When a person leaves: what happens to their login
rule:exit_revoke_mode.does: off: nothing is touched. alert: only a red line in Exceptions. auto: the login is disabled and the grants end.
rule:exit_revoke_mode.why: A person who left should not keep access to money and stock.
rule:exit_revoke_mode.default: off. Nothing is touched, as today.
rule:exit_revoke_mode.change: auto sets the login to disabled, ends the grants and writes one audit line. A re-hire turns on only a login that this feature turned off.
rule:exit_revoke_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:exit_revoke_statuses.title: Which statuses count as leaving
rule:exit_revoke_statuses.does: A comma list of statuses: resigned, terminated, retired, on_leave.
rule:exit_revoke_statuses.why: It decides who is treated as having left.
rule:exit_revoke_statuses.change: Adding on_leave is allowed but not advised. An unknown status is refused.
rule:exit_revoke_statuses.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:expense_count_on.title: Expense vouchers count when they are
rule:expense_count_on.does: as_today, approved or submitted. One rule for the profit report, the expense reports, the day book and the journal.
rule:expense_count_on.why: A voucher should count at the same time in every report.
rule:expense_count_on.default: as_today. The day book counts submitted and approved. The journal counts approved only.
rule:expense_count_on.change: approved or submitted makes all reports follow one rule. Journal entries already posted do not change.
rule:expense_count_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:fc_payroll_day.title: Day of the month salaries are usually paid
rule:fc_payroll_day.does: Lets the expected cash calendar put the next salary payment on a date.
rule:fc_payroll_day.why: Without a day the salary has no date and is shown as 'date unknown'.
rule:fc_payroll_day.default: Blank. Salary shows as date unknown.
rule:fc_payroll_day.change: Unpaid approved payroll is placed on that day; if nothing is owed, the last payroll run is repeated on that day and marked as an assumption.

rule:fc_window_days.title: Forecast window (days of history)
rule:fc_window_days.does: How many completed days the sales, item and expiry forecasts look back over.
rule:fc_window_days.why: More history is steadier, less history reacts faster.
rule:fc_window_days.default: Blank. Each forecast page asks for the days; nothing is assumed.
rule:fc_window_days.change: With a number set, forecasts use it when no days are typed.

rule:forms_post_to_ledger.title: Approved forms post to the stock ledger
rule:forms_post_to_ledger.does: When ON, an approved GRN, issue slip, count sheet, transfer challan or factory sheet adds its lines to the stock ledger. Each form also has its own switch.
rule:forms_post_to_ledger.why: It makes the paper forms the source of stock.
rule:forms_post_to_ledger.change: ON locks four stock screens: issue, transfer, count and production. They are refused with path_locked unless you set the path on the path switches page.
rule:forms_post_to_ledger.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:item_similar_check_on.title: Similar-name and barcode check when adding an item
rule:item_similar_check_on.does: When ON, adding a new item first checks the name against existing items. An exact same name is refused, and a barcode already in use is refused. A look-alike name is shown and the person presses again to add anyway.
rule:item_similar_check_on.why: Stops the same product being entered twice under small spelling differences.
rule:item_similar_check_on.default: OFF. Items are added exactly as before.
rule:item_similar_check_on.change: Nothing already saved changes. Only new items are checked.

rule:journal_attach_over.title: A manual journal above this total needs an attachment
rule:journal_attach_over.does: Above this total in Tk, a manual journal must carry a photo or file reference.
rule:journal_attach_over.why: A big manual entry should have paper behind it.
rule:journal_attach_over.change: A number sets the limit. Journals already posted do not change.
rule:journal_attach_over.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:journal_control_acct_mode.title: Manual journal on a cash, bank, receivable, payable or inventory account
rule:journal_control_acct_mode.does: allow: as today. request: a journal by someone who is not the owner waits for the approver. block: refused unless the owner allows one exception.
rule:journal_control_acct_mode.why: A manual journal can move profit between periods or hide a shortage.
rule:journal_control_acct_mode.change: request holds the journal until the approver decides, and journals already posted do not change. A journal that does not balance is refused first.
rule:journal_control_acct_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:journal_control_prefixes.title: Chart codes that count as control accounts
rule:journal_control_prefixes.does: A comma list of chart code beginnings. The default is 11 (cash, bank, wallets), 1210 (customer receivables), 13 (inventory) and 2100 (supplier payables).
rule:journal_control_prefixes.why: It decides which accounts the journal control watches.
rule:journal_control_prefixes.change: A change affects new journals only.
rule:journal_control_prefixes.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:journal_loc_check.title: Check the place of every line of a manual journal
rule:journal_loc_check.does: When ON, a person may post a manual journal line only to a place they may use. A line with no place needs the all-places right.
rule:journal_loc_check.why: A branch accountant should not post across the company.
rule:journal_loc_check.change: ON refuses manual journals that break it. Journals already posted do not change.
rule:journal_loc_check.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:journal_sched_post_cap.title: Most documents one scheduled run may post
rule:journal_sched_post_cap.does: A batch size. Documents over it wait for the next run, oldest first.
rule:journal_sched_post_cap.why: One run should not take too long.
rule:journal_sched_post_cap.default: 1500, the same batch as Post now.
rule:journal_sched_post_cap.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:journal_sched_post_lookback_days.title: Scheduled posting: look back this many days
rule:journal_sched_post_lookback_days.does: Each run looks only at the last N days. Older leftovers need Post now.
rule:journal_sched_post_lookback_days.why: A shorter look-back makes each run faster.
rule:journal_sched_post_lookback_days.default: Blank. Every document since the start date is scanned.
rule:journal_sched_post_lookback_days.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:journal_sched_post_on.title: Post new documents to the books on a schedule
rule:journal_sched_post_on.does: OFF: the books fill only when someone presses Post now or opens Accounts. ON: the 30-minute notify job posts waiting documents by itself.
rule:journal_sched_post_on.why: The books stay fresh even if nobody opens Accounts.
rule:journal_sched_post_on.change: ON needs Accounting on and a start date, and it posts what Post now would post. Documents in a closed period are held back.
rule:journal_sched_post_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:journal_sched_post_types.title: Scheduled posting: only these source types
rule:journal_sched_post_types.does: A comma list such as sale,sale_return. Types left out are still posted by Post now.
rule:journal_sched_post_types.why: It lets you start with a few kinds of document.
rule:journal_sched_post_types.change: A list limits what the schedule posts.
rule:journal_sched_post_types.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:journal_stale_warn_hours.title: Warn when waiting documents are not posted for this many hours
rule:journal_stale_warn_hours.does: The "last posted at" strip turns red when documents wait and nothing was posted for this long.
rule:journal_stale_warn_hours.why: You see a stuck posting early.
rule:journal_stale_warn_hours.default: Blank. The strip never turns red by itself.
rule:journal_stale_warn_hours.change: A number of hours from 1 to 8760.
rule:journal_stale_warn_hours.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:kpi_alert_discount_pct.title: Alert when a day's discount is more than this % of the sales before discount
rule:kpi_alert_discount_pct.does: Lists a place and day as an alert when the discount given was above this share of the sales before discount.
rule:kpi_alert_discount_pct.why: Heavy discounting on one day is easy to miss in a daily total.
rule:kpi_alert_discount_pct.change: The KPI tab lists the alert days. Display only.

rule:kpi_alert_sales_drop_pct.title: Alert when a day's sales fall by more than this %
rule:kpi_alert_sales_drop_pct.does: Compares a place's sales of one day with the average of the previous 4 same weekdays (at least 2 are needed) and lists the day as an alert when it is lower by more than this percentage.
rule:kpi_alert_sales_drop_pct.why: A quiet day that nobody noticed is often the first sign of a problem at one shop.
rule:kpi_alert_sales_drop_pct.default: Blank. No sales-drop alert is shown.
rule:kpi_alert_sales_drop_pct.change: The KPI trend (Targets, KPI & comparison, tab KPI) lists the alert days. Nothing is blocked, posted or sent; it only draws a list.

rule:kpi_alert_void_n.title: Alert when a place voids more than this many sales in one day
rule:kpi_alert_void_n.does: Lists a place and day as an alert when the number of voided sales is above this count. 0 means any void is listed.
rule:kpi_alert_void_n.why: Voids are where cash can go missing.
rule:kpi_alert_void_n.change: The KPI tab lists the alert days. Display only.

rule:late_sale_policy.title: Offline sale older than the offline limit
rule:late_sale_policy.does: redate: the sale takes the time it reached the server. redate_flag: same, and a line goes to the Exceptions list. park: the sale is held for the owner, who accepts it with its own time, re-dates it or rejects it.
rule:late_sale_policy.why: A sale made offline days ago should not slide into today without a trace.
rule:late_sale_policy.change: park holds the sale, with no receipt and no entry in the books until it is accepted. Past figures never change.
rule:late_sale_policy.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:lock_backward_policy.title: Moving the lock date back
rule:lock_backward_policy.does: allow: any time. reason_after_year_close: moving the date back into a closed year needs a written reopen reason. reason_always: any move back needs a reason.
rule:lock_backward_policy.why: Moving the lock back reopens closed months.
rule:lock_backward_policy.change: The stricter choices ask for a reason on each move back. Past figures never change.
rule:lock_backward_policy.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:mapping_type_guard.title: Check the account type when a mapping is changed
rule:mapping_type_guard.does: When ON, a mapping key (for example sales) may only point to the account types listed for it (for example income).
rule:mapping_type_guard.why: A wrong mapping can post to the wrong kind of account.
rule:mapping_type_guard.change: ON refuses a mapping to the wrong type and leaves existing mappings alone. The owner can edit the list of types.
rule:mapping_type_guard.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:marketing_post_from.title: Marketing spend is posted from this date
rule:marketing_post_from.does: The first date an 17-1 line may be posted.
rule:marketing_post_from.why: Stops old months from being posted into closed books.
rule:marketing_post_from.default: Blank. The switch above cannot be turned on.
rule:marketing_post_from.change: Lines dated before it are never posted.

rule:marketing_post_on.title: Post the marketing spend of form 17-1 to the books
rule:marketing_post_on.does: When ON, approved 17-1 lines paid from bank, mobile or card are written to the journal (Dr marketing expense, Cr bank or mobile), except lines that look like the same spend already in a 11-1 voucher or quick expense, which wait for a person's decision.
rule:marketing_post_on.why: Today marketing spend in 17-1 never reaches the journal profit.
rule:marketing_post_on.change: Switch it ON only after setting the start date below. Use the 'Post to the books' tab: Dry run first, then Post now.
rule:marketing_post_on.who: Only the owner (Settings). Posting is run by the accounts manager.

rule:mi_ai_summary_on.title: Let the AI summariser propose a summary of chosen findings
rule:mi_ai_summary_on.does: Lets the AI assistant write a short proposed summary of findings you selected. The proposal waits for a person to accept or reject it.
rule:mi_ai_summary_on.why: Long sources are slow to read.
rule:mi_ai_summary_on.default: OFF. No AI call is made.
rule:mi_ai_summary_on.change: ON: the assistant may propose text only. It never creates a finding, an opportunity or a price, and never publishes.
rule:mi_ai_summary_on.who: Only the owner, in Settings. Every change is written to the change log.

rule:mi_alerts_on.title: Put competitor price alerts in the in-app notifications
rule:mi_alerts_on.does: Adds one line a day to the owner's notifications when competitor prices moved beyond the threshold.
rule:mi_alerts_on.why: The owner sees the alert without opening the Market page.
rule:mi_alerts_on.default: OFF. Alerts are only listed on the Market page.
rule:mi_alerts_on.change: ON: one in-app line per day with the count of items that moved. It has no customer data.
rule:mi_alerts_on.who: Only the owner, in Settings. Every change is written to the change log.

rule:mi_digest_on.title: Weekly growth and market digest to the owner (in-app)
rule:mi_digest_on.does: Writes one in-app line for the owner with the top sales movers, open opportunities and the number of price alerts, when the weekly job runs it.
rule:mi_digest_on.why: A short weekly summary keeps the owner on the numbers without a long report.
rule:mi_digest_on.change: ON: the digest is written when the scheduled job (a later package) runs it. It has numbers from our own sales only and is not sent outside the app.
rule:mi_digest_on.who: Only the owner, in Settings. Every change is written to the change log.

rule:mi_elast_min_days.title: Minimum trading days at each price before a price-response hint is shown
rule:mi_elast_min_days.does: Sets how many trading days a price must have been charged before we compare how many units sold at that price.
rule:mi_elast_min_days.why: A price that was charged for one day says nothing.
rule:mi_elast_min_days.default: Blank. No price-response hint is shown.
rule:mi_elast_min_days.change: A number lets the Growth page show the past pattern, with the days behind it, when at least two prices meet the minimum. It never changes a price.
rule:mi_elast_min_days.who: Only the owner, in Settings. Every change is written to the change log.

rule:mi_on.title: Market intelligence workspace (research, findings, opportunities)
rule:mi_on.does: Turns on the Market page: research topics, source registry, findings you type in, competitor prices, opportunities with evidence and decisions, and measuring them from our own sales.
rule:mi_on.why: It keeps what we learn about competitors, prices, festivals and customers in one place, with the source and the date, instead of in people's heads.
rule:mi_on.default: OFF. The Market page is empty and nothing can be written. Nothing is searched on the internet by this switch.
rule:mi_on.change: ON: people with the market rights can add topics, sources, findings and prices. Opportunities can be recorded and moved through their statuses; every move asks for a reason that is kept for ever.
rule:mi_on.who: Only the owner, in Settings (the Rules page). Every change is written to the change log.

rule:mi_quote_max_chars.title: Longest quoted snippet kept from a source (characters)
rule:mi_quote_max_chars.does: Sets how many characters of a source may be kept as a direct quote on a finding.
rule:mi_quote_max_chars.why: Keeping only short quotes and our own summary respects the source and keeps the record useful.
rule:mi_quote_max_chars.default: Blank. Quotes are not stored; write your own summary only.
rule:mi_quote_max_chars.change: A number lets quotes up to that length be saved. Longer quotes are refused with a message.
rule:mi_quote_max_chars.who: Only the owner, in Settings. Every change is written to the change log.

rule:mi_research_job_on.title: Run scheduled research jobs
rule:mi_research_job_on.does: Lets the job runner (a later package) run the research jobs that are switched on.
rule:mi_research_job_on.why: A job is only useful when it runs on its own.
rule:mi_research_job_on.default: OFF. Job definitions can be stored; none runs.
rule:mi_research_job_on.change: ON: the research gate is checked before each run. A job still needs its source and the fetch switch above.
rule:mi_research_job_on.who: Only the owner, in Settings. Every change is written to the change log.

rule:mi_scrape_on.title: Allow scheduled research to fetch a permitted source
rule:mi_scrape_on.does: Lets a scheduled research job read a public page from a source, but only when the owner has allowed that source after reading its terms, the robots.txt check passed and a rate limit is typed.
rule:mi_scrape_on.why: Reading a permitted page on a schedule saves hours.
rule:mi_scrape_on.default: OFF. No job fetches anything. Even ON, each source stays closed until the owner allows it.
rule:mi_scrape_on.change: ON: the research gate opens only for sources that meet every condition. OFF again: every job stops at once, whatever the source settings.
rule:mi_scrape_on.who: Only the owner, in Settings. Every change is written to the change log.

rule:mi_watch_threshold_pct.title: Alert when a competitor price moves by more than this %
rule:mi_watch_threshold_pct.does: Lists each competitor price that moved more than this percentage since its previous observation.
rule:mi_watch_threshold_pct.why: A big competitor price move is worth a look the same day.
rule:mi_watch_threshold_pct.change: A number lists the moves on the Market page's price tab. Nothing is sent to customers.
rule:mi_watch_threshold_pct.who: Only the owner, in Settings. Every change is written to the change log.

rule:mkt_repeat_days.title: Repeat purchase window after a promotion (days)
rule:mkt_repeat_days.does: How many days after a promotion ended a later bill counts as a repeat purchase.
rule:mkt_repeat_days.why: A repeat-purchase figure is meaningless without saying how long we waited.
rule:mkt_repeat_days.default: Blank. The report asks the person to type the days; nothing is assumed.
rule:mkt_repeat_days.change: With a number set, the report uses it when no days are typed.

rule:open_parties_adjust_mode.title: Who decides a change of an opening due
rule:open_parties_adjust_mode.does: direct: a person with Accounts manage adjusts at once, with a reason. approval: a second person decides.
rule:open_parties_adjust_mode.why: It lets you add a second pair of eyes on old dues.
rule:open_parties_adjust_mode.change: approval: the maker never decides. The owner's own request follows the owner approval setting.
rule:open_parties_adjust_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:open_parties_freeze.title: Lock opening dues after the opening batch
rule:open_parties_freeze.does: After an opening batch is posted, a direct change of an opening due or payable is refused.
rule:open_parties_freeze.why: It stops old dues from being edited quietly after go-live.
rule:open_parties_freeze.default: off. Changes are allowed, as today.
rule:open_parties_freeze.change: Set to after_opening: you must use an adjustment with a reason. Each adjustment writes a balanced entry, an audit line and a yellow Exceptions row.
rule:open_parties_freeze.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:open_parties_link.title: Count opening dues in customer balances
rule:open_parties_link.does: When ON, the old due you typed is added to the customer balance, the credit limit check, the dues list and the ledger. The customer can then pay it. The opening batch also fills the party list from the posted figures.
rule:open_parties_link.why: Without it, a customer who owed money before go-live cannot be collected.
rule:open_parties_link.default: OFF. Customer balances come from sales, collections and returns only.
rule:open_parties_link.change: ON adds the opening due to customer balances from then on. Entries already posted do not change.
rule:open_parties_link.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:order_advance_post_from.title: Post advances only for orders created on or after
rule:order_advance_post_from.does: A start day for advance posting (YYYY-MM-DD).
rule:order_advance_post_from.why: Protects history: earlier orders are never touched.
rule:order_advance_post_from.default: Blank. With the switch on, every open order.
rule:order_advance_post_from.change: Orders created before the day are left exactly as they are.

rule:order_advance_post_on.title: Post an order advance as a customer advance
rule:order_advance_post_on.does: Records the advance taken on an app order in the books the day it is taken (cash, bank or mobile in; account 2300 customer advance). At delivery the advance is applied to the sale.
rule:order_advance_post_on.why: Today the advance reaches the books only when the order is delivered, and never if the order is cancelled, so the books and the day book miss money that is in the till.
rule:order_advance_post_on.default: Off. The advance reaches the books at delivery, as today.
rule:order_advance_post_on.change: On: a person with the cash right records the advance; delivery then collects only what is left and applies the advance. Day book, journal and the advance list show it from the first day.

rule:order_late_grace_minutes.title: Minutes of grace before a delivery counts as late
rule:order_late_grace_minutes.does: Adds a grace to the end of the promised slot before the on-time report calls a delivery late.
rule:order_late_grace_minutes.why: Some owners allow a few minutes; the system does not guess a number for you.
rule:order_late_grace_minutes.default: Blank. Late means after the end of the promised slot, with no grace.
rule:order_late_grace_minutes.change: A number such as 15 makes a delivery up to 15 minutes after the slot still on time. Only the reports change.

rule:order_promise_required.title: A promised time slot is needed before an app order is confirmed
rule:order_promise_required.does: Stops an app order from being confirmed until a promised time slot (from and to) is written.
rule:order_promise_required.why: Without a promised time nobody can say whether a delivery was on time.
rule:order_promise_required.default: Off. Orders are confirmed as today.
rule:order_promise_required.change: On: confirming an order with no slot is refused with a clear message. Nothing else changes.

rule:order_refund_record_on.title: Record the refund of a cancelled order advance as real money
rule:order_refund_record_on.does: When a cancelled order's advance is to be refunded, makes a refund record. A person who may move money pays it: cash, bank or mobile goes out and the books follow.
rule:order_refund_record_on.why: Today choosing 'refund' writes nothing, so a refund can be promised and never paid, or paid with no record.
rule:order_refund_record_on.default: Off. Choosing refund writes no money record, as today.
rule:order_refund_record_on.change: On: every refund has a record (due or paid). If the advance was never recorded, the cash-in and the cash-out both appear on the day it was found, netting to zero.

rule:other_income_from.title: Other income counts from this date
rule:other_income_from.does: An entry dated before this day is refused. Type it as YYYY-MM-DD.
rule:other_income_from.change: A date closes older days to this entry. Past figures never change.
rule:other_income_from.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:other_income_on.title: Other income entry (scrap, old oil, rent received)
rule:other_income_on.does: OFF: the Other income screen refuses entries. ON: staff with the cash move permission can record money that is not a sale.
rule:other_income_on.why: It keeps the entry closed until the owner is ready.
rule:other_income_on.change: ON opens the entry for new records. Nothing already posted changes.
rule:other_income_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:owner_approval_mode.title: Approval of the owner's own entries
rule:owner_approval_mode.does: Chooses who approves the owner's own entries. self: the owner approves. named: a named role or named people approve; logged: the owner approves and it always shows in the log; off: the control is off.
rule:owner_approval_mode.why: It lets someone else check the owner's own entries.
rule:owner_approval_mode.default: self. The owner approves, as today.
rule:owner_approval_mode.change: named needs an active approver who is not the owner, and the approver is never the maker. Entries already decided do not change.
rule:owner_approval_mode.who: Only the owner, through the approval setter. Every change is an audit line.

rule:owner_approver_role.title: Named approver role
rule:owner_approver_role.does: The role whose holders approve the owner's entries when the mode is named.
rule:owner_approver_role.why: Named mode cannot work without an approver.
rule:owner_approver_role.default: Blank. Named mode is refused until a role or people are set.
rule:owner_approver_role.change: The owner cannot name a role the owner holds. Entries already decided do not change.
rule:owner_approver_role.who: Only the owner, through the approval setter.

rule:owner_approver_users.title: Named approver people
rule:owner_approver_users.does: One or more people who approve the owner's entries when the mode is named. They work instead of the role, or with it.
rule:owner_approver_users.why: You can name a person without making a whole role.
rule:owner_approver_users.change: The owner cannot name himself. Entries already decided do not change.
rule:owner_approver_users.who: Only the owner, through the approval setter.

rule:owner_closed_period_mode.title: Owner in a closed period
rule:owner_closed_period_mode.does: off: the owner can change closed dates silently. log: allowed, and each use goes to the Exceptions list. reason: refused until the owner opens an override window with a written reason.
rule:owner_closed_period_mode.why: A lock the owner can pass in silence is not a close.
rule:owner_closed_period_mode.default: off. The owner is silent, as today.
rule:owner_closed_period_mode.change: reason makes the owner write a reason first, and each use adds an audit line and an Exceptions row. Past figures never change.
rule:owner_closed_period_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:owner_money_entry_mode.title: Who may record an owner draw or an owner top-up
rule:owner_money_entry_mode.does: open: anyone with the cash move right. approval: an entry by someone who is not the owner waits for the approver. owner: only the owner.
rule:owner_money_entry_mode.why: Owner drawings can hide a theft.
rule:owner_money_entry_mode.change: approval holds the entry, so it is not posted and not in the day book until approved. Entries already saved do not change.
rule:owner_money_entry_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:owner_self_approve.title: Owner may approve own requests
rule:owner_self_approve.does: When ON, the owner can approve the owner's own list requests, releases, emergencies, item changes and entry change requests.
rule:owner_self_approve.why: It decides if the owner needs a second person for these requests.
rule:owner_self_approve.change: While the approval mode is named, it cannot be switched ON. It can be switched OFF only while another approver exists.
rule:owner_self_approve.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:partner_accrue_at.title: Book the partner profit at
rule:partner_accrue_at.does: approval: the debt is booked when the settlement is approved. payment: it is booked only when it is paid.
rule:partner_accrue_at.why: The owner decides when the profit becomes a debt.
rule:partner_accrue_at.change: A settlement keeps the basis it was first posted with. Settlements already posted do not change.
rule:partner_accrue_at.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:partner_settlement_post_on.title: Post partner profit shares to the books
rule:partner_settlement_post_on.does: OFF: nothing is posted, as today. ON: an approved settlement and its payments are posted to the books.
rule:partner_settlement_post_on.why: Partner profit should be in the books.
rule:partner_settlement_post_on.change: ON posts approved settlements. A settlement keeps the basis it was first posted with.
rule:partner_settlement_post_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:party_request_approver_mode.title: Who decides supplier payment requests
rule:party_request_approver_mode.does: Same as the staff setting (same), or the owner, one role, or one named person.
rule:party_request_approver_mode.why: A different approver for supplier payments is possible.
rule:party_request_approver_mode.change: Set it on the Pay request settings screen.

rule:party_request_approver_role.title: Approver role for supplier payment requests
rule:party_request_approver_role.does: The role code whose holders decide supplier payment requests when the mode is role.
rule:party_request_approver_role.change: Set through the Pay request settings screen, not directly.

rule:party_request_approver_user.title: Approver person for supplier payment requests
rule:party_request_approver_user.does: The one named person who decides supplier payment requests when the mode is user.
rule:party_request_approver_user.change: Set through the Pay request settings screen, not directly.

rule:party_requests_on.title: Staff can ask for a supplier payment in the app
rule:party_requests_on.does: When ON, staff with a place send a supplier payment request (supplier, amount, which bill or due, date needed). One responsible person decides.
rule:party_requests_on.why: Supplier payments get a written request and decision.
rule:party_requests_on.default: OFF. Supplier payments are made as today.
rule:party_requests_on.change: ON: the supplier request screen opens. Payments already made never change.

rule:party_requests_required.title: No supplier payment without an approved request
rule:party_requests_required.does: When ON, a supplier payment (not made with a bill) is refused unless an approved, due request backs it. The same exception rule applies as for staff pay.
rule:party_requests_required.change: ON: payments made on the old screen are accepted when a matching request exists.

rule:pay_capture_on.title: Write down bKash, Nagad and Rocket payments
rule:pay_capture_on.does: Lets the counter write a mobile payment: the Trx-ID, sender number, amount and time, against an order, a sale or an advance.
rule:pay_capture_on.default: Off. Nothing can be written; the screens say the module is off.
rule:pay_capture_on.change: On: a Trx-ID already written is refused. Each capture gets a flag (ok, overpay, underpay, no target) and waits for a second person to verify it.

rule:pay_capture_tol.title: Taka difference allowed when matching a payment
rule:pay_capture_tol.does: The number of taka a payment may differ from the amount due before it is flagged as overpay or underpay.
rule:pay_capture_tol.why: Small differences from fees or rounding can be let through; big ones must be looked at.
rule:pay_capture_tol.default: Blank. The amount must match exactly. No number is assumed.
rule:pay_capture_tol.change: A number such as 5 lets a payment within 5 taka of the due amount be flagged ok. Only the flag changes; nothing is posted.

rule:pay_request_advance_ceiling.title: Highest open advance for one staff member
rule:pay_request_advance_ceiling.does: Open advances plus open advance requests plus the new one may not pass this amount. Blank means no ceiling.
rule:pay_request_advance_ceiling.why: Keeps the total owed by one person under a number the owner chose.
rule:pay_request_advance_ceiling.change: A request that would pass the amount is refused. Advances already given never change.

rule:pay_request_approver_mode.title: Who decides staff pay requests
rule:pay_request_approver_mode.does: The owner (default), everyone with one role, or one named person decides salary and advance requests. The owner can always decide. The person who asks never decides his own request.
rule:pay_request_approver_mode.why: One responsible person keeps decisions clear.
rule:pay_request_approver_mode.change: Set it on the Pay request settings screen; the role and person keys cannot be changed one by one from the browser.

rule:pay_request_approver_role.title: Approver role for staff pay requests
rule:pay_request_approver_role.does: The role code whose holders decide staff pay requests when the approver mode is role.
rule:pay_request_approver_role.change: Set through the Pay request settings screen, not directly.

rule:pay_request_approver_user.title: Approver person for staff pay requests
rule:pay_request_approver_user.does: The one named person who decides staff pay requests when the approver mode is user.
rule:pay_request_approver_user.change: Set through the Pay request settings screen, not directly.

rule:pay_request_exception_mode.title: Payment without an approved request: how an exception works
rule:pay_request_exception_mode.does: When the policy is ON: reason = the payer writes why and the payment goes through, owner = only the owner may, never = no exception. Every exception is a line in the Exceptions list.
rule:pay_request_exception_mode.why: Keeps the rare urgent payment possible but visible.
rule:pay_request_exception_mode.change: Only matters while the request policy is ON.

rule:pay_request_max_per_month.title: Most requests one staff member may send in a month
rule:pay_request_max_per_month.does: A number. Blank means no limit.
rule:pay_request_max_per_month.change: A request over the limit is refused with a clear message.

rule:pay_requests_on.title: Staff can ask for salary or an advance in the app
rule:pay_requests_on.does: When ON, a staff member sends an amount, a reason and the date it is needed from his own login. One responsible person decides: approve (on the date asked or another date) or reject with a reason.
rule:pay_requests_on.why: Requests are written down with who decided and when, instead of being asked by word of mouth.
rule:pay_requests_on.default: OFF. The advance and payroll screens work exactly as today.
rule:pay_requests_on.change: ON: the request screens open for staff and the approver. Payments already made never change.

rule:pay_requests_required.title: No salary or advance payment without an approved request
rule:pay_requests_required.does: When ON, a salary or advance payment to a staff member is refused unless an approved, due request backs it. One exception with a written reason is possible and is written to the Exceptions list.
rule:pay_requests_required.why: Stops verbal requests from turning into payments nobody approved.
rule:pay_requests_required.default: OFF. Payments are made as today.
rule:pay_requests_required.change: ON: the old screens still work when a matching request exists (it is linked and marked paid); otherwise they say a request is needed.

rule:pay_requests_required_kinds.title: Which payments need a request
rule:pay_requests_required_kinds.does: Chooses what the policy covers: both, advance only, or salary only.
rule:pay_requests_required_kinds.why: Lets the owner start with one kind of payment.
rule:pay_requests_required_kinds.change: Only matters while the policy 'No salary or advance payment without an approved request' is ON.

rule:payroll_accrual_from.title: First month of salary accrual
rule:payroll_accrual_from.does: The first month booked as accrual. Type it as YYYY-MM-01.
rule:payroll_accrual_from.why: It stops old months from changing.
rule:payroll_accrual_from.default: Blank. Nothing is accrued, even if the switch is ON.
rule:payroll_accrual_from.change: A month sets where accrual starts. Earlier months keep the old posting.
rule:payroll_accrual_from.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:payroll_accrual_on.title: Book salary as a monthly accrual
rule:payroll_accrual_on.does: OFF: salary is a cost on the day it is paid. ON: an approved payroll run is booked at month end as a cost and as accrued salary, and paying it later clears the accrual.
rule:payroll_accrual_on.why: A month should carry its own salary cost.
rule:payroll_accrual_on.change: ON books from the first month you give, and earlier months keep the old posting. Switching never reverses entries already posted.
rule:payroll_accrual_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:period_closed_until.title: Books closed until
rule:period_closed_until.does: Anything dated up to this day needs permission to change. The date is typed.
rule:period_closed_until.why: It protects months you have already closed.
rule:period_closed_until.change: Setting a date closes everything on or before it for people without permission. Past figures never change.
rule:period_closed_until.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:period_lock_mode.title: Period lock: how the books are closed
rule:period_lock_mode.does: manual: the date typed in "Books closed until". auto: the month before locks by itself after a day you set, and the typed date still counts. off: no lock at all.
rule:period_lock_mode.why: It decides if closing a month is a manual job or automatic.
rule:period_lock_mode.change: auto with a blank day locks nothing by itself and cannot be saved, and off lets every date be changed. Past figures never change.
rule:period_lock_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:period_override_default_minutes.title: Override window: default length
rule:period_override_default_minutes.does: How long an override window stays open when no length is typed.
rule:period_override_default_minutes.why: A window should end by itself.
rule:period_override_default_minutes.change: A number from 5 to 1440 minutes. It affects new windows only.
rule:period_override_default_minutes.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:pos_offline_hours.title: How many hours an offline sale keeps its own time
rule:pos_offline_hours.does: A sale made on the phone without internet keeps its own time for this many hours. Older sales follow the late sale policy.
rule:pos_offline_hours.why: It sets what counts as a late sale.
rule:pos_offline_hours.change: A number of hours from 1 to 8760. It applies to sales saved after the change.
rule:pos_offline_hours.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:profit_loss_billopex.title: Profit counts running costs paid by supplier bill
rule:profit_loss_billopex.does: The consumable and unclassified part of posted purchase bills. A purchase return reduces it. It acts only while the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_billopex.why: Each loss can be counted or left out on its own.
rule:profit_loss_billopex.default: ON. It acts only after the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_billopex.change: OFF leaves this row out of the profit. Past figures follow the date setting.
rule:profit_loss_billopex.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:profit_loss_cashshort.title: Profit counts cash short and over
rule:profit_loss_cashshort.does: Approved cash short or over cases. A short booked as a staff receivable is not a loss. It acts only while the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_cashshort.why: Each loss can be counted or left out on its own.
rule:profit_loss_cashshort.default: ON. It acts only after the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_cashshort.change: OFF leaves this row out of the profit. Past figures follow the date setting.
rule:profit_loss_cashshort.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:profit_loss_count.title: Profit counts stock count shortages
rule:profit_loss_count.does: Stock a physical count found missing, at its ledger cost. A surplus is not valued. It acts only while the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_count.why: Each loss can be counted or left out on its own.
rule:profit_loss_count.default: ON. It acts only after the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_count.change: OFF leaves this row out of the profit. Past figures follow the date setting.
rule:profit_loss_count.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:profit_loss_transit.title: Profit counts goods lost in transit
rule:profit_loss_transit.does: Transit shortages that were written off. A claim to the carrier is not a loss until it is written off. It acts only while the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_transit.why: Each loss can be counted or left out on its own.
rule:profit_loss_transit.default: ON. It acts only after the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_transit.change: OFF leaves this row out of the profit. Past figures follow the date setting.
rule:profit_loss_transit.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:profit_loss_wastage.title: Profit counts wasted stock
rule:profit_loss_wastage.does: Stock written off as wastage, at its ledger cost. It acts only while the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_wastage.why: Each loss can be counted or left out on its own.
rule:profit_loss_wastage.default: ON. It acts only after the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_loss_wastage.change: OFF leaves this row out of the profit. Past figures follow the date setting.
rule:profit_loss_wastage.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:profit_losses_from.title: Count these extra profit rows from this date
rule:profit_losses_from.does: The extra profit rows count only from this date. Type it as YYYY-MM-DD.
rule:profit_losses_from.why: It keeps closed months as they were.
rule:profit_losses_from.default: Blank. Every date counts once the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_losses_from.change: A date keeps earlier months unchanged. A value that is not a date is ignored.
rule:profit_losses_from.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:profit_one_number_on.title: One profit number: count losses in the profit
rule:profit_one_number_on.does: Adds the losses to the management profit: wasted stock, count shortages, goods lost in transit, cash short and over, and running costs paid by supplier bill. It also takes factory overhead out once. Branches, the owner sheet, break-even and partner shares then use it.
rule:profit_one_number_on.why: Profit should show the losses that cost money.
rule:profit_one_number_on.default: OFF. Every profit figure stays as it is today.
rule:profit_one_number_on.change: ON adds the rows from the date set in "Count these extra profit rows from this date"; if that date is blank, earlier months change too. No journal entry is written.
rule:profit_one_number_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:profit_overhead_once.title: Profit counts factory overhead once
rule:profit_overhead_once.does: Overhead that conversion costing already put inside the cost of finished goods is taken out of the expenses.
rule:profit_overhead_once.why: Without it the overhead is counted twice.
rule:profit_overhead_once.default: ON. It acts only after the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_overhead_once.change: OFF counts the overhead twice when conversion costing is on. Past figures follow the date setting.
rule:profit_overhead_once.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:profit_source.title: Partner shares take the profit from
rule:profit_source.does: management: the management profit, one function for every report. ledger: the journal profit. It acts only while the main switch is ON.
rule:profit_source.why: Partner payouts need one agreed profit figure.
rule:profit_source.change: Choose ledger only when the journal is posted every day and two clean months agree. Every settlement stores the basis it used.
rule:profit_source.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:purchase_separate_poster.title: The person who wrote a bill cannot post it
rule:purchase_separate_poster.does: When ON, the person who wrote a purchase bill cannot post it. The owner is still allowed.
rule:purchase_separate_poster.why: Two people must touch a bill.
rule:purchase_separate_poster.change: ON refuses posting by the maker with poster_must_differ. Bills already posted do not change.
rule:purchase_separate_poster.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:receipt_bank_on.title: Accept bank transfer and cheque from customers
rule:receipt_bank_on.does: OFF: a customer payment can only be cash, mobile or card. ON: bank transfer and cheque are accepted on due collections and POS split payments.
rule:receipt_bank_on.why: The books then show the bank account the money really reached.
rule:receipt_bank_on.change: ON adds bank rows to the payment screens. Old payments are not changed.
rule:receipt_bank_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:receipt_expiry_required.title: Lot expiry date required
rule:receipt_expiry_required.does: Also requires the expiry date printed on the supplier's lot.
rule:receipt_expiry_required.why: Expiry lists are silent about stock with no expiry.
rule:receipt_expiry_required.change: A stock line without an expiry date is refused at posting (together with the lot switch).

rule:receipt_lot_required.title: Supplier lot number required on a purchase bill
rule:receipt_lot_required.does: Makes the supplier's lot or batch number compulsory on every stock line before a purchase bill can be posted.
rule:receipt_lot_required.why: Without a lot number a bad delivery cannot be traced to the products and outlets it reached.
rule:receipt_lot_required.change: A bill with a stock line and no lot number is refused at posting. Needs the server hook; the screen asks either way.

rule:receipt_ref_from.title: The reference rule counts from this date
rule:receipt_ref_from.does: A payment dated before this day is never asked for a number. Type it as YYYY-MM-DD.
rule:receipt_ref_from.why: An old figure is never touched.
rule:receipt_ref_from.default: Blank. The rule counts at once.
rule:receipt_ref_from.change: A date protects older payments. Past figures never change.
rule:receipt_ref_from.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:receipt_ref_required.title: Reference number needed on customer bank receipts
rule:receipt_ref_required.does: off: never. bank: a bank or cheque receipt needs a transaction or cheque number. bank_mobile: mobile wallet receipts need one too.
rule:receipt_ref_required.why: A reference lets you match the bank statement.
rule:receipt_ref_required.change: A missing number can be waived with a written reason. Payments before the "from" date are never asked.
rule:receipt_ref_required.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:recog_image_match_on.title: Match a photo to approved item photos (on the phone)
rule:recog_image_match_on.does: When ON, a photo is compared with the approved item photos stored on this phone and the nearest items are listed with their distance. Nothing leaves the phone.
rule:recog_image_match_on.why: Helps find an item when there is no barcode or readable label.
rule:recog_image_match_on.change: Needs an item photo index on the phone and a distance limit. Until both exist the list stays empty and says why.
rule:recog_image_match_on.warn: No model is installed in this version: the list stays empty.

rule:recog_image_threshold.title: Photo match distance limit
rule:recog_image_threshold.does: Only items whose photo distance is at or below this number are listed. Smaller is stricter. The distance is a number, never a percentage.
rule:recog_image_threshold.why: Stops unrelated items from being suggested.
rule:recog_image_threshold.default: Blank. Blank = not set: no photo candidates are shown.
rule:recog_image_threshold.change: Changing it affects the next photo only.

rule:recog_ocr_langs.title: Languages to read
rule:recog_ocr_langs.does: The language files to use, written like eng+ben (English and Bangla). Each language is one file downloaded once.
rule:recog_ocr_langs.why: Bangla labels need the Bangla file; English labels need the English file.
rule:recog_ocr_langs.change: A new language downloads its file the next time it is used.

rule:recog_ocr_max_px.title: Label photo longest side in pixels
rule:recog_ocr_max_px.does: The label photo is made smaller to this longest side before reading. Smaller is faster on old phones but reads less small print.
rule:recog_ocr_max_px.why: Old phones run out of memory with large photos.
rule:recog_ocr_max_px.default: Blank. Blank blocks label reading: no size is assumed.
rule:recog_ocr_max_px.change: Changing it affects the next read only.

rule:recog_ocr_on.title: Read label text on the phone (OCR)
rule:recog_ocr_on.does: When ON, a label photo is read on this phone by the Tesseract engine. The text is shown for review; nothing is saved from it. The photo never leaves the phone.
rule:recog_ocr_on.why: Lets staff find an item from the words on a packet without typing.
rule:recog_ocr_on.change: The first use downloads the chosen language file once (Wi-Fi only while the Wi-Fi switch is on). Nothing is saved automatically.
rule:recog_ocr_on.who: Only the owner (Settings). The camera screen shows whether the phone can run it.

rule:recog_ocr_wifi_only.title: Download language files on Wi-Fi only
rule:recog_ocr_wifi_only.does: When ON, a language file that is not on the phone is downloaded only on Wi-Fi. A file already on the phone is always used.
rule:recog_ocr_wifi_only.why: The language files are several megabytes; mobile data is paid for.

rule:recog_vision_budget.title: Vision service monthly call cap
rule:recog_vision_budget.does: The most calls to the vision service in one month. When reached, no more calls are made until next month.
rule:recog_vision_budget.default: Blank. Blank = the service does not run.
rule:recog_vision_budget.change: Changing it applies from the next call.

rule:recog_vision_consent_on.title: Consent to send label photos to the server vision service
rule:recog_vision_consent_on.does: The owner confirms that label photos may be sent to the paid vision service. Without this, no photo is sent.
rule:recog_vision_consent_on.why: Photos can show customers and suppliers; the owner must agree.
rule:recog_vision_consent_on.change: Turning it off stops all sending at once.

rule:recog_vision_on.title: Server vision service (paid, needs consent)
rule:recog_vision_on.does: Would send a label photo to a server vision service for label suggestions. It also needs the consent switch and the monthly cap, and the X1 connection.
rule:recog_vision_on.why: Better reading for hard photos, at a cost.
rule:recog_vision_on.change: Not available yet: the X1 connection is not built, so this stays inactive.
rule:recog_vision_on.warn: Costs money. Photos leave the phone when this is ON and consent is given.

rule:report_cash_short_by_case_on.title: Cash short/over report follows the shortage case
rule:report_cash_short_by_case_on.does: The cash short and over report leaves out sheets whose shortage case was rejected or voided, and shows how many cases are open, approved, rejected and void.
rule:report_cash_short_by_case_on.why: The owner's decision on a shortage case should be visible in the report.
rule:report_cash_short_by_case_on.default: OFF. The report counts the flag of every daily sheet (06-1) as today.
rule:report_cash_short_by_case_on.change: Rejected and voided cases no longer add to the figures.

rule:report_cf_opening_through.title: Cash-flow statement: journals up to this date are opening balances
rule:report_cf_opening_through.does: Journals dated on or before this date are shown as opening balances, not as cash inflows.
rule:report_cf_opening_through.why: If the opening balances were typed as an ordinary manual journal, they would otherwise look like a big cash inflow.
rule:report_cf_opening_through.default: Blank. Only journals of the kind 'opening balances' are left out.
rule:report_cf_opening_through.change: Those journals move to the 'opening balances in the period' line. The closing cash does not change.

rule:report_compliance_closed_days.title: Weekly closed days for the compliance report
rule:report_compliance_closed_days.does: Weekly days on which a place is closed (for example fri or fri,sat).
rule:report_compliance_closed_days.why: A closed day is not a missing form.
rule:report_compliance_closed_days.default: Blank. No weekly closed day (the holidays list is always used once a start date is set).
rule:report_compliance_closed_days.change: Those weekdays are left out of the missing-form count. Acts only when the start date above is set.

rule:report_compliance_from.title: Forms are required from this date (rollout start)
rule:report_compliance_from.does: The compliance report counts a form as missing only for days from this date.
rule:report_compliance_from.why: Without a start date every calendar day since the beginning counts as a missing form, which overstates the gap.
rule:report_compliance_from.default: Blank. The report counts every calendar day as before and says so.
rule:report_compliance_from.change: Only days from the date count; holidays and the weekly closed days are left out.

rule:report_expense_parity_on.title: Expense report counts quick expenses and skips shadow vouchers
rule:report_expense_parity_on.does: When ON, the expense report and the weak-control report count what the profit report counts: quick expenses in, shadow vouchers out.
rule:report_expense_parity_on.why: The two reports should show one total.
rule:report_expense_parity_on.change: ON changes the expense report and the weak-control report. Journal entries already posted do not change.
rule:report_expense_parity_on.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:report_lapsed_days.title: Lapsed customers: look back this many days
rule:report_lapsed_days.does: A customer who bought within this many days before the period but not in it is lapsed.
rule:report_lapsed_days.why: Customers silent for longer than the number are not listed at all.
rule:report_lapsed_days.default: Blank. The built-in 180 days is used and the report says so.
rule:report_lapsed_days.change: The lapsed list gets longer or shorter.

rule:report_profit_blank_on.title: Profit shows 'not captured' when a part of it is missing
rule:report_profit_blank_on.does: On the Profit and loss reports (management view), a row whose expenses, salary, fixed cost or cost of goods were never captured shows 'not captured' in the profit column instead of a number.
rule:report_profit_blank_on.why: A profit that quietly leaves a missing cost out looks better than the truth.
rule:report_profit_blank_on.default: OFF. The profit number is exactly what it is today.
rule:report_profit_blank_on.change: Rows with a missing part show 'not captured' in the profit and profit % columns. The extra column profit_complete always says whether the row is complete.

rule:report_rfm_atrisk_days.title: At-risk customer: no purchase for more than this many days
rule:report_rfm_atrisk_days.does: How long without a purchase makes a customer at risk.
rule:report_rfm_atrisk_days.default: Blank. The built-in 60 days is used and the report says so.

rule:report_rfm_min_orders.title: Best customer: at least this many orders
rule:report_rfm_min_orders.does: The number of orders that makes a customer a best customer (Champion) in the customer segment report.
rule:report_rfm_min_orders.why: The number was written into the report; it is a business decision.
rule:report_rfm_min_orders.default: Blank. The report uses the number it always used (3) and says it was not set by the owner.
rule:report_rfm_min_orders.change: The segment changes for customers near the line.

rule:report_rfm_recent_days.title: Best customer: last purchase within this many days
rule:report_rfm_recent_days.does: How recent the last purchase must be for a best customer.
rule:report_rfm_recent_days.why: Same reason: an owner decision, not a code constant.
rule:report_rfm_recent_days.default: Blank. The built-in 30 days is used and the report says so.
rule:report_rfm_recent_days.change: The segment changes for customers near the line.

rule:report_salary_source.title: Salary in the profit comes from
rule:report_salary_source.does: legacy: the 21-1 salary sheet. app_first: app payroll runs are the main source and the sheet is used only where no counted run exists.
rule:report_salary_source.why: A salary should be counted once.
rule:report_salary_source.change: app_first reads payroll runs first. Journal entries already posted do not change.
rule:report_salary_source.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:report_top_customers_n.title: How many top customers are listed
rule:report_top_customers_n.does: Number of customers shown in "What the top customers buy".
rule:report_top_customers_n.why: Keeps the list short enough for a phone.
rule:report_top_customers_n.change: A number from 1 to 200 changes the length of the list.

rule:reports_cost_basis.title: Report cost basis
rule:reports_cost_basis.does: Chooses where item sales, category sales, sales summary, combined sales and the business page take the cost of goods from.
rule:reports_cost_basis.why: Two cost bases made the same item show "-" in one report and a margin in another.
rule:reports_cost_basis.default: price_list: only the cost typed in the item master, exactly as before.
rule:reports_cost_basis.change: ledger_first: the cost from the stock ledger (what the goods really cost) first; the typed cost only where the ledger has none, and that part is called an estimate. Lines with no cost anywhere stay empty, never 0.

rule:reports_net_of_returns.title: Sales figures are net of sale returns (existing setting, now also used here)
rule:reports_net_of_returns.does: The new "after returns" columns, the festival comparison and the top-customer list follow this setting.
rule:reports_net_of_returns.change: Off: the "after returns" columns equal the old columns and a note says returns are shown only for information.

rule:return_expired_restock.title: Goods from an expired batch
rule:return_expired_restock.does: allow: they go back on the shelf. writeoff: they are written off automatically. block: the return is refused unless there is an override.
rule:return_expired_restock.why: Expired goods should not be sold again.
rule:return_expired_restock.change: writeoff books the goods as wastage with reason customer_return. Past returns do not change.
rule:return_expired_restock.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:return_needs_receipt.title: A sale return must show the receipt number
rule:return_needs_receipt.does: When ON, the receipt number must be typed and must match the sale. A class can set its own choice.
rule:return_needs_receipt.why: It stops a return for a sale that did not happen.
rule:return_needs_receipt.default: OFF. Any return of a recorded sale is accepted.
rule:return_needs_receipt.change: ON refuses a return with no matching receipt unless the override is used. Returns already saved do not change.
rule:return_needs_receipt.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:return_window_hours.title: Return window (hours after the sale)
rule:return_window_hours.does: How many hours after a sale a return is accepted. It is used for every item class that has no window of its own.
rule:return_window_hours.why: A very old receipt should not be taken back.
rule:return_window_hours.change: Past the window, a return needs an override with a reason. Sales and returns already saved do not change.
rule:return_window_hours.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:salary_in_daily_off.title: Keep salary out of the daily profit
rule:salary_in_daily_off.does: ON: the daily profit leaves salary out and the month carries it. OFF: the daily profit report shows the month salary as a separate line.
rule:salary_in_daily_off.why: Salary is not a daily cost.
rule:salary_in_daily_off.change: OFF adds a separate salary line to the daily profit report. It is not shared out by day.
rule:salary_in_daily_off.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:salary_pay_source.title: Salary is paid from
rule:salary_pay_source.does: by_payment: the mode picked when paying. cash, mobile or bank: every salary payment goes to that account.
rule:salary_pay_source.why: It decides which money account a salary leaves.
rule:salary_pay_source.change: It affects entries not yet posted. Entries already posted do not change.
rule:salary_pay_source.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:shift_mates_on.title: Staff see who else is on at their place
rule:shift_mates_on.does: Under each of my shifts it lists the colleagues working the same day at the same place, with their times. Only names and shift times are shown.
rule:shift_mates_on.why: A person can see who is working with him and plan swaps.
rule:shift_mates_on.default: On, but it matters only after shift_on is on.
rule:shift_mates_on.change: Switch it off and a person sees only his own shifts and no colleague names.

rule:shift_on.title: Shift schedule is on (who works which shift)
rule:shift_on.does: Turns the shift schedule on or off. On lets staff see their own coming shifts and lets a designated person set the roster. Shift templates and the weekly pattern already in attendance are reused, not copied.
rule:shift_on.why: Staff learn their shifts from the app and the owner can compare the plan with attendance.
rule:shift_on.default: Off. No menu entry and no roster data, and attendance, leave and payroll work as before.
rule:shift_on.change: Turning it on shows My shifts to everyone and the roster to schedulers. Turning it off hides them and keeps every roster row.

rule:short_decider.title: Who decides cash short and transit short cases
rule:short_decider.does: owner: only the owner. accounts_manager: people with the Accounts manage grant can also decide. Nobody decides a count they made themselves.
rule:short_decider.why: The person who counted should not clear their own count.
rule:short_decider.change: accounts_manager widens the group that can decide. Decisions already made do not change.
rule:short_decider.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:social_max_per_day.title: Most posts per day
rule:social_max_per_day.does: The largest number of posts and customer messages that may be planned or sent in one Dhaka day.
rule:social_max_per_day.why: Stops a flood of posts that annoys followers and can get the page restricted.
rule:social_max_per_day.default: Blank. No post can be scheduled or published until a number is typed.
rule:social_max_per_day.change: A new schedule that would go over the number is refused with a day-limit message.

rule:social_max_per_hour.title: Most posts per hour
rule:social_max_per_hour.does: The largest number of posts and customer messages in one clock hour.
rule:social_max_per_hour.why: Spreads posts out so the page does not look like spam.
rule:social_max_per_hour.default: Blank. No post can be scheduled or published until a number is typed.
rule:social_max_per_hour.change: A schedule that would go over the number in its hour is refused.

rule:social_media_image_mb.title: Largest picture size (MB)
rule:social_media_image_mb.does: The biggest JPEG or PNG picture that may be attached to a post.
rule:social_media_image_mb.why: Large files are slow to upload and may be refused by the provider.
rule:social_media_image_mb.default: 5 MB. This is a proposed starting value, to be confirmed by the owner.
rule:social_media_image_mb.change: Bigger pictures are refused when they are added.

rule:social_media_video_mb.title: Largest video size (MB)
rule:social_media_video_mb.does: The biggest MP4 video that may be attached to a post.
rule:social_media_video_mb.why: Video uploads are slow on a weak connection.
rule:social_media_video_mb.default: 50 MB. This is a proposed starting value, to be confirmed by the owner.
rule:social_media_video_mb.change: Bigger videos are refused when they are added.

rule:social_on.title: Social and marketing workspace is on
rule:social_on.does: Turns on the content calendar, content items, the approval queue and the publishing screens. Nothing is posted by this switch alone.
rule:social_on.why: Keeps the social work in one place with an approval step before anything goes public.
rule:social_on.default: Off. No content can be written and no approval can be made.
rule:social_on.change: On: people with the write or approve right can prepare and approve content. Publishing still needs its own switch.

rule:social_publish_on.title: Publish approved posts automatically
rule:social_publish_on.does: Lets the publisher send approved posts to the connected pages and accounts at their scheduled time.
rule:social_publish_on.why: A post goes out on time without someone pressing a button, but only after a person approved it.
rule:social_publish_on.change: On: the publisher (run by GitHub Actions with the secrets you set) posts due items, within the limits and outside quiet hours. Off: due items wait.

rule:social_quiet_from.title: Quiet hours start (Dhaka time)
rule:social_quiet_from.does: The start of a window when no post and no customer message goes out. Written as HH:MM.
rule:social_quiet_from.why: Nobody wants a message at midnight.
rule:social_quiet_from.change: Scheduling inside the window is refused; the publisher waits until it is over.

rule:social_quiet_to.title: Quiet hours end (Dhaka time)
rule:social_quiet_to.does: The end of the quiet window. Written as HH:MM. An end earlier than the start means the window crosses midnight.
rule:social_quiet_to.why: Together with the start it defines when the page stays silent.
rule:social_quiet_to.change: As for the start: both must be written for the window to apply.

rule:social_retry_max.title: Most tries for one post
rule:social_retry_max.does: How many times the publisher tries a post that failed before it is marked failed.
rule:social_retry_max.why: A short problem with the provider heals itself; a long one must be seen by a person.
rule:social_retry_max.default: 5 tries. The waits grow: 2, 4, 8 and 16 minutes.
rule:social_retry_max.change: A failed post after its last try shows in the queue as failed and can be scheduled again by the approver.

rule:social_stop_all.title: Stop all publishing (emergency)
rule:social_stop_all.does: Stops every post and every customer message at once. Queued items wait; nothing is deleted.
rule:social_stop_all.why: A wrong post or a provider problem can be stopped in one step.
rule:social_stop_all.change: On: the publisher sends nothing and new schedules are refused until it is switched off again. Off: the waiting queue continues.
rule:social_stop_all.who: Only the owner, and it needs a reason.

rule:start_date_lock_after_opening.title: Do not move the accounting start date after the opening is posted
rule:start_date_lock_after_opening.does: When ON, once an opening entry exists the accounting start date cannot be changed. Reverse the opening first.
rule:start_date_lock_after_opening.why: Moving the start date would break the opening.
rule:start_date_lock_after_opening.change: ON blocks the change. Past figures never change.
rule:start_date_lock_after_opening.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:supplier_dup_mode.title: Second supplier with the same name, mobile or TIN
rule:supplier_dup_mode.does: off: no check. warn: save it and add a yellow line to Exceptions. block: refuse it unless the owner allows one exception.
rule:supplier_dup_mode.why: A duplicate supplier can take a double payment.
rule:supplier_dup_mode.change: warn or block checks new suppliers only. Suppliers already saved do not change.
rule:supplier_dup_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:supplier_pay_dup_hours.title: Window for the repeat-payment check
rule:supplier_pay_dup_hours.does: How many hours back a payment counts as a repeat. It is used only when the repeat check is not off.
rule:supplier_pay_dup_hours.why: It sets how wide the check looks.
rule:supplier_pay_dup_hours.change: A number of hours from 1 to 720.
rule:supplier_pay_dup_hours.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:supplier_pay_dup_mode.title: Same supplier payment entered twice
rule:supplier_pay_dup_mode.does: off: no check. flag: save it and add a yellow line to Exceptions. block: refuse it unless the owner allows one exception; a repeat is the same supplier and total inside a time window.
rule:supplier_pay_dup_mode.why: A payment keyed twice sends money out twice.
rule:supplier_pay_dup_mode.change: flag or block compares new payments only. Payments already saved do not change.
rule:supplier_pay_dup_mode.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:supplier_pay_over.title: A supplier payment above this amount waits for the approver
rule:supplier_pay_over.does: A payment above this total, entered by someone who is not the owner, is held until the approver decides. The owner is not held.
rule:supplier_pay_over.why: Large payments get a second pair of eyes.
rule:supplier_pay_over.change: A number in Tk sets the limit. A held payment is not paid and the supplier balance does not change until approved.
rule:supplier_pay_over.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.title: Supplier payment limit over several days
rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.does: A number of days, 0 to 365. The supplier payment limit is compared with this payment plus what the same person already paid or has waiting for the same supplier in that many days.
rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.why: Stops splitting one big payment into small ones to stay under the limit.
rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.default: 0, the limit is checked per payment as today.
rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.change: Only used when the supplier payment limit has a number. The owner is never held.

rule:switch_coupling_warning.title: Warning before a switch that locks other screens
rule:switch_coupling_warning.does: off: no warning. warn: the screen shows what a switch will lock or unlock before it is saved. confirm: the owner must also tick a confirmation, and the server checks it.
rule:switch_coupling_warning.why: Some switches lock other screens and nobody knew.
rule:switch_coupling_warning.default: warn. It shows text only and blocks nothing.
rule:switch_coupling_warning.change: confirm refuses turning on the coupled switches without a fresh confirmation. Turning them OFF is never held back.
rule:switch_coupling_warning.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:todo_on.title: To-do list is on (extra tasks given to people)
rule:todo_on.does: Turns the to-do list on or off. On lets the owner or a designated person give an extra task to one person or to a role, with a due date and a priority. The person sees only his own tasks and a small card on Home when he has some open.
rule:todo_on.why: Extra duties get a name, a date and an answer instead of a spoken request.
rule:todo_on.default: Off. No card on Home, no menu entry, and nothing can be given.
rule:todo_on.change: Turning it on shows the list and the card. Turning it off hides them and keeps every task and note.

rule:todo_repeat_on.title: To-do: repeating duties (daily or weekly)
rule:todo_repeat_on.does: Lets a task be given as daily or weekly. When the person marks a repeating task done, or cannot do, the next one is made for the same person.
rule:todo_repeat_on.why: A routine duty should not have to be given again every day.
rule:todo_repeat_on.default: Off. The repeat choice is not shown and the server refuses it.
rule:todo_repeat_on.change: Turn it on after todo_on. The next due date is the later of the old due date and today, plus one day or seven days.

rule:transfer_price_pct.title: Transfer value = this % of the selling price (only for price_pct)
rule:transfer_price_pct.does: The percentage of the item's selling price used as the value of goods moved between units, when the basis is price_pct.
rule:transfer_price_pct.why: A blank number blocks the basis that needs it: no value is guessed.
rule:transfer_price_pct.default: Blank. With price_pct the report says 'percentage not set'.
rule:transfer_price_pct.change: Transfers get a value in the factory-vs-retail report and the factory margin on transfers is worked out. An item with no selling price stays 'not valued'.

rule:transfer_valuation_basis.title: How goods moved from the factory to the shops are valued (reports only)
rule:transfer_valuation_basis.does: Decides the value shown for transfers in the factory-vs-retail report: none (not valued), cost (the factory's ledger cost) or price_pct (a percentage of the selling price, set in transfer_price_pct).
rule:transfer_valuation_basis.why: Without a value for transfers the factory result and the shop result cannot be told apart.
rule:transfer_valuation_basis.default: none. The report says 'not valued' and shows quantities and the ledger cost only.
rule:transfer_valuation_basis.change: Only the factory-vs-retail report changes. No stock, journal or price is touched.

rule:transit_short_bearer.title: Who bears goods short in transit
rule:transit_short_bearer.does: ask: the owner chooses for each case. carrier: claim to the carrier first, with no direct write-off. shop: no claim, write off as a loss.
rule:transit_short_bearer.why: Goods lost on the way cost money, and someone must carry it.
rule:transit_short_bearer.change: The choice applies to new cases. Past cases do not change.
rule:transit_short_bearer.who: Only the owner, in the Switchboard.

rule:void_follows_return_rules.title: A void must follow the return rules
rule:void_follows_return_rules.does: When ON, voiding a sale is refused if a full return of the same sale would be refused: outside the return window, a class set to never put back, or goods from an expired batch.
rule:void_follows_return_rules.why: Stops a void from being used to put goods back on the shelf when a return was refused.
rule:void_follows_return_rules.default: OFF, a void works as today.
rule:void_follows_return_rules.change: ON: the owner and holders of the return override right may still void with a written reason; that is logged and shown in the Exceptions list.

rule:website_brand_bn.title: Shop name (Bangla)
rule:website_brand_bn.does: The shop name shown on the public pages in Bangla.
