rule:website_brand_bn.default: Blank: the header shows a generic word.
rule:website_brand_bn.change: The header and footer change at once.

rule:website_brand_en.title: Shop name (English)
rule:website_brand_en.does: The shop name shown on the public pages in English.
rule:website_brand_en.why: English-speaking customers read the name first.
rule:website_brand_en.default: Blank: the header shows a generic word.
rule:website_brand_en.change: The English header and footer change at once.

rule:website_captcha_on.title: Captcha required for web orders
rule:website_captcha_on.does: Requires a captcha pass for web orders; no captcha provider is connected yet.
rule:website_captcha_on.why: Captcha stops automatic order spam, but while it is on and no provider exists the shop refuses orders.
rule:website_captcha_on.change: All web checkouts are refused until a provider is added.

rule:website_custom_cake_on.title: Custom cake request form
rule:website_custom_cake_on.does: Shows the form where a customer asks for a custom cake with a reference photo.
rule:website_custom_cake_on.why: A custom cake needs a conversation before it is made.
rule:website_custom_cake_on.change: Customers can send requests; the owner confirms or declines each one.

rule:website_cutoff_hour.title: Same-day order cut-off (hour)
rule:website_cutoff_hour.does: After this hour (Dhaka time) same-day delivery is refused.
rule:website_cutoff_hour.why: Late orders cannot be made and delivered the same day.
rule:website_cutoff_hour.change: Customers see the same-day refusal after this hour.

rule:website_festival_mode_on.title: Festival pre-order mode
rule:website_festival_mode_on.does: Lets items show as Pre-order and applies the minimum lead days for festival orders.
rule:website_festival_mode_on.why: Peak days need orders days ahead.
rule:website_festival_mode_on.default: Off: items show In stock, Limited or Sold out only.
rule:website_festival_mode_on.change: Items set to pre-order show Pre-order to customers.

rule:website_ga_id.title: Google Analytics ID
rule:website_ga_id.does: Adds Google Analytics only when this ID is set and the visitor accepted cookies.
rule:website_ga_id.why: Analytics must be chosen by the owner and agreed by the visitor.
rule:website_ga_id.default: Blank: no analytics code is loaded.
rule:website_ga_id.change: Visitors who accept cookies are measured from their next visit.

rule:website_holiday_text_bn.title: Closure banner (Bangla)
rule:website_holiday_text_bn.does: A banner in Bangla on every public page, for a holiday or a notice.
rule:website_holiday_text_bn.why: Customers should know before they order.

rule:website_holiday_text_en.title: Closure banner (English)
rule:website_holiday_text_en.does: A banner in English on every public page, for a holiday or a notice.
rule:website_holiday_text_en.why: English-speaking customers should know before they order.
rule:website_holiday_text_en.change: The English banner appears at once.

rule:website_lead_days.title: Minimum lead days for an order
rule:website_lead_days.does: Orders must be placed at least this many days ahead, for every item.
rule:website_lead_days.why: Cakes and sweets need time to make.
rule:website_lead_days.change: The earliest delivery date moves for all items.

rule:website_location_id.title: Branch that receives web orders
rule:website_location_id.does: Chooses the branch whose stock and order numbers web orders use. 0 means not chosen.
rule:website_location_id.why: A web order is taken from one branch stock, so the wrong branch sends orders to the wrong shelf.
rule:website_location_id.default: Blank/0: web orders are refused. Saving a branch affects new orders only.
rule:website_location_id.change: New web orders use this branch; existing orders keep theirs.

rule:website_messenger_url.title: Messenger page link
rule:website_messenger_url.does: Adds a message-us button that opens this Messenger page.
rule:website_messenger_url.default: Blank: no Messenger button is shown.
rule:website_messenger_url.change: The button appears on the contact and footer areas. Only an https link is used.

rule:website_min_order.title: Minimum order (Tk)
rule:website_min_order.does: A basket below this amount cannot be ordered online.
rule:website_min_order.why: A minimum keeps small online orders from costing more to serve than they bring.
rule:website_min_order.change: Baskets below the new amount are refused at checkout.

rule:website_on.title: Website (online shop) on
rule:website_on.does: Opens the public shop pages for customers.
rule:website_on.why: A public order page is the first thing a stranger can use.
rule:website_on.default: Off: the public pages say the shop is closed and take no orders.
rule:website_on.change: Customers see published items and can place orders for the chosen branch.
rule:website_on.who: Only the owner (Settings or Website screen).

rule:website_pay_cod_on.title: Cash on delivery offered
rule:website_pay_cod_on.does: Shows the cash-on-delivery option at checkout.
rule:website_pay_cod_on.why: Many customers pay in cash when the order arrives.
rule:website_pay_cod_on.default: Off: cash on delivery is not offered.
rule:website_pay_cod_on.change: The option appears or disappears at checkout.

rule:website_pay_manual_on.title: bKash / Nagad payment with a Trx ID
rule:website_pay_manual_on.does: Shows the bKash or Nagad option; the customer types the Trx ID after sending money.
rule:website_pay_manual_on.why: A typed Trx ID is only a claim until a person checks it in the wallet app.
rule:website_pay_manual_on.default: Off: the option is not offered.
rule:website_pay_manual_on.change: Customers can choose it; staff check the payment before confirming.

rule:website_pay_mobile_number.title: bKash / Nagad number shown to customers
rule:website_pay_mobile_number.does: The number customers send money to for the manual option.
rule:website_pay_mobile_number.why: Customers need the right number to pay.
rule:website_pay_mobile_number.default: Blank: the manual option stays hidden.

rule:website_pixel_id.title: Facebook Pixel ID
rule:website_pixel_id.does: Adds the Facebook Pixel only when this ID is set and the visitor accepted cookies.
rule:website_pixel_id.why: The Pixel reports visits to Facebook, so visitors must agree first.
rule:website_pixel_id.default: Blank: no Pixel code is loaded.
rule:website_pixel_id.change: Visitors who accept cookies are tracked from their next visit.

rule:website_policy_privacy_bn.title: Privacy policy (Bangla)
rule:website_policy_privacy_bn.does: The privacy text shown on the policies page in Bangla.
rule:website_policy_privacy_bn.why: Customers give personal details and must know how they are used.
rule:website_policy_privacy_bn.default: Blank: the page says coming soon.
rule:website_policy_privacy_bn.change: The policies page shows the new text.

rule:website_policy_privacy_en.title: Privacy policy (English)
rule:website_policy_privacy_en.does: The privacy text shown on the policies page in English.
rule:website_policy_privacy_en.why: English-speaking customers must know how their details are used.
rule:website_policy_privacy_en.default: Blank: the page says coming soon.
rule:website_policy_privacy_en.change: The English policies page shows the new text.

rule:website_policy_refund_bn.title: Refund and cancellation (Bangla)
rule:website_policy_refund_bn.does: The refund and cancellation text shown on the policies page in Bangla.
rule:website_policy_refund_bn.why: Customers need to know when a cancellation or refund is possible.
rule:website_policy_refund_bn.default: Blank: the page says coming soon.
rule:website_policy_refund_bn.change: The policies page shows the new text.

rule:website_policy_refund_en.title: Refund and cancellation (English)
rule:website_policy_refund_en.does: The refund and cancellation text shown on the policies page in English.
rule:website_policy_refund_en.why: English-speaking customers need to know when a cancellation or refund is possible.
rule:website_policy_refund_en.default: Blank: the page says coming soon.
rule:website_policy_refund_en.change: The English policies page shows the new text.

rule:website_policy_terms_bn.title: Terms (Bangla)
rule:website_policy_terms_bn.does: The terms text shown on the policies page in Bangla.
rule:website_policy_terms_bn.why: Customers should know the rules of ordering.
rule:website_policy_terms_bn.default: Blank: the page says coming soon.
rule:website_policy_terms_bn.change: The policies page shows the new text.

rule:website_policy_terms_en.title: Terms (English)
rule:website_policy_terms_en.does: The terms text shown on the policies page in English.
rule:website_policy_terms_en.why: English-speaking customers should know the rules of ordering.
rule:website_policy_terms_en.default: Blank: the page says coming soon.
rule:website_policy_terms_en.change: The English policies page shows the new text.

rule:website_public_url.title: Public address of the website
rule:website_public_url.does: Stores the https address of the shop once a domain or hosting exists.
rule:website_public_url.why: The go-live checklist uses it to show whether customers can really reach the shop.
rule:website_public_url.default: Blank: the shop is for local testing only.
rule:website_public_url.change: The checklist domain line turns OK. Nothing else changes by itself.

rule:website_rate_max.title: Web orders per device in the time window
rule:website_rate_max.does: Limits how many web order attempts one device may make in the window below.
rule:website_rate_max.why: It slows down automatic order spam.
rule:website_rate_max.change: Devices that go over the limit are told to wait.

rule:website_rate_window_min.title: Web order limit window (minutes)
rule:website_rate_window_min.does: The length of time used for the per-device attempt limit.
rule:website_rate_window_min.why: The limit needs a time window to mean anything.
rule:website_rate_window_min.change: A longer window makes the limit stricter.

rule:website_reserve_minutes.title: Hold time for reserved stock (minutes)
rule:website_reserve_minutes.does: How long a web order keeps its units before they are released.
rule:website_reserve_minutes.why: A hold that is never released would block stock forever.
rule:website_reserve_minutes.change: Holds expire sooner or later; expired holds are released.

rule:website_reserve_on.title: Hold stock at web checkout (hard reservation)
rule:website_reserve_on.does: A web order takes its units out of free stock straight away until it is delivered, cancelled or its hold time ends.
rule:website_reserve_on.why: Without it two customers can buy the last cake; with it the second is told sold out.
rule:website_reserve_on.default: Off: the shop shows availability but holds no stock.
rule:website_reserve_on.change: Checkout is refused as sold out when free stock is not enough.

rule:website_stock_threshold.title: Stock level that shows Limited
rule:website_stock_threshold.does: When free stock is at or below this number, the shop shows Limited instead of In stock.
rule:website_stock_threshold.why: It warns customers without showing the exact stock to the public.
rule:website_stock_threshold.change: Items move to Limited sooner or later on the web.

rule:website_whatsapp.title: WhatsApp number for orders
rule:website_whatsapp.does: Adds WhatsApp order and contact buttons with this number.
rule:website_whatsapp.default: Blank: no WhatsApp button is shown.
rule:website_whatsapp.change: The buttons appear on the public pages.

rule:xb_delivery_on.title: Riders and delivery status
rule:xb_delivery_on.does: Lets the shop assign an order to a rider, move it through out, delivered, failed, reattempt and returned, and record the cash on delivery handed in.
rule:xb_delivery_on.why: Without this the shop does not know which rider has which order or how much cash a rider still holds.
rule:xb_delivery_on.default: Off. No rider or delivery can be recorded.
rule:xb_delivery_on.change: On: a delivery can be assigned to an active rider with a zone fee. The cash collected per rider per day is compared with the deposits; a difference opens one case for the owner to explain.

rule:xc_coaching_on.title: Staff coaching board (owner only)
rule:xc_coaching_on.does: Shows the owner, per person, the figures that already exist: bills, discounts, voids, cash shortage cases, production rejects, late days and complaints. No ranking and no score.
rule:xc_coaching_on.why: Helps the owner talk to people with the same facts for everyone.
rule:xc_coaching_on.default: Off. Nothing is composed, sent or shown.
rule:xc_coaching_on.change: On: the owner can open the board for a chosen period. Other roles cannot see it even when it is on.
rule:xc_coaching_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_markdown_pct.title: Markdown % for unsold stock
rule:xc_markdown_pct.does: The discount suggested for units that cannot sell tomorrow, and the discount a markdown sale is recorded at.
rule:xc_markdown_pct.why: The owner sets the discount, not the software.
rule:xc_markdown_pct.default: Blank. Blank means no discount is suggested and a markdown sale is refused.
rule:xc_markdown_pct.change: A typed percentage (1 to 90) is used for the suggested markdown price and for markdown sales.
rule:xc_markdown_pct.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_price_alert_on.title: Supplier price-rise alert
rule:xc_price_alert_on.does: Puts a warning in the bell when a supplier's rate for an item goes up by more than the percentage set below, compared with that supplier's previous rate.
rule:xc_price_alert_on.why: A rise noticed the day it happens can be negotiated or the menu price changed.
rule:xc_price_alert_on.default: Off. Nothing is composed, sent or shown.
rule:xc_price_alert_on.change: On: the warning appears once per item and supplier per day. Nothing is changed in the purchase records.
rule:xc_price_alert_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_price_rise_pct.title: Rise % that triggers the price alert
rule:xc_price_rise_pct.does: The percentage rise over the previous rate that causes a warning.
rule:xc_price_rise_pct.why: Too small and the owner gets noise; too large and small rises are missed.
rule:xc_price_rise_pct.default: Blank. Blank means the alert says 'threshold not set' and writes nothing.
rule:xc_price_rise_pct.change: A typed percentage (1 to 500) is used by the price alert when its switch is on.
rule:xc_price_rise_pct.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_prod_suggest_on.title: Daily production suggestion
rule:xc_prod_suggest_on.does: Shows a suggested quantity for each item at a place: the average of the same weekday in the last weeks, plus open orders for that day, minus stock on hand. Festival uplift is shown separately.
rule:xc_prod_suggest_on.why: Gives the baker a starting figure from real sales.
rule:xc_prod_suggest_on.default: Off. Nothing is composed, sent or shown.
rule:xc_prod_suggest_on.change: On: the planning screen can show the suggestion and the range. Nothing is written to the production plan until the baker confirms.
rule:xc_prod_suggest_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_prod_weeks.title: Weeks of same-weekday history
rule:xc_prod_weeks.does: How many past weeks of the same weekday the suggestion averages over.
rule:xc_prod_weeks.why: More weeks steadier, fewer weeks quicker to react.
rule:xc_prod_weeks.default: Blank. Blank means no suggestion is shown and the screen says 'data needed'.
rule:xc_prod_weeks.change: Typed weeks (1 to 12) switch the suggestion on for the switched-on places.
rule:xc_prod_weeks.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_summary_email_on.title: Daily summary by e-mail
rule:xc_summary_email_on.does: Sends the summary by e-mail to recipients whose channel is e-mail.
rule:xc_summary_email_on.why: E-mail is the record that can be kept and forwarded.
rule:xc_summary_email_on.default: Off. Nothing is composed, sent or shown.
rule:xc_summary_email_on.change: On: e-mail recipients get the summary. Needs the Gmail secrets set by the technical person (docs/OPS_SETUP.md).
rule:xc_summary_email_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_summary_on.title: Owner daily summary
rule:xc_summary_on.does: Builds one summary of the day (sales, cash, wallet receipts, wastage, cakes due tomorrow, and for the owner also dues, approvals and failures) and sends it to the people the owner has entered.
rule:xc_summary_on.why: The owner sees the day in one message instead of opening five screens.
rule:xc_summary_on.default: Off. Nothing is composed, sent or shown.
rule:xc_summary_on.change: On: the summary goes out at the hours set below, to the recipients who are switched on. Nothing is changed in the books.
rule:xc_summary_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_summary_telegram_on.title: Daily summary by Telegram
rule:xc_summary_telegram_on.does: Sends the summary to Telegram chats whose channel is Telegram.
rule:xc_summary_telegram_on.default: Off. Nothing is composed, sent or shown.
rule:xc_summary_telegram_on.change: On: Telegram recipients get the summary. The bot token is kept as a secret by the technical person; the chat number is typed on the recipient row.
rule:xc_summary_telegram_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_summary_times.title: Summary hours (Dhaka)
rule:xc_summary_times.does: The hours of the day the summary is due, for example 08 and 21. 08 means yesterday's figures; 21 means today's.
rule:xc_summary_times.why: Keeps the morning and evening messages where the owner wants them.
rule:xc_summary_times.change: The summary goes out only in the hours listed. The technical schedule runs at about 08:10 and 21:10 Dhaka time.
rule:xc_summary_times.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_sync_alert_on.title: Every shop synced? alert
rule:xc_sync_alert_on.does: Puts a warning in the bell for each place with no recorded sale for longer than the hours set below.
rule:xc_sync_alert_on.why: A shop that has stopped sending sales is found the same day.
rule:xc_sync_alert_on.default: Off. Nothing is composed, sent or shown.
rule:xc_sync_alert_on.change: On: the warning appears once per place per day, if the hours are typed too. Nothing is changed in the books.
rule:xc_sync_alert_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_sync_stale_hours.title: Hours without a sale before the alert
rule:xc_sync_stale_hours.does: How many hours with no recorded sale at a place before the sync warning is shown.
rule:xc_sync_stale_hours.why: A quiet shop is not always broken; the owner knows the hours of each shop.
rule:xc_sync_stale_hours.default: Blank. Blank means the warning says 'threshold not set' and does nothing.
rule:xc_sync_stale_hours.change: Typed hours (1 to 720) make the sync warning work when its switch is on.
rule:xc_sync_stale_hours.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

rule:xc_unsold_on.title: Unsold stock and markdown
rule:xc_unsold_on.does: Lists the units that cannot be sold tomorrow (their expiry is before the end of the next day), lets the person record what happened to each unit (sold at a markdown, staff meal, donation, waste), and shows the wastage share per item.
rule:xc_unsold_on.default: Off. Nothing is composed, sent or shown.
rule:xc_unsold_on.change: On: the end-of-day list and the outcome lines are available. An outcome line never moves stock or money; waste is still booked on the wastage screen.
rule:xc_unsold_on.src: X1-XC builder notes (docs/integration/X*.md); not yet checked against the code

screen:accounts.title: Accounts and ledger
screen:accounts.does: Shows the books: the journal, trial balance, balance sheet and income statement. The Opening tab posts the first balances. You can post new sales, purchases and expenses to the books here.
screen:accounts.why: This is where the records become the books.
screen:accounts.default: Accounting is OFF until the owner switches it on and sets a start date. While it is off, nothing is posted.
screen:accounts.change: Nothing dated before the start date goes into the books. Posted entries are corrected by a reversal, not by a delete.
screen:accounts.who: The owner and people with Accounts view or Accounts manage.

screen:announce.title: Announcements screen
screen:announce.does: Shows what is on the bar for me, with an I have read this button. A poster also sees what he posted, who has read each one, and can withdraw a message with a reason.
screen:announce.why: One place to post, check the read receipts and stop a wrong message.
screen:announce.default: The menu entry is hidden while announce_on is off.
screen:announce.change: Switch announce_on on to see it. A withdrawn message stays in the list with its reason and is never deleted.
screen:announce.who: Everyone reads. Holders of announce_post and the owner post and see the receipts of their own posts.

screen:balancecheck.title: Balance check
screen:balancecheck.does: Checks that the books agree. Red means the equation, the trial balance, a journal entry or a stock figure is wrong. Day book and other cross-checks show as amber warnings.
screen:balancecheck.why: A red line means a figure cannot be trusted.
screen:balancecheck.change: There is no switch. It needs the accounting start date, and without it the page says data is needed.
screen:balancecheck.who: The owner and people with Accounts view or Accounts manage.

screen:bankreceipt.title: Bank and cheque receipts
screen:bankreceipt.does: Takes a customer payment by bank transfer or cheque, with the account it went to and a reference. A cheque is a bank receipt with its cheque number.
screen:bankreceipt.why: Hotels and offices often pay by bank, and cash or card would be wrong.
screen:bankreceipt.default: Nothing shows until "Accept bank transfer and cheque from customers" is switched on.
screen:bankreceipt.change: A missing reference can be waived with a written reason. That adds an audit line and a yellow Exceptions row.
screen:bankreceipt.who: People who can use the POS.

screen:cakejobs.title: Custom cake jobs and due tomorrow
screen:cakejobs.does: Lists custom cakes for a place and date range with their state, and moves each one step forward: confirm, production slip, baked, decorated, ready, delivered. Shows the sheet of cakes due tomorrow with count, weight, flavour, message, design and allergy notes.
screen:cakejobs.why: Custom cakes are the largest orders of the week, and the list shows what is due and the step each cake is at.
screen:cakejobs.default: Visible. Its switch 'Custom cake workflow' defaults OFF; with the switch OFF no cake job can be made or moved.
screen:cakejobs.change: A cake moves one step at a time and cannot be skipped; delivery needs the app order delivered first and, when that switch is on, a photo. Nothing is sent to the customer from this screen.
screen:cakejobs.who: The owner, and people who can use point of sale for the place. Price and capacity rules are set in the cake price list and the cake settings.

screen:camrec.title: Camera & Recognition
screen:camrec.does: Lists each way the app can read a barcode, label or photo, says whether this phone can run it now and why not, and runs a self-test on each one.
screen:camrec.why: Shows the truth about this phone before anyone relies on the camera.
screen:camrec.default: Every recognition option is OFF, so the screen reports them as off.
screen:camrec.change: The screen only reads; switches are changed in Settings.

screen:connect.title: Connect Center
screen:connect.does: One place for every outside connection: website and domain, hosting, Facebook Page, Instagram, WhatsApp Business, SMS gateway, e-mail, bKash and Nagad, AI provider, image reading and analytics. It shows the status, the non-secret settings, the names of the server secrets each one needs and where to set them, and a Test connection button.
screen:connect.why: When the owner buys a domain or gets a key, he links it here without changing the app.
screen:connect.default: Every connection is OFF and not connected.
screen:connect.change: Owner: switch a connection on, set its address (https only), rate and monthly call cap, read-only and dry-run. Secret VALUES are never typed here: they are set on the server under the names shown.
screen:connect.who: Only the owner can see and change it.

screen:exceptions.title: Exceptions
screen:exceptions.does: Lists the lines that need a look: red lines are serious and yellow lines are notes. Every override that needs a reason lands here.
screen:exceptions.why: It shows where a control was bypassed, so nothing is hidden.
screen:exceptions.default: Read only. It does not block anything.
screen:exceptions.change: There is no switch. Each control decides what it writes here.
screen:exceptions.src: phase46.sql; phase87.sql; I-1.md section 1 (one list of 18 kinds)

screen:freshness.title: Books freshness
screen:freshness.does: Shows when the last document was posted to the books, what still waits, and if the books are ready to fill by themselves. A button checks what the next run would post and changes nothing.
screen:freshness.why: The books fill only when something posts documents, so you should see how fresh they are.
screen:freshness.default: Read only. Scheduled posting is OFF.
screen:freshness.change: The owner can switch scheduled posting ON or OFF here. The page shows a warning first.
screen:freshness.who: People with Accounts view or Accounts manage can look. Only the owner switches posting.

screen:ledgerlinks.title: Ledger links
screen:ledgerlinks.does: Shows the master switch that makes approved forms post to the stock ledger, and the switch for each form.
screen:ledgerlinks.why: It is where you decide if paper forms drive the stock.
screen:ledgerlinks.change: A warning shows what the switch will lock, before it is saved.

screen:market.title: Market & growth
screen:market.does: One page with five tabs: Overview, Research (topics, sources, findings), Prices (competitor prices and CSV import), Opportunities (evidence, KPI, status, tasks, measuring from sales) and Growth (our item and outlet growth, bought together, festival review).
screen:market.why: It joins what we read about the market with what our own sales show, so a decision can be checked against real numbers.
screen:market.default: Empty until the owner switches on the workspace and gives the rights.
screen:market.change: Every number says what it is based on: the days it covers and the assumptions. A warning reminds that a pattern is not a cause.
screen:market.who: The owner decides who has the rights. The page itself has no setting.

screen:moneyaccounts.title: Money accounts
screen:moneyaccounts.does: Lists your cash drawers, mobile wallets and bank accounts. Each one is its own account in the books. You can see a statement, move money, charge a fee and check the real balance.
screen:moneyaccounts.why: Every payment can come from the account you choose, and the books follow it.
screen:moneyaccounts.default: Nothing is drawn until at least one account exists. A payment with no account posts as before.
screen:moneyaccounts.change: Adding an account changes no old figure. An account with a balance, an unposted payment or a repeat transfer cannot be switched off.
screen:moneyaccounts.who: People with the Accounts view grant can see it. The owner and Accounts manage change it.

screen:moneycontrols.title: Money controls
screen:moneycontrols.does: One page for the cash, supplier and journal controls. It shows each setting and the requests that wait for the approver.
screen:moneycontrols.why: It is the place to see which controls are on.
screen:moneycontrols.default: Every control starts OFF or blank, so nothing changes until you set it.
screen:moneycontrols.change: A held request is decided by the approver chosen under the owner approval setting. The maker never decides.
screen:moneycontrols.who: People with Accounts view, Accounts manage, cash move or supplier pay can look. The owner changes the settings.

screen:monthclose.title: Monthly Close
screen:monthclose.does: Shows a month before you mark it reviewed. It carries salary accrual and the partner profit share. Mark the month reviewed or undo the mark.
screen:monthclose.why: A month should be looked at once before it is left.
screen:monthclose.default: The mark is only a log. It does not lock the month.
screen:monthclose.change: To lock a month, set "Books closed until" separately.
screen:monthclose.who: The owner and people with Accounts manage.

screen:openparties.title: Opening dues and payables
screen:openparties.does: Type what customers owed you and what you owed suppliers on day one, one by one or by paste. It also shows where the party lists and the books differ.
screen:openparties.why: Old dues can then be collected and counted in credit limits.
screen:openparties.default: Nothing changes until "Count opening dues in customer balances" is switched on.
screen:openparties.change: You can type or paste only before the opening batch is posted. After that, use an adjustment with a reason.
screen:openparties.who: People with Accounts manage for all places type and adjust. People with Accounts view can look. A branch accountant is refused.

screen:otherincome.title: Other income
screen:otherincome.does: Records money that is not a sale: scrap, old oil, rent received, supplier discount. It posts to the Other income account.
screen:otherincome.why: This money would otherwise have no place in the books.
screen:otherincome.default: The screen refuses entries until "Other income entry" is switched on.
screen:otherincome.change: A recorded entry can be voided. Entries dated before the "from" date are refused.
screen:otherincome.who: The owner, and people with the cash move grant or Accounts view or manage.

screen:partyrequest.title: Ask to pay a supplier
screen:partyrequest.does: Write a request to pay a supplier and follow its status.
screen:partyrequest.why: Supplier payments start from a written request.
screen:partyrequest.default: Shows a notice while the switch is off.

screen:paths.title: Path switches
screen:paths.does: For jobs that can be done two ways, the app screen or the paper form, you choose which one is the main record. The other becomes a locked shadow copy.
screen:paths.why: One job must be counted once.
screen:paths.default: The app screen (path a) is the main record, as set for each job.
screen:paths.change: Nothing is deleted, and the other path keeps a locked shadow copy. A refused screen says path_locked.

screen:payapprovals.title: Pay requests to decide
screen:payapprovals.does: Waiting, due today, later and all. Approve on the date asked or on another date, reject with a reason, or pay from the list.
screen:payapprovals.why: The person responsible sees everything he must decide or pay today in one place.
screen:payapprovals.default: Empty until requests are switched on.
screen:payapprovals.change: The approver is set on the Pay request settings page.
screen:payapprovals.who: The chosen approver and the owner.

screen:paycapture.title: Mobile payment capture and verify
screen:paycapture.does: Writes a bKash, Nagad or Rocket payment: the Trx-ID, sender number, amount, time and what it is for (an order, an advance or nothing yet). A pasted SMS can be read to fill the boxes; the person checks every value before saving. The server flags the payment ok, over, under or no target, and lists the payments waiting for a second person.
screen:paycapture.why: A Trx-ID can be used only once, and writing it down stops a double use and shows at the end of the day whether the phone and the app agree.
screen:paycapture.default: Visible. Its switch 'Write down bKash, Nagad and Rocket payments' defaults OFF; with the switch OFF nothing can be written.
screen:paycapture.change: Nothing is posted to the books by this screen, and a second person verifies each payment; nobody verifies the payment they wrote. A rejected or flagged payment needs a note.
screen:paycapture.who: The owner, and people who can use point of sale for the place. Verifying needs the 'Verify mobile payments' grant, which the server checks.

screen:payreqsettings.title: Pay request settings
screen:payreqsettings.does: Switch requests on, choose who decides, switch the policy on, set the exception rule and the limits.
screen:payreqsettings.why: Every owner decision is a setting that can change at any time.
screen:payreqsettings.change: Each change is written to the change log.

screen:payrequest.title: Ask for salary or advance
screen:payrequest.does: Send a request and see the status and dates of your requests. You can cancel one that is not paid.
screen:payrequest.why: One place for asking and for knowing the answer.
screen:payrequest.default: Shows a notice while the switch is off.
screen:payrequest.who: Staff linked to an employee record. A payroll manager can enter one for a colleague.

screen:periodlock.title: Period lock
screen:periodlock.does: Shows if the books are closed and up to what date. The owner can open an override window with a reason. It also lists held late sales and the back-date limits.
screen:periodlock.why: A closed month should stay closed unless someone has a reason.
screen:periodlock.default: Nothing changes by itself. The lock date is the one typed in "Books closed until". Every new rule starts OFF or blank.
screen:periodlock.change: Changing a rule here affects new entries only. Past figures never change.
screen:periodlock.who: The owner changes rules and opens windows. People with Accounts manage see the state.

screen:profitcheck.title: Profit check
screen:profitcheck.does: Compares the management profit with the journal profit and lists the difference by cause. You can leave one loss out of the profit with a reason. It also shows if day book, profit, expense report and journal agree, and holds the dated brand map.
screen:profitcheck.why: Branch ranking and partner shares rest on one profit number.
screen:profitcheck.default: Read only for most people. All profit settings start OFF, so every profit figure stays as it is today.
screen:profitcheck.change: Leaving a loss out needs a reason of 5 letters or more, and it writes an audit line and a yellow Exceptions row. It can be counted again, and no journal entry is written.
screen:profitcheck.who: People with Accounts view or Accounts manage can look. Only the owner changes settings and the brand map.

screen:returnrules.title: Return and exit rules
screen:returnrules.does: Sets the rules for sale returns and for people who leave. For returns: the return window, the receipt need, which goods go back on the shelf, and what to do with expired goods.
screen:returnrules.why: A returned sweet or cake should not go back on sale by mistake.
screen:returnrules.default: Every rule starts OFF or blank, so returns work as today.
screen:returnrules.change: A class rule can start on a later day. A rule that starts later is not used today.
screen:returnrules.who: The owner sets the rules. People with the return override grant can pass a rule with a reason.

screen:riders.title: Riders, delivery status and cash on delivery
screen:riders.does: Shows the delivery jobs of a place and moves each one: out for delivery, delivered (with the cash collected), failed (with a reason), try again, or returned to the shop. Assigns an open home or courier order to a rider and a zone. Checks a day's cash collected against the deposits rider by rider, records a deposit, and explains an open difference case.
screen:riders.why: Without this the shop does not know which rider has which order or how much cash a rider still holds.
screen:riders.default: Visible. Its switch 'Riders and delivery status' defaults OFF; with the switch OFF no rider or delivery can be recorded.
screen:riders.change: Checking a day can open one case for a rider whose figures differ; a case is explained, never deleted. No cash is posted and no message is sent to a rider or a customer.
screen:riders.who: The owner, and people who can use point of sale for the place. Adding riders and zone fees needs the 'Manage riders and delivery zones' grant.
screen:riders.src: web/xb_riders.js; supabase/phase493.sql (xb_delivery_assign, xb_delivery_move, xb_cod_reconcile, xb_cod_deposit, xb_cod_case_explain)

screen:shifts.title: Shift schedule screen
screen:shifts.does: My shifts lists the next 14 days with shift, time, off-days, approved leave, holidays and notes. A scheduler also gets a weekly roster by place, where a tap on a day sets a template, an off-day or a leave or swap note, plus copy last week and the templates.
screen:shifts.why: One short screen for staff to read and for the planner to edit.
screen:shifts.default: The menu entry is hidden while shift_on is off.
screen:shifts.change: Switch shift_on on to see it. Clearing a day returns it to the weekly pattern, and the old row is kept in the change log.
screen:shifts.who: Everyone reads their own shifts. Holders of shift_manage and the owner edit the roster.

screen:shortages.title: Cash short and transit short
screen:shortages.does: Lists cash short or over cases from the daily count and goods that arrived short between places. A decider approves, claims from the carrier, recovers or writes off. Each step posts a balanced entry.
screen:shortages.why: A shortage should have an owner and a reason, not just disappear.
screen:shortages.default: Cases are listed. Nothing is posted to the books until "Post an approved cash short/over to the books" is ON.
screen:shortages.change: There is no switch on the page. Backfill of old cases is not automatic.
screen:shortages.who: People with Accounts view can look. The decider is set by the "Who decides" setting.

screen:todo.title: To-do list screen
screen:todo.does: A person sees his own open tasks, with overdue ones in red, and marks each one done with an optional note or cannot do with a reason. A giver also sees every task he gave with its status and notes, and can cancel one with a reason or reopen it.
screen:todo.why: Every extra task ends with a visible answer.
screen:todo.default: The menu entry is hidden while todo_on is off.
screen:todo.change: Switch todo_on on to see it. A cancelled or finished task stays in the giver's list and is never deleted.
screen:todo.who: Each person sees only his own tasks. The giver and the owner see what they gave.

screen:wallets.title: Mobile wallets
screen:wallets.does: A register for each wallet: bKash, Nagad, Rocket and Upay. You can add fees, move money, and count the wallet from the phone.
screen:wallets.why: It lets you match each wallet with what the phone really shows.
screen:wallets.default: The wallet register works alone. Nothing moves to its own wallet account until the wallet split switch is ON.
screen:wallets.change: The phone total is typed first, and the book figure comes back after it is saved. A difference needs a reason once.
screen:wallets.who: The owner, people with the 07-1 form right and people with Accounts view.

screen:x1health.title: Automation & integration health
screen:x1health.does: Shows whether automation is on, whether it is paused, each connection and each scheduled job (ok, failed, stale, never run), failed intake items, the last backup, books freshness and proposals waiting for approval.
screen:x1health.why: One screen tells the owner what is working and what is not.
screen:x1health.default: Owner only. The owner may add the health widget to the owner board.
screen:x1health.change: Nothing to set. It only reads.

screen:xcsummary.title: Owner summary: recipients and history
screen:xcsummary.does: Shows who receives the daily owner summary, lets the owner add a recipient or switch one on or off (a switched-off row is kept, never deleted), and shows the send history.
screen:xcsummary.why: The owner decides who gets the summary without asking the technical person.
screen:xcsummary.default: Visible in the menu for the owner. The summary switch defaults OFF; no recipient exists until the owner adds one.
screen:xcsummary.change: This screen sends nothing. The summary goes out only at the set hours, from the scheduled script, to recipients who are switched on.

screen:xcunsold.title: Unsold stock and markdown
screen:xcunsold.does: Lists the units whose expiry falls before the end of tomorrow, with the markdown price the server suggests. For each line the person records one decision: sold at a markdown, staff meal, donation or waste. It also lists the decisions already written for the chosen day.
screen:xcunsold.why: Unsold cakes are money, and the list makes the decision before the end of the day.
screen:xcunsold.default: Visible in the menu for the people who may use it. Its own switch 'Unsold stock and markdown' defaults OFF; with the switch OFF the screen says the feature is switched off and records nothing.
screen:xcunsold.change: Recording a decision never moves stock or money; waste is still booked on the stock screen. A markdown sale is taken at the till.
screen:xcunsold.who: The owner, and people who can open production or point of sale for the place. The server decides every call.

switch:path:expense.title: Path switch: expense
switch:path:expense.does: Chooses which way counts for this job: the day-book quick expense or the 11-1 expense voucher. The other way becomes a locked shadow copy.
switch:path:expense.why: One job must be counted once.
switch:path:expense.default: Quick entries get a 11-1 shadow copy at day end, confirmed with one click.
switch:path:expense.change: The other path becomes a shadow copy, and its screen may be refused with path_locked; whichever-is-first is also allowed. Nothing is deleted.
switch:path:expense.who: Only the owner, on the path switches page.

switch:path:owner_money.title: Path switch: owner money
switch:path:owner_money.does: Chooses which way counts for this job: partner capital or the cash move for an owner top-up or draw. The other way becomes a locked shadow copy.
switch:path:owner_money.why: One job must be counted once.
switch:path:owner_money.default: Partner capital is the main record. The cash move gets the shadow copy.
switch:path:owner_money.change: The other path becomes a shadow copy, and its screen may be refused with path_locked; whichever-is-first is also allowed. Nothing is deleted.
switch:path:owner_money.who: Only the owner, on the path switches page.

switch:path:payroll.title: Path switch: payroll
switch:path:payroll.does: Chooses which way counts for this job: app payroll runs or the 21-1 monthly salary sheet. The other way becomes a locked shadow copy.
switch:path:payroll.why: One job must be counted once.
switch:path:payroll.default: Both are open. Once app payroll starts for a month, 21-1 is locked and kept as a shadow copy.
switch:path:payroll.change: The other path becomes a shadow copy, and its screen may be refused with path_locked; whichever-is-first is also allowed. Nothing is deleted.
switch:path:payroll.who: Only the owner, on the path switches page.

switch:path:production.title: Path switch: production
switch:path:production.does: Chooses which way counts for this job: the recipe production run or the 12-1 factory daily sheet. The other way becomes a locked shadow copy.
switch:path:production.why: One job must be counted once.
switch:path:production.default: The run is the main record. The form is a reference.
switch:path:production.change: The other path becomes a shadow copy and its screen may be refused with path_locked. Nothing is deleted.
switch:path:production.who: Only the owner, on the path switches page.

switch:path:stock_count.title: Path switch: stock count
switch:path:stock_count.does: Chooses which way counts for this job: the stock screen count or the 36-1 count sheet. The other way becomes a locked shadow copy.
switch:path:stock_count.why: One job must be counted once.
switch:path:stock_count.default: The screen is the main record. The form is a reference.
switch:path:stock_count.change: The other path becomes a shadow copy and its screen may be refused with path_locked. Nothing is deleted.
switch:path:stock_count.who: Only the owner, on the path switches page.

switch:path:stock_issue.title: Path switch: stock issue
switch:path:stock_issue.does: Chooses which way counts for this job: the stock screen issue or the 18-1 issue slip. The other way becomes a locked shadow copy.
switch:path:stock_issue.why: One job must be counted once.
switch:path:stock_issue.default: The screen is the main record. The form is a reference.
switch:path:stock_issue.change: The other path becomes a shadow copy and its screen may be refused with path_locked. Nothing is deleted.
switch:path:stock_issue.who: Only the owner, on the path switches page.

switch:path:stock_transfer.title: Path switch: stock transfer
switch:path:stock_transfer.does: Chooses which way counts for this job: the stock screen transfer or the 39-1 transfer challan. The other way becomes a locked shadow copy.
switch:path:stock_transfer.why: One job must be counted once.
switch:path:stock_transfer.default: The screen is the main record. The form is a reference.
switch:path:stock_transfer.change: The other path becomes a shadow copy and its screen may be refused with path_locked. Nothing is deleted.
switch:path:stock_transfer.who: Only the owner, on the path switches page.

rule:transfer_client_reuse_block.title: Refuse a transfer id already used by another user
rule:transfer_client_reuse_block.does: When ON, a factory-to-branch send whose id was already used by a different user is refused. Without it, the second send is answered as done with the first transfer's id and its goods are not moved.
rule:transfer_client_reuse_block.why: A send that is reported as done but never moved goods hides stock that is still in the factory.
rule:transfer_client_reuse_block.default: Off. The second send is answered as done with the first transfer's id (as before).
rule:transfer_client_reuse_block.change: On: the second send is refused with "client_id_reused"; nothing moves. The same user retrying the same send still gets the first result.
rule:transfer_client_reuse_block.src: phase544 (SW-7, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md item 20); reproduced on a local database, not yet checked in the app

rule:price_check_include_freight.title: Include freight in the purchase price check
rule:price_check_include_freight.does: When ON, after a landed cost (freight, duty, clearing and other charges) is posted, each item it touches is compared with its last purchase, using the invoice price plus the freight allocated to that item. A jump above the threshold (Purchase cost jump %) gives a yellow flag in the exceptions list.
rule:price_check_include_freight.why: A freight rise is a real rise in what the goods cost. The price check that runs at bill posting sees only the invoice price, so it misses it.
rule:price_check_include_freight.default: Off. The price check uses the invoice price only, as before.
rule:price_check_include_freight.change: On: the flag appears when the landed cost is posted, because the freight is not known before that. The check at bill posting does not change.
rule:price_check_include_freight.src: phase545 (docs/PLAN_NEXT.md item 45); tested on a local database (phase545_test.sql; the scenario with the switch off gives the same state as the chain without phase 545); not yet checked in the app

rule:transfer_overdraw_block.title: Refuse a send bigger than the stock on hand (transfers)
rule:transfer_overdraw_block.does: When ON, a transfer from a place is refused if the place has less stock of that item than the quantity sent.
rule:transfer_overdraw_block.why: Stops a factory from sending goods it does not have, which makes its stock negative in the books.
rule:transfer_overdraw_block.default: Off. A send bigger than the stock is accepted and the sender balance can go negative (as before).
rule:transfer_overdraw_block.change: On: the send is refused with "insufficient_stock". Sends within stock still work.
rule:transfer_overdraw_block.src: phase499 or phase501 to phase505 (SW, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md section 2); not yet checked in the app

rule:transfer_paused_block.title: Refuse a transfer to a paused or closed place
rule:transfer_paused_block.does: When ON, a transfer to a place whose status is not live (paused or closed) is refused.
rule:transfer_paused_block.why: Goods sent to a place nobody is open to receive end up in transit for ever.
rule:transfer_paused_block.default: Off. A send to a paused place is accepted (as before).
rule:transfer_paused_block.change: On: the send is refused with "destination_paused".
rule:transfer_paused_block.src: phase499 or phase501 to phase505 (SW, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md section 2); not yet checked in the app

rule:transfer_partial_on.title: Receive a transfer in parts
rule:transfer_partial_on.does: When ON, the receiver can take in part of a transfer now and the rest later. The transfer stays open until all of it arrives, or the owner closes the rest as short.
rule:transfer_partial_on.why: A factory ships by van in several lots, so one receipt for the whole transfer is not how it arrives.
rule:transfer_partial_on.default: Off. One receipt closes the transfer, as before.
rule:transfer_partial_on.change: On: a part receipt leaves the transfer open. The owner can close the rest as short with the close-short action (one short-in-transit line is written).
rule:transfer_partial_on.src: phase499 or phase501 to phase505 (SW, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md section 2); not yet checked in the app

rule:stock_unit_unknown_block.title: Refuse a sale when the unit conversion is unknown
rule:stock_unit_unknown_block.does: When ON, a sale of a tracked item whose unit has no conversion to the base unit is refused.
rule:stock_unit_unknown_block.why: Without a conversion the sale is kept but the stock is not reduced, so the stock figure is wrong.
rule:stock_unit_unknown_block.default: Off. The sale is kept with a yellow warning and the stock is not reduced (as before).
rule:stock_unit_unknown_block.change: On: the sale is refused with "stock_unit_unknown". Fix the conversion first.
rule:stock_unit_unknown_block.src: phase499 or phase501 to phase505 (SW, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md section 2); not yet checked in the app

rule:return_sale_factor_on.title: Return at the conversion factor of the sale
rule:return_sale_factor_on.does: When ON, a sale return puts back stock using the conversion factor that the sale used, not today factor.
rule:return_sale_factor_on.why: If the conversion was edited after the sale, today factor puts back the wrong quantity.
rule:return_sale_factor_on.default: Off. A return uses today factor (as before). Sales made before the new table have no saved factor and always use today factor.
rule:return_sale_factor_on.change: On: the returned quantity matches what the sale took out.
rule:return_sale_factor_on.src: phase499 or phase501 to phase505 (SW, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md section 2); not yet checked in the app

rule:biz_items_net_returns.title: Item analysis takes sale returns off
rule:biz_items_net_returns.does: When ON, the item analysis (per item revenue and quantity) takes off the returns made in the period.
rule:biz_items_net_returns.why: The returns line of the other reports already takes them off, and the item analysis did not.
rule:biz_items_net_returns.default: Off. The item analysis shows sales before returns (as before).
rule:biz_items_net_returns.change: On: quantity and revenue per item are after returns, for the day the return was made.
rule:biz_items_net_returns.src: phase499 or phase501 to phase505 (SW, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md section 2); not yet checked in the app

rule:dues_net_advance_on.title: Customer due takes off applied advances
rule:dues_net_advance_on.does: When ON, an advance that was applied to a customer sale reduces the customer due in the due list.
rule:dues_net_advance_on.why: An advance that was used still showed the sale as owed, so the same money could be collected twice.
rule:dues_net_advance_on.default: Off. The due list shows the sale as owed (as before).
rule:dues_net_advance_on.change: On: the due list shows the due after the applied advance.
rule:dues_net_advance_on.src: phase499 or phase501 to phase505 (SW, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md section 2); not yet checked in the app

rule:recipe_intermediate_on.title: A made product as an ingredient of another recipe
rule:recipe_intermediate_on.does: When ON, a finished item made by its own recipe (for example chhana or dough) can be an ingredient of another recipe. A loop (A needs B needs A) is refused.
rule:recipe_intermediate_on.why: Two-stage sweets need the made intermediate, and without this the recipe cannot be saved.
rule:recipe_intermediate_on.default: Off. Only raw material, packaging and resale items can be ingredients (as before).
rule:recipe_intermediate_on.change: On: the recipe can use a made product. Production uses its stock at the average cost.
rule:recipe_intermediate_on.src: phase499 or phase501 to phase505 (SW, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md section 2); not yet checked in the app

rule:tracking_map_apply_on.title: Apply the reviewed stock tracking map
rule:tracking_map_apply_on.does: When ON, the owner can apply the reviewed tracking proposal to the items of one item type. The proposal is shown first and changes nothing until applied.
rule:tracking_map_apply_on.why: Not every item should be stock-tracked, so the proposal is decided once per item type.
rule:tracking_map_apply_on.default: Off. The map can be read and reviewed; nothing changes.
rule:tracking_map_apply_on.change: On: the owner can apply a reviewed type. Opening stock must be counted first.
rule:tracking_map_apply_on.src: phase499 or phase501 to phase505 (SW, docs/PLAN_NEXT.md section 2); not yet checked in the app

rule:accounting_autopost.title: Post new business events when the accounts page opens
rule:accounting_autopost.does: On = opening the accounts page posts new sales, purchases and expenses by itself. Off = press "Post now".
rule:accounting_autopost.why: An owner decision kept as a setting with a safe default (BUILD-RULES: every owner decision is a setting).

feature:layout_choice.title: Screen layout (phone or PC look)
feature:layout_choice.does: Lets you choose how the app looks on this device: Automatic (by screen width), Phone look (always the phone layout) or PC look (the desktop layout with a side menu, where the screen is wide enough).
feature:layout_choice.why: A PC with a narrow window or a phone in landscape may look better with one of the two fixed looks.
feature:layout_choice.default: Automatic. The choice is saved on this device only, never in the database.
feature:layout_choice.change: Tap one of the three buttons in Settings. The screen changes at once; no reload is needed.
feature:layout_choice.who: Anyone who can open Settings sees the choice for this device only. It does not change what other devices or staff see.
